lessons.title: Present Perfect
lessons.grammar_topic: PRESENT PERFECT (have/has + V3)
lessons.book_ref: Asosiy material — shu reja (formula jadvali, mashqlar, matn). Ixtiyoriy qo'shimcha: Student's book IELTS 2.0, Lesson 1 — dars kitobsiz ham to'liq o'tiladi.
objectives: Present Perfect (have/has + V3) tasdiq, inkor va savolini tuzadi: 'have yoki has' mashqidagi 8 gapdan kamida 6 tasini to'g'ri to'ldiradi.
"Have you ever…?" savolini beradi va "Yes, I have / No, I haven't" + 1 tafsilot bilan javob beradi (mini-vazifada 5 ta savol-javob).
been to / gone to farqini ajratadi: 'been yoki gone' mashqidagi 6 gapdan kamida 5 tasida to'g'ri tanlaydi.
20 ta hikoya fe'lining V1–V2–V3 shakllarini yoddan aytadi (CORE 20; V3 jadvalidagi 10 fe'ldan kamida 8 tasi to'g'ri).
Kombinatsiya: formula jadvalini (tasdiq → inkor → savol) 1 daqiqada 4 marta to'liq aytadi.
materials: Formula jadvali — rejaning Grammatika bo'limi (grammar.formulas), proyektor yoki doska
Narrative verbs (hikoya fe'llari, V1–V2–V3) CORE 20 varag'i.
Kirish diagnostikasi — class_ex 'Kirish diagnostikasi' (20 fe'l), proyektor yoki doska. Kahoot bu darsda o'ynalmaydi: 1-dars Kahooti 2-dars boshida o'ynaladi.
timeline: Salomlashish + kirish savoli
"What have you done today?" — ustoz 3 o'quvchidan so'raydi, javoblarni doskaga yozadi (I have eaten…, I have come…).
Kirish — IELTS 2.0 kursi bilan tanishuv

Ustoz kurs tartibini tushuntiradi: har dars boshida o'tgan dars Kahooti va o'tgan dars CORE 20 yozma normativi; Kombinatsiya (1 jumlali ta'rif), coin va ovozli normativ; Jony Student ilovasi; 7, 14, 20-darslarda Progress Test, 25-darsda Final Test.
KIRISH DIAGNOSTIKASI — 1.0 takrori: Past Simple (V1 → V2)

Yozma, 6 daqiqa + 2 daqiqa kalit bilan tekshirish. Material: class_ex 'Kirish diagnostikasi' (1-dars CORE'da yo'q 20 ta keng tarqalgan noto'g'ri fe'l, to'liq kalit). Coin berilmaydi — natija ustozga guruh darajasini ko'rsatadi.
YANGI MAVZU — Present Perfect (have/has + V3)

Formula jadvali (grammar.formulas): Tasdiq S + have/has + V3 → Inkor S + haven't/hasn't + V3 → Savol Have/Has + S + V3? Har qatorda misol + tarjima, keyin o'quvchi o'zi misol tuzadi; so'ng ever/never va been to / gone to qatorlari, presentation savol-javoblari. + 3 CCQ (grammar.notes).
Narrative verbs (hikoya fe'llari, V1–V2–V3) — CORE 20
Har fe'l: V1 – V2 – V3 xor bilan, keyin 1 ta Present Perfect gap ("I have ___"). Har 5 fe'ldan keyin tezkor so'rov: ustoz V1 aytadi — o'quvchilar V3. STRONG 20 — kuchlilarga (ixtiyoriy).
Kombinatsiya

Kombinatsiya — o'quvchi bugungi formula jadvalini (tasdiq → inkor → savol, har qatorga 1 misol + o'zbekcha tarjima) yoddan, to'xtamasdan aytib chiqadi va 1 daqiqada necha marta to'liq aytgani sanaladi. Bugun: S + have/has + V3 / S + haven't/hasn't + V3 / Have/Has + S + V3? Juftlikda: biri aytadi, biri sanaydi. 1 daqiqada 3 marta — warm-up, 4 marta — normativ, 5 marta — 2 coin.
Sinf mashqlari
Majburiy: V3 jadvali (4 daq, yakka + juftlikda tekshirish), have yoki has (6 daq, yakka), Natija gapi (8 daq, juftlik — og'zaki, keyin yozma), been yoki gone (5 daq). ZAXIRA: Xatoni toping.
Reading
Jony Academy matni "Sardor Rashidov: what he has done" + 3 topshiriq: Present Perfect toping, TRUE / FALSE / NOT GIVEN, Present Perfect yoki Past Simple?
Writing / speaking mini-vazifa

Mini-vazifa: Have you ever…? — 6 daqiqa juftlikda 5 ta savol-javob ("ha" bo'lsa 1 tafsilot) va 2 ta Part 1 savoli; 6 daqiqa — sherigi haqida 5 gap yozadi. Mezon: speaking_mini / mini_writing, 3 × 0–2.
Xatolar ustida ishlash + exit ticket
4 daqiqa: darsda ko'p uchragan xatolar doskada (have went → have gone; yesterday bilan Past Simple; been / gone); vaqt qolsa — ZAXIRA: Xatoni toping. Oxirgi 3 daqiqa: Exit ticket (class_ex oxirida).
Uyga vazifa
Majburiy: Mashq to'plami (12 band), yozma ish "Mening haftam" (8 gap), ovozli normativ. Qo'shimcha: tarjima, flashcard. Ustoz Mashq to'plamining 1-bandini sinfda namuna qilib ko'rsatadi.

intro: Present Perfect — o'tgan zamonda bo'lgan, lekin natijasi HOZIR ko'rinadigan ish. Vaqt aytilmaydi: "I have lost my key" (kalitim yo'q — hozir).
Past Simple'dan farqi: Past Simple'da vaqt aniq (yesterday, in 2020), Present Perfect'da vaqt muhim emas — natija muhim.
have/has — yordamchi; asosiy fe'l 3-shaklda (V3). Regular: V+ed; irregular — jadvaldan yod olinadi (bugungi lug'at).
formulas: I have started my business recently.
Have you ever been to Tashkent?
have been to = borib kelgan; have gone to = ketgan (hali u yerda)
Yes, I have. / No, I haven't.
Has she called? — Yes, she has.
presentation: Have you ever broken a bone?
Yes, I have. I have broken my arm.
Has your teacher come?
No, she hasn't come yet.
What have you eaten today?
I have eaten plov.
Have they finished the test?
Yes, they have finished it.
Has he ever seen the sea?
No, he has never seen the sea.
Have you done your homework?
Yes, I have done it.
Where has Ali gone?
He has gone to the bank.
Have you been to Samarkand?
Yes, I have been there twice.
Has it rained today?
No, it hasn't rained.
How many books have you read this year?
I have read five books.
notes: Vaqt so'zi bo'lsa (yesterday, last week, ago, in 2019) — Past Simple, Present Perfect emas.
Present Perfect bilan yuradigan so'zlar: ever, never, just, already, yet, recently, so far, today, this week.

"been to" — borib kelgan (tashrif); "gone to" — ketgan, hali qaytmagan; "been in" — u yerda bo'lgan/turgan. "been to" ham, "been in" ham to'g'ri; tashrif haqida "been to" ishlating. Ustoz doskada ikkita rasm bilan ko'rsatadi.
Irregular V3 — kombinatsiya bilan emas, lug'at bilan yodlanadi: bugungi CORE 20 shu maqsadda.
CCQ: I have lost my key. — Do I have my key now? (No) — Do we know when I lost it? (No)
CCQ: He has gone to London. — Is he here now? (No) — Is he in London now? (Yes)
CCQ: She has been to London. — Is she in London now? (No) — Did she go there and come back? (Yes)
CCQ: I saw him yesterday. — Do we know when? (Yes) — Present Perfect or Past Simple? (Past Simple)
mistakes: V3 kerak: go – went – GONE (u maktabga ketgan, hozir shu yerda emas).
He hasn't never been to Bukhara.
He has never been to Bukhara.
never — o'zi inkor: hasn't + never = ikki inkor, xato.
He has been to Paris, so he isn't here now.
He has gone to Paris, so he isn't here now.

how: CORE 20 — hikoyalarda eng ko'p uchraydigan irregular fe'llar (3 shakli bilan). STRONG +20 va SUPER +20 — kuchli o'quvchi uchun.
Har so'z: V1 – V2 – V3 aytiladi, so'ng Present Perfect gap: "I have ___". Ovoz chiqarib, xor bilan 2 marta.
Normativ: ustoz V1 aytadi — o'quvchi V2, V3 + tarjima.
core: She has bought a new phone.
He has eaten all the cake.
The child has fallen off the bike.
They have given me a present.
I have known her for years.
strong: Have you paid for the tickets?
Where have you put my bag?
She has read this book twice.
U bu kitobni ikki marta o'qigan.
Have you ever ridden a horse?
She has sung at a concert.
We have sat here for an hour.
Biz bu yerda bir soatdan beri o'tiribmiz.
Have you spoken to the boss?
I have spent all my money.
I have told you the truth.
Our team has won the match.
super: They have built a new bridge.
He has drawn a beautiful picture.
She has driven for ten years.
U o'n yildan beri mashina haydaydi.
I have never felt so happy.
Have you ever flown to Dubai?
The tree has grown a lot.
The cat has hidden under the bed.
I have kept all his letters.
He has lent me his laptop.
I have swum in the sea.
She has taught English for years.
U yillardan beri ingliz tili o'rgatadi.
He has thrown the ball away.
I have worn this shirt twice.
normativ: Normativ — belgilangan vaqt ichida bajariladigan o'lchovli me'yor (lug'at yoki formula); me'yorni bajargan o'quvchi rejadagi coin'ni oladi.
Ovozli (uyda): CORE 20 — V1–V2–V3 + tarjima, 1.5 daqiqa — 1 coin.
Yozma (2-dars boshida): shu CORE 20, o'zbekchadan inglizchaga, 5 daqiqa, kamida 18 to'g'ri — 2 coin. STRONG 20 — ixtiyoriy, kuchlilar uchun +1 coin.

class_ex.title: have yoki has
class_ex.instr: Bo'sh joyga have / has / haven't / hasn't qo'ying
items: I ___ finished my homework.
She ___ never been to London.
They ___ (not) arrived yet.
___ you ever eaten sushi?
He ___ (not) called me today.
We ___ known each other since 2020.
___ it stopped raining?
My parents ___ bought a new house.

class_ex.title: Natija gapi
class_ex.instr: Vaziyatga qarab Present Perfect gap tuzing: A vaziyatni o'qiydi, B gapni aytadi; keyin ikkalasi yozadi.
items: Aziz's room was dirty. Now it's clean. (Aziz / clean)
Madina can't find her phone. (Madina / lose)
The glass is on the floor in pieces. (Timur / break)
Dad isn't at home. He is at work now. (Dad / go)
Look! Sevara has a new bike. (Sevara / buy)
I'm not hungry now. (I / eat / lunch)
We are late. The film is on now. (the film / begin)
The teacher is angry: the students can't answer. (they / not / do / their homework)
answers: Sevara has bought a new bike.
The film has begun. / The film has already begun.
class_ex.note: Yordam: qavsdagi fe'lning V3 shakli — CORE 20 varag'ida (break – broke – broken). Qo'shimcha: har gapning savol shaklini ham ayting (Has Madina lost her phone?).

class_ex.title: been yoki gone
class_ex.instr: been / gone — to'g'risini tanlang
items: Ali isn't here. He has ___ to the market.
I have ___ to Samarkand three times.
Where's Mum? She has ___ out.
They have ___ to Turkey. They came back yesterday.
Sardor isn't at home. He has ___ to the stadium.
Have you ever ___ to Bukhara? — Yes, twice.

class_ex.title: Mini-vazifa: Have you ever…?
class_ex.instr: 1) Juftlikda: 5 ta "Have you ever…?" savol bering va javob bering (Yes, I have / No, I haven't; "ha" bo'lsa 1 tafsilot Past Simple bilan: I went there last summer). Keyin 2 ta Part 1 savoliga 45–60 soniya javob bering. 2) Sherigingiz haqida 5 gap yozing (has / hasn't + V3).
items: What have you done this week?
Have you ever been to another city?
Sherigingiz haqida 5 gap yozing (has / hasn't + V3).
answers: Namuna: This week I have done a lot. I have finished two tests and I have played football with my friends. I haven't watched TV much.
Namuna: Yes, I have. I have been to Samarkand twice. I went there last summer with my family and I saw the Registan.
Namuna: Jasur has been to Samarkand. He has never ridden a camel. He has lost his phone once. He hasn't won a prize. He has never broken a bone.
class_ex.note: Mezon: speaking_mini rubrikasi (og'zaki qism) va mini_writing rubrikasi (5 gap), 3 × 0–2. Yordam: box'dagi so'z juftlari (be / abroad → Have you ever been abroad?). Qo'shimcha: har "ha" javobiga Past Simple bilan 2 tafsilot (When? Who with?).

class_ex.title: ZAXIRA: Xatoni toping
class_ex.instr: Har gapda 1 xato — toping va tuzating
items: Mum has went to the shop.
She have seen this film.
We have visit Bukhara.
Has they finished?
I have seen him last week.
I have broke my phone.
answers: Mum has gone to the shop.

class_ex.title: Exit ticket
class_ex.instr: 3 daqiqa, yakka, qog'ozda.
items: Tanlang: Ali isn't here. He has (been / gone) to the bank.
To'ldiring: I ___ (not / finish) my homework yet.
O'zingiz gap tuzing: "Have you ever…?" savoli + qisqa javob.
answers: Namuna: Have you ever been to Bukhara? — Yes, I have. / No, I haven't.
class_ex.note: 3 dan 2 tasi to'g'ri — maqsadga erishildi.

Uyga vazifa: 3 majburiy band (~35 daq) + 2 qo'shimcha. Ovozli normativni keyingi darsdan oldin yuboring. Mashq to'plami keyingi darsning 'Uyga vazifa tekshiruvi' bosqichida kalit bilan tekshiriladi.

I ___ (never / eat) sushi.
___ you ___ (finish) your homework?
They ___ (not / buy) the tickets yet.

homework.title: MAJBURIY: Yozma ish — Mening haftam (~15 daq)
homework.instr: 8 gap, Present Perfect: bu hafta qilgan 4 ishingiz (tasdiq), qilmagan 3 ishingiz (inkor) va do'stingizga 1 ta "Have you ever…?" savoli.
answers: Namuna: This week I have cleaned my room. I have read two chapters of a book. I have helped my mum in the kitchen. I have played football twice. I haven't watched a film. I haven't bought new shoes. I haven't called my grandma yet. Have you ever cooked plov?

reading.title: Sardor Rashidov: what he has done
text: Sardor Rashidov is a football player from Uzbekistan. He has played for Bunyodkor and for clubs abroad, and he has played many games for the national team of Uzbekistan. In his career he has scored many goals, and his teams have won many matches. Fans have always liked his fast dribbling.
Has he ever had bad days? Of course he has. Like every player, he has lost games and he has made mistakes. But he has never stopped working.

In 2025 Uzbekistan qualified for the FIFA World Cup for the first time, and the whole country celebrated. Many young players in Uzbekistan have learned one thing from footballers like Rashidov: talent is not enough — you have to work every day.

tasks.title: Present Perfect toping
tasks.instr: Matndan 6 ta "has/have + V3" gapni toping va yozing
items: played (Bunyodkor)
scored
won
liked
made
learned
answers: He has played for Bunyodkor and for clubs abroad.
His teams have won many matches.
Fans have always liked his fast dribbling.
Many young players in Uzbekistan have learned one thing from footballers like Rashidov.

tasks.title: TRUE / FALSE / NOT GIVEN
tasks.instr: Do the following statements agree with the information in the text? Write TRUE, FALSE or NOT GIVEN.
items: Sardor Rashidov is a football player from Uzbekistan.
He has played for only one club.
He has never lost a game.
He has a younger brother who also plays football.
Uzbekistan qualified for the World Cup in 2025.

tasks.title: Present Perfect yoki Past Simple?
tasks.instr: Matndagi gaplar bo'yicha javob bering
items: "In 2025 Uzbekistan qualified for the FIFA World Cup." — Nega Past Simple?
"He has played for Bunyodkor." — Nega Present Perfect?
Has he ever played for a club abroad? — qisqa javob bering.
answers: Aniq vaqt bor — in 2025. Vaqt aytilsa → Past Simple.
Vaqt aytilmagan; muhim — hayotiy tajriba (natija hozir ham bor).

reading.book_ref: Jony Academy original matni; faktlar soddalashtirilgan, iqtiboslar yo'q.

kahoot.q: I ___ my key. I can't open the door now.
kahoot.explain: Natija hozir (eshikni ocholmayman) → have + V3; lose – lost – lost.

kahoot.q: My brother has never ___ sushi.
kahoot.explain: has + V3: eat – ate – EATEN.

kahoot.q: Qaysi gap TO'G'RI?
kahoot.explain: She → HAS; asosiy fe'l V3 shaklda: finished.

kahoot.q: Qaysi gapda XATO bor?
options: I have went to the market.
He has gone to the market.
We have bought a new car.
kahoot.explain: go – went – GONE: have + V3 → have gone. «have went» — xato.

kahoot.q: ___ you ever ___ to Samarkand?
kahoot.explain: Savol: Have + you + V3? «been to» = borib kelgan.

kahoot.q: Inkor shaklini tanlang: «We have finished the project.»
kahoot.explain: Inkor: haven't + V3; we → have.

kahoot.q: Has Aziz called you? — Yes, he ___.
kahoot.explain: Has…? savoliga qisqa javob: Yes, he has / No, he hasn't.

kahoot.q: Tarjima: «U hech qachon samolyotda uchmagan.»
options: She has never flown on a plane.
She has never flew on a plane.
She have never flown on a plane.
She hasn't never flown on a plane.
kahoot.explain: She → has; never has va V3 orasida; fly – flew – FLOWN. Ikki inkor (hasn't never) — xato.

kahoot.q: Ali isn't here. He ___ to London. He comes back next week.
kahoot.explain: Hali qaytmagan (hozir u yerda) → has gone to. «has been to» = borib kelgan.

kahoot.q: I ___ him yesterday at school.
kahoot.explain: «yesterday» — vaqt aniq → Present Perfect emas, Past Simple: saw.

kahoot.q: Qaysi holatda Present Perfect ishlatiladi?
options: O'tgan ish, natijasi hozir muhim, vaqti aytilmagan
kahoot.explain: Present Perfect — o'tgan ish, lekin natija HOZIR muhim; vaqt aytilmaydi.

kahoot.q: So'z tartibi: ever / you / have / eaten / plov?
kahoot.explain: Savol: Have + S + ever + V3? → Have you ever eaten plov?

kahoot.q: write – wrote – ___
kahoot.explain: write – wrote – WRITTEN (noto'g'ri fe'l).
buy (sotib olmoq) – bought – bought. «brought» — bring (olib kelmoq) fe'lidan.

kahoot.q: Oops! I have ___ my glass. There is water on the floor.
kahoot.explain: have + V3: break – broke – BROKEN (sindirmoq).

kahoot.q: Antonim: find (topmoq) ↔ ?
kahoot.explain: find – topmoq, lose – yo'qotmoq (lost – lost).

kahoot.q: Our team has ___ the match! We are the champions!
kahoot.explain: win (yutmoq) – won – WON.

kahoot.q: «tark etmoq; qoldirmoq» — qaysi fe'l?
kahoot.explain: leave – left – left = tark etmoq, qoldirmoq. live — yashamoq.

kahoot.q: Which verb is the SAME in V1, V2 and V3?
kahoot.explain: put – put – put. take – took – taken, give – gave – given, speak – spoke – spoken.

kahoot.q: I have ___ this book three times. I love it!
kahoot.explain: read – read – read: yozilishi bir xil, V2/V3 [red] deb o'qiladi.

lessons.title: Present Perfect vs Past Simple
lessons.grammar_topic: PRESENT PERFECT vs PAST SIMPLE (vaqt aniqmi — natijami?)
lessons.book_ref: Asosiy material — shu reja (formula jadvali, mashqlar, matn). Ixtiyoriy qo'shimcha: Student's book IELTS 2.0, Lesson 2 — dars kitobsiz ham to'liq o'tiladi.
objectives: Past Simple yoki Present Perfect'ni vaqt so'ziga qarab tanlaydi: 10 ta gapdan kamida 8 tasida to'g'ri.
Bir voqeani ikki zamonda ifodalaydi (I have lost my key → I lost it yesterday): 6 tadan kamida 4 tasi to'g'ri.
"Have you ever…?" savoliga Past Simple tafsilot bilan javob beradi (juftlikda 3 suhbat).
CORE 20 so'zni lug'at mashqidagi 6 gapdan kamida 5 tasida to'g'ri ishlatadi.
Kombinatsiya: 1 daqiqada 2 marta (normativ).
materials: Formula jadvali — rejaning Grammatika bo'limi (grammar.formulas), proyektor yoki doska
Birth (tug'ilish, chaqaloq) CORE 20 varag'i; 1-dars CORE 20 varag'i.
Kahoot: 'O'tgan dars Kahooti' tugmasi (1-dars savollari)
Mini-reading matni (reading) — proyektor.
timeline: Salomlashish + kirish savoli
"When did you come to Jony Academy?" (Past Simple) → "How many lessons have you had?" (Present Perfect). Ikkisi doskaga: qaysi birida vaqt bor?
Kahoot — 1-dars takrori: Present Perfect + Narrative verbs
'O'tgan dars Kahooti' tugmasi (1-dars Kahooti: 20 savol, har biriga 15 soniya). Bugungi dars Kahootini ochmang — u 3-dars boshida o'ynaladi.
YOZMA NORMATIV — 1-dars lug'ati: Narrative verbs (CORE 20)

Ustoz 20 so'zni o'zbekcha aytadi, o'quvchi inglizchasini yozadi — 5 daqiqa (1-dars CORE — fe'llar: ustoz o'zbekcha ma'nosini aytadi, o'quvchi V1–V2–V3 ni yozadi); 1 daqiqa juftlikda CORE varag'i bilan tekshirish. 18–20 to'g'ri — 2 coin.
Uyga vazifa tekshiruvi
1-dars Mashq to'plami: kalit proyektorda, juftlikda tekshirish; 2 ta umumiy xato doskada.
YANGI MAVZU — Present Perfect vs Past Simple

Formula jadvali (grammar.formulas): Past Simple — vaqt aniq (two minutes ago); Present Perfect — vaqt aytilmaydi, natija yoki tajriba hozir muhim. Juft gaplar yonma-yon, "When?" so'rab tekshiriladi; so'ng presentation juftlikda. + 3 CCQ (grammar.notes).
Birth (tug'ilish, chaqaloq) — CORE 20
Har so'z bilan juftlikda bitta Past Simple yoki Present Perfect gap (namuna — vocab.core). Nozik so'zlar — vocab.how eslatmasi.
Kombinatsiya

Kombinatsiya — o'quvchi bugungi formula jadvalini (tasdiq → inkor → savol, har qatorga 1 misol + o'zbekcha tarjima) yoddan, to'xtamasdan aytib chiqadi va 1 daqiqada necha marta to'liq aytgani sanaladi. Bugun: S + V2 + vaqt / S + didn't + V1 / Did + S + V1? / S + have/has + V3 / S + haven't/hasn't + V3 / Have/Has + S + V3? (I saw him yesterday. — Men uni kecha ko'rdim. / I have seen him. — Men uni ko'rganman.). Juftlikda: biri aytadi, biri sanaydi. 1 daqiqada 1 marta — warm-up, 2 marta — normativ, 3 marta — 2 coin.
Sinf mashqlari

Majburiy: Past Simple yoki Present Perfect? (7 daq, yakka), Ikki gap — bir voqea (6 daq, juftlik), Suhbat: tajriba → tafsilot (6 daq, juftlik), Lug'at: gapni to'ldiring (4 daq). ZAXIRA: Vaqt so'zini toping, Xatoni toping.
Mini-reading
Mini-reading: matn + T/F/NG + 2 savol.
Writing / speaking mini-vazifa
Mini-vazifa: My family story — 6 gap yozadi (7 daq), juftlikda 2 ta Part 1 savoliga og'zaki javob (5 daq).
Xatolar ustida ishlash + takror o'yini + exit ticket
3 ta ko'p uchragan xato doskada (3 daq). Takror o'yini (3 daq): ustoz vaqt so'zini aytadi (yesterday / ever / just / so far…), jamoalar mos zamonda gap tuzadi. Oxirgi 3 daqiqa — Exit ticket.
Uyga vazifa
3 majburiy band + 1 qo'shimcha (homework_intro).

intro: Past Simple: ish O'TGANDA bo'ldi va tugadi, VAQTI aniq (yesterday, ago, last…, in 2019, when I was…).
Present Perfect: ish o'tganda bo'ldi, lekin vaqt muhim emas; natija yoki tajriba HOZIR muhim (ever, never, just, already, yet, so far, today).
Suhbat qoidasi: birinchi savol Present Perfect ("Have you ever been to Dubai?"), tafsilot Past Simple ("When did you go? — I went in 2023").
formulas: I entered the room two minutes ago.
Have you ever…? → When did you…?
Have you ever been to Dubai? — Yes. — When did you go? — In 2023.
yesterday / last week / ago / in 2019 → Past Simple
today / this week / this year / so far → Present Perfect
She has called me twice today.
U bugun ikki marta qo'ng'iroq qildi.
I have lost my key. I can't get in.
presentation: Have you ever seen a newborn baby?
Yes, I have. I saw my cousin's baby last month.
When was your brother born?
He was born in 2015.
Has your aunt had her baby yet?
Yes, she has. She gave birth last week.
Did you visit them in hospital?
Yes, I visited them on Monday.
Have you ever been to a cradle ceremony (beshik to'yi)?
Yes, I have. I went to my cousin's cradle ceremony last spring.
What did you buy for the baby?
I bought a small blanket.
Have your parents chosen a name?
Yes, they have already chosen it.
Did the baby sleep well last night?
No, she cried all night.
Has the baby started walking?
Not yet. She has just started crawling.
When did you last hold a baby?
I held my nephew yesterday.
notes: "ago" faqat Past Simple bilan: two days ago — I met him two days ago.
"just / already / yet" — Present Perfect (British English).
"today / this week" — davr hali tugamagan → Present Perfect; "this morning" tushdan keyin aytilsa → Past Simple.
Savol "When…?" — har doim Past Simple ("When have you…?" bo'lmaydi).
CCQ: I have lost my key. — Do I have my key now? (No) — Do we know when I lost it? (No) — Is it important now? (Yes)
CCQ: I lost my key yesterday. — Do we know when? (Yes, yesterday) — Is that time finished? (Yes)
CCQ: Have you ever been to Samarkand? — Am I asking about the time? (No, about experience) — After "Yes", which question comes? (When did you go? — Past Simple)
mistakes: I lost my key, I can't get in.
I have lost my key. I can't get in.

reading.book_ref: Jony Academy original matni
reading.title: Aziz's baby sister
text: My name is Aziz. I am fifteen and I live in Namangan. Three weeks ago my mother gave birth to a baby girl. She was born on a Monday morning, five days before the due date. When the midwife said, "It's a girl!", my father cried with happiness.

My parents have named the baby Malika. Many relatives have visited the newborn, and everyone has said "Congratulations!" My grandmother has already sung her the same old lullaby many times. I held Malika on her second day at home.
I haven't slept well this week because the baby cries at night. But I have learned a lot. I can change a nappy now, and I often take care of her when Mum is tired. I want to watch my sister grow up.

tasks.title: TRUE / FALSE / NOT GIVEN
tasks.instr: Do the following statements agree with the information in the text? Write TRUE, FALSE or NOT GIVEN.
items: Malika was born after her due date.
Aziz's father cried when the baby was born.
Malika weighed three kilos at birth.
The parents have chosen a name for the baby.
Aziz has slept well this week.

tasks.title: Qisqa javob: When…? / Has…?
tasks.instr: Answer the questions.
items: When was Malika born?
Has Aziz learned anything new?
answers: She was born three weeks ago, on a Monday morning.
Yes, he has. He can change a nappy now.

lessons.title: Since vs For, Because + Present Perfect
lessons.grammar_topic: HOW LONG? SINCE vs FOR; BECAUSE + PRESENT PERFECT
lessons.book_ref: Asosiy material — shu reja (formula jadvali, mashqlar, matn). Ixtiyoriy qo'shimcha: Student's book IELTS 2.0, Lesson 3 — dars kitobsiz ham to'liq o'tiladi.
objectives: since (nuqta) / for (davr): 10 gapdan kamida 8 tasida to'g'ri tanlaydi.
"How long have/has … ?" savolini tuzadi: 7 dan kamida 5 tasi to'g'ri.
because + Present Perfect bilan sabab aytadi: 6 dan kamida 4 tasi to'g'ri.
Marriage CORE 20 dan kamida 5 so'z bilan "How long…?" gapi tuzadi.
Kombinatsiya (3 qator): 1 daqiqada 3 / 4 / 5 marta (warm-up / normativ / 2 coin).
materials: Formula jadvali — rejaning Grammatika bo'limi (grammar.formulas), proyektor yoki doska
Marriage (nikoh, to'y) CORE 20 varag'i.
Kahoot: 'O'tgan dars Kahooti' tugmasi (2-dars savollari)
timeline: Salomlashish + kirish savoli
"How long have you studied English?" — javoblar doskaga: "since 2024" / "for two years". Qaysi biri boshlanish nuqtasi, qaysi biri davomiylik?
Kahoot — 2-dars takrori: Present Perfect vs Past Simple + Birth
'O'tgan dars Kahooti' tugmasi (2-dars Kahooti: 20 savol, har biriga 15 soniya). Bugungi dars Kahootini ochmang — u 4-dars boshida o'ynaladi.
YOZMA NORMATIV — 2-dars lug'ati: Birth (CORE 20)
Ustoz 20 so'zni o'zbekcha aytadi, o'quvchi inglizchasini yozadi — 5 daqiqa; 1 daqiqa juftlikda CORE varag'i bilan tekshirish. 18–20 to'g'ri — 2 coin.
Uyga vazifa tekshiruvi
2-dars Mashq to'plami kaliti proyektorda: o'quvchi o'zi tekshiradi; 2 ta ko'p xato band doskada.
YANGI MAVZU — How long? Since vs For; Because + Present Perfect

Formula jadvali (grammar.formulas): SINCE + nuqta, FOR + davr, HOW LONG + have/has + S + V3?, BECAUSE + Present Perfect (natija hozir). presentation — juftlikda, mistakes — doskada. + 3 CCQ (grammar.notes).
Marriage (nikoh, to'y) — CORE 20
Talaffuz → tarjima → misol; 5–6 so'z bilan "How long…?" savoli (How long have they been married?). vocab.how dagi eslatmani o'qing.
Kombinatsiya

Kombinatsiya — o'quvchi bugungi formula jadvalini (tasdiq → inkor → savol, har qatorga 1 misol + o'zbekcha tarjima) yoddan, to'xtamasdan aytib chiqadi va 1 daqiqada necha marta to'liq aytgani sanaladi. Bugun: S + have/has + V3 + since/for / S + haven't/hasn't + V3 + since/for / How long + have/has + S + V3? Juftlikda: biri aytadi, biri sanaydi. 1 daqiqada 3 marta — warm-up, 4 marta — normativ, 5 marta — 2 coin.
Sinf mashqlari
Majburiy: since yoki for (6 daq, yakka), How long…? (6 daq, yakka), Because + Present Perfect (6 daq, juftlik), Karimovlar oilasi — How long…? (5 daq, juftlik, speaking). ZAXIRA: Lug'at: mos so'z.
Mini-reading
Matn: reading. 1-o'qish (3 daq): umumiy savol (tasks[0]). 2-o'qish (7 daq): TRUE / FALSE / NOT GIVEN + 2 ta "How long…?"; javoblar birga tekshiriladi.
Writing / speaking mini-vazifa
Mini-vazifa: How long…? survey (class_ex): 5 daq so'rovnoma, 5 daq — 6 gap yozma, 2 daq — juftlikda 2 ta Part 1 savoli.
Xatolar ustida ishlash + takror o'yini + exit ticket

3 daq: ko'p uchragan 3 xato doskada (since three years → for three years). 3 daq: takror o'yini "Since or For?" — ustoz vaqt ifodasini aytadi (2019, two weeks, my birthday…), guruhlar tez javob beradi. Oxirgi 3 daq: Exit ticket.
Uyga vazifa
3 majburiy band (~35 daq) + 1 qo'shimcha (tarjima) — homework_intro.

intro: SINCE — qachon boshlangan: since 2012, since Monday, since I was a child (nuqta).
FOR — qancha davom etgan: for 20 years, for two hours, for a long time (davr).
Ikkalasi ham ko'pincha Present Perfect bilan: ish o'tganda boshlangan, hozir ham davom etyapti.
BECAUSE + Present Perfect: hozirgi holatning sababi o'tgan ishda — "She can't go because she has caught a cold".
formulas: S + have/has + V3 + since + boshlanish nuqtasi
I have lived there for 20 years.
Men u yerda 20 yildan beri yashayman.

U bazmga bora olmaydi, chunki shamollab qolgan.
I haven't seen him since Monday.
It's two years since we got married.

notes: since + nuqta (yil, kun, soat, voqea); for + raqam + davr (days, weeks, years).
"since I was a child" — since'dan keyin butun gap Past Simple'da keladi.
"How long…?" ga javob: "for / since" bilan; "When…?" ga javob: Past Simple + vaqt.
because + Present Perfect — sabab hozir ta'sir qilyapti; because + Past Simple — sabab o'tgan, tugagan.
CCQ: I have lived here since 2020. — Do I live here now? (Yes) — 2020: point or period? (Point → since)
CCQ: They have been married for 20 years. — Are they married now? (Yes) — 20 years: point or period? (Period → for)
CCQ: She can't come because she has broken her leg. — Is her leg broken now? (Yes) — Past reason, present result? (Yes)
CCQ: How long have you known him? — Do you know him now? (Yes) — Start or length of time? (Length → for / since)
mistakes: I have lived here since three years.
I have lived here for three years.
How long do you know him?
How long have you known him?
She is happy because she passes the exam. (hozir)
She is happy because she has passed the exam.
Sabab o'tgan, natija hozir → Present Perfect.

kahoot.q: I have lived in Tashkent ___ 2015.
kahoot.explain: 2015 — boshlanish NUQTASI → since.

kahoot.q: My parents have been married ___ twenty years.
kahoot.explain: twenty years — DAVR → for.

kahoot.q: ___ have you known your best friend? — Since school.
kahoot.explain: Qancha vaqtdan beri? → How long + have/has + S + V3?

kahoot.q: Qaysi so'z SINCE bilan ishlatiladi?
kahoot.explain: since + nuqta (Monday, 2012). Davr (two hours, ten years) → for.

kahoot.q: Qaysi so'z FOR bilan ishlatiladi?
kahoot.explain: for + davr (three months). 2020, last summer — nuqta → since.

kahoot.q: Qaysi gapda XATO bor?
options: I have lived here since three years.
I have lived here for three years.
She has worked here for a long time.
kahoot.explain: three years — davr → for, since emas.

kahoot.q: She can't come to the wedding because she ___ a cold.
kahoot.explain: Hozirgi holat sababi o'tgan ishda → because + has + V3 (catch – caught – caught).

kahoot.q: How long ___ you ___ him? — Since 2018.
kahoot.explain: Hozir ham davom etyapti + since → Present Perfect: How long have you known…?

kahoot.q: Tarjima: «Men uni dushanbadan beri ko'rmaganman.»
options: I haven't seen him since Monday.
I haven't seen him for Monday.
I didn't see him since Monday.
I don't see him since Monday.
kahoot.explain: Inkor PP + since + nuqta: I haven't seen him since Monday.

kahoot.q: It's two years ___ we got married.
kahoot.explain: It's + davr + since + Past Simple: It's two years since we got married.

kahoot.q: I ___ here since 2020.
kahoot.explain: since/for bilan hozirgacha davom → Present Perfect: have lived.

kahoot.q: He is happy because he ___ a new job.
kahoot.explain: Hozir xursand — sababi: has + V3 (find – found – found).

kahoot.q: The woman getting married at a wedding is the ___.
kahoot.explain: bride — kelin, groom — kuyov, best man — kuyov jo'rasi, guest — mehmon.

kahoot.q: Collocation: to ___ married
kahoot.explain: get married — turmush qurmoq: They got married in 2019.

kahoot.q: A holiday that newlyweds take after the wedding is a ___.
kahoot.explain: honeymoon — asal oyi.

kahoot.q: He asked her to marry him. He ___ to her.
kahoot.explain: propose (to smb) — turmush taklif qilmoq.

kahoot.q: The day each year when you remember your wedding is an ___.
kahoot.explain: anniversary — (nikoh) yilligi.

kahoot.q: «in-laws» kimlar?
kahoot.explain: in-laws — qaynota-qaynona, turmush o'rtog'i oilasi. mother-in-law — qaynona.

kahoot.q: We sent 300 wedding ___ to our guests.
kahoot.explain: invitation — taklifnoma. vows — nikoh va'dasi, ring — uzuk, proposal — turmush taklifi.

kahoot.q: A husband or a wife is a ___.
kahoot.explain: spouse — juft (er yoki xotin). couple — er-xotin (ikkalasi).

reading.title: My grandparents' 40 years together
text: My grandparents, Rustam and Zuhra, got married in 1986. They have been married for forty years now. They met at a friend's wedding in Bukhara, and Grandpa proposed after six months.

They have lived in the same house since their wedding. Grandpa worked as a teacher for thirty years, and he has been retired since 2016. Grandma has cooked plov for the whole family every Friday since I was a baby.

This year the family is very happy because all the grandchildren have come home for the anniversary. We have planned a big dinner in their garden. Grandma says the secret of a long marriage is simple: respect and a lot of patience.

lessons.title: Yet, Still, Already, Just
lessons.grammar_topic: YET / STILL / ALREADY / JUST + PRESENT PERFECT
lessons.book_ref: Asosiy material — shu reja (formula jadvali, mashqlar, matn). Ixtiyoriy qo'shimcha: Student's book IELTS 2.0, Lesson 4 — dars kitobsiz ham to'liq o'tiladi.
objectives: yet / still / already / just ning ma'nosi va o'rni: 8 ta gapdan kamida 6 tasida to'g'ri so'zni tanlaydi.
O'z kunidan yet / still / already / just bilan 6 gap yozadi (Mini-vazifa: My to-do list).
Death CORE 20 so'zni taniydi; ta'ziyani hurmatli ohangda 3 ta ibora bilan bildiradi.
Mini-reading: T/F/NG ning 5 bandidan kamida 4 tasini to'g'ri bajaradi.
Kombinatsiya: 1 daqiqada 1 / 2 / 3 marta (warm-up / normativ / 2 coin).
materials: Formula jadvali — rejaning Grammatika bo'limi (grammar.formulas), proyektor yoki doska
Death (o'lim, motam — hurmat bilan) CORE 20 varag'i.
Kahoot: 'O'tgan dars Kahooti' tugmasi (3-dars savollari)
timeline: Salomlashish + kirish savoli
Ustoz: "Have you done your homework?" — javob variantlari doskada: "I have ALREADY done it" / "I haven't done it YET" / "I STILL haven't done it" / "I have JUST done it". Farqini his qildiring.
Kahoot — 3-dars takrori: Since vs For, Because + Present Perfect + Marriage
'O'tgan dars Kahooti' tugmasi (3-dars Kahooti: 20 savol, har biriga 15 soniya). Bugungi dars Kahootini ochmang — u 5-dars boshida o'ynaladi.
YOZMA NORMATIV — 3-dars lug'ati: Marriage (CORE 20)
Ustoz 20 so'zni o'zbekcha aytadi, o'quvchi inglizchasini yozadi — 5 daqiqa; 1 daqiqa juftlikda CORE varag'i bilan tekshirish. 18–20 to'g'ri — 2 coin.
Uyga vazifa tekshiruvi
3-dars Mashq to'plami kaliti proyektorda: o'quvchi daftarini o'zi tekshiradi; eng ko'p xato qilingan 2 band doskada.
YANGI MAVZU — Yet, still, already, just + Present Perfect

Formula jadvali (grammar.formulas): YET (inkor/savol, gap oxirida) → STILL (inkor, haven't/hasn't dan oldin) → ALREADY va JUST (have/has va V3 orasida). Har biriga 2 misol + tarjima; presentation juftlikda. + 3 CCQ (grammar.notes).
Death (o'lim, motam — hurmat bilan) — CORE 20
So'z → sinf takrori → misol gap (vocab.core); 5–6 so'z bilan yet/already/just gaplari. vocab.how dagi Ustozga eslatma.
Kombinatsiya

Kombinatsiya — o'quvchi bugungi formula jadvalini (tasdiq → inkor → savol, har qatorga 1 misol + o'zbekcha tarjima) yoddan, to'xtamasdan aytib chiqadi va 1 daqiqada necha marta to'liq aytgani sanaladi. Bugun: S + have/has + already/just + V3 / S + haven't/hasn't + V3 + yet / S + still + haven't/hasn't + V3 / Have/Has + S + V3 + yet? Juftlikda: biri aytadi, biri sanaydi. 1 daqiqada 1 marta — warm-up, 2 marta — normativ, 3 marta — 2 coin.
Sinf mashqlari

Majburiy: To'g'ri so'zni qo'ying (6 daq, yakka), ALREADY bilan javob (6 daq, juftlik), YET bilan davom ettiring (6 daq, yakka), Ta'ziya bildirish (5 daq, juftlik). ZAXIRA: So'z tartibi, Lug'at: ta'rif.
Mini-reading

Mini-reading "Kamola's busy Saturday": 1-o'qish — kim va nima qilyapti (2 daq); T/F/NG 5 band (4 daq, yakka); 2 savol + kalit bilan tekshirish (4 daq). Matnda yet/still/already/just ni tagiga chizdiring.
Writing / speaking mini-vazifa
Mini-vazifa: My to-do list — 7 daq yozma (6 gap), 5 daq juftlikda 2 ta Part 1 savoli (45–60 soniya). Mezon: mini_writing.
Xatolar ustida ishlash + takror o'yini + exit ticket
3 daq: eng ko'p uchragan 3 xato doskada. 3 daq: "Beep" o'yini — ustoz yet/still/already/just o'rniga "beep" deydi, jamoalar topadi. Oxirgi 3 daq: Exit ticket.
Uyga vazifa
Majburiy: Mashq to'plami, Mening kunim, Ta'ziya xati, Ovozli normativ; qo'shimcha: Tarjima.

intro: YET — "hali": inkor va savolda, GAP OXIRIDA.
STILL — "haligacha (kutilgan ish bo'lmadi)": inkorda, HAVE'DAN OLDIN (norozilik ohangi).
ALREADY — "allaqachon": tasdiqda, have va V3 ORASIDA.
JUST — "hozirgina": have va V3 ORASIDA. Misollar — formula jadvalida.
formulas: U hali hech narsa sotib olmadi.
Has John bought a new car yet?
Jon yangi mashina sotib oldimi hali?
presentation: Have you finished the book yet?
No, I haven't finished it yet.
Has the guest arrived yet?
Yes, he has just arrived.
Have you called your grandmother?
I still haven't called her. I'll do it tonight.
Has she sent her condolences?
Yes, she has already sent them.
Has the film started yet?
It has already started. Hurry up!
Have you told your parents the news?
Not yet. I still haven't found the right words.
notes: "already" savolda ham bo'ladi (hayrat): "Have you already finished?!" — "Shunchalik tez tugatdingmi?!"
"still" tasdiq gapda Present Simple/Continuous bilan boshqa ma'no: "I still live here" — hali ham yashayman.
O'lim mavzusi: ingliz tilida "pass away" (vafot etdi) "die"dan yumshoqroq; ta'ziya: "I'm sorry for your loss" / "My condolences".
CCQ: I have already eaten. — Is my meal finished? (Yes) — Did it happen sooner than someone expected? (Yes)
CCQ: She has just left. — Is she here now? (No) — Did she leave a long time ago? (No, a moment ago)
CCQ: I haven't called him yet. — Have I called him? (No) — Am I going to call him? (Yes, probably)

how: CORE 20 — motam so'zlari va ta'ziya iboralari. STRONG — B1, SUPER — B2 (kuchlilar uchun).
Ustozga eslatma: o'lim mavzusida shaxsiy savol berilmaydi, hazil qilinmaydi; yaqinini yo'qotgan o'quvchi bo'lsa ta'ziya mashqi yozma bajariladi. Misollarda faqat to'qima personajlar (Aziz, Kamola).

kahoot.q: I haven't finished my homework ___.
kahoot.explain: YET — inkor va savolda, GAP OXIRIDA: I haven't finished yet.

kahoot.q: She has ___ left. You missed her by one minute!
kahoot.explain: JUST — hozirgina: has + just + V3.

kahoot.q: Qaysi gap TO'G'RI?
kahoot.explain: ALREADY — have va V3 orasida: I have already done it.

kahoot.q: Has the bus arrived ___?
kahoot.explain: Savolda «hali?» → YET, gap oxirida: Has the bus arrived yet?

kahoot.q: Qaysi gapda XATO bor?
kahoot.explain: JUST have'dan KEYIN keladi: She has just left.

kahoot.q: I ___ called my grandmother. I feel bad!
kahoot.explain: STILL — inkorda, have'dan OLDIN: I still haven't called.

kahoot.q: So'z tartibi: has / just / the film / started
kahoot.explain: S + has + just + V3: The film has just started.

kahoot.q: Qaysi so'z inkor va savolda GAP OXIRIDA keladi?
kahoot.explain: YET — gap oxirida (inkor/savol). already, just — have va V3 orasida; still — have'dan oldin.

kahoot.q: Tarjima: «Men allaqachon oyligimni sarflab bo'ldim.»
options: I already spent my salary yet.
kahoot.explain: allaqachon = ALREADY, have va V3 orasida.

kahoot.q: «Siz hali tugatdingizmi?» — to'g'ri savolni tanlang.
kahoot.explain: Have + you + V3 + yet? — yet gap oxirida.

kahoot.q: What has he ___ done? — He has just gone out.
kahoot.explain: «Hozirgina nima qildi?» → What has he just done?

kahoot.q: ALREADY gapda qayerda turadi?
kahoot.explain: S + have/has + ALREADY + V3: I've already eaten.

kahoot.q: Her grandfather ___ away last year. We miss him.
kahoot.explain: pass away — olamdan o'tmoq (hurmatli ibora).

kahoot.q: A woman whose husband has died is a ___.
kahoot.explain: widow — beva ayol; widower — beva erkak.

kahoot.q: A child whose parents have died is an ___.
kahoot.explain: orphan — yetim.

kahoot.q: People bring flowers to the ___ in the cemetery.
kahoot.explain: grave — qabr. will — vasiyatnoma, heaven — jannat.

kahoot.q: We send our ___ to the family. (ta'ziya)
kahoot.explain: condolences — ta'ziya. congratulations — tabrik (xursandchilikda).

kahoot.q: Before he died, he wrote a ___ and left his house to his son.
kahoot.explain: will — vasiyatnoma. inherit — meros olmoq.

kahoot.q: «grief» ma'nosi?
kahoot.explain: grief — qayg'u, g'am. inheritance — meros, cemetery — qabriston, burial — dafn.

kahoot.explain: survive — omon qolmoq; survivor — omon qolgan odam.

reading.title: Kamola's busy Saturday
text: It is four o'clock on Saturday afternoon. Kamola is fifteen and she lives in Namangan. She has had a very busy day. She has already cleaned her room and washed the dishes. She has also helped her grandmother at the market.

But her list is not finished yet. Kamola still hasn't done her English homework, and her test is on Monday. Her friend Madina has just called. "Have you finished the reading task yet?" Madina asked. "No, not yet," Kamola said. "I've just come home!"
Now the house is quiet. Her little brother has already gone to the park with their dad. Kamola has made a cup of tea and opened her book. She hopes to finish everything before dinner.

lessons.title: Present Perfect Continuous
lessons.grammar_topic: PRESENT PERFECT CONTINUOUS (have/has been + V-ing)
lessons.book_ref: Asosiy material — shu reja (formula jadvali, mashqlar, matn). Ixtiyoriy qo'shimcha: Student's book IELTS 2.0, Lesson 5 — dars kitobsiz ham to'liq o'tiladi.
objectives: have/has been + V-ing qolipini tasdiq, inkor va savolda tuzadi: 8 ta gapdan kamida 6 tasini to'g'ri to'ldiradi.
"How long have you been …ing?" savolini tuzadi va for/since bilan to'liq javob beradi (5 savoldan kamida 4 tasi).
Tana a'zolari CORE 20 ni biladi va "My … has been hurting since/for …" qolipida 3 ta gap aytadi.
Reading: Makhachev matnidan PPC gaplarni topadi, T/F/NG da 5 dan 4.
Listening: shifokor dialogidan gap-fill'da 6 dan kamida 4 ta to'g'ri javob.
Kombinatsiya: 1 daqiqada 3 / 4 / 5 marta (warm-up / normativ / 2 coin).
materials: Formula jadvali — rejaning Grammatika bo'limi (grammar.formulas), proyektor yoki doska
Parts of the body (tana a'zolari) CORE 20 varag'i.
Kahoot: 'O'tgan dars Kahooti' tugmasi (4-dars savollari)
timeline: Salomlashish + kirish savoli
Ustoz vaziyat ko'rsatadi: "The ground is wet. It has been raining." Keyin o'quvchilar ustozdan so'raydi: "Why are you tired?" → "I have been working all day." Doskaga: have/has been + V-ing.
Kahoot — 4-dars takrori: Yet, Still, Already, Just + Death
'O'tgan dars Kahooti' tugmasi (4-dars Kahooti: 20 savol, har biriga 15 soniya). Bugungi dars Kahootini ochmang — u 6-dars boshida o'ynaladi.
YOZMA NORMATIV — 4-dars lug'ati: Death (CORE 20)
Ustoz 20 so'zni o'zbekcha aytadi, o'quvchi inglizchasini yozadi — 5 daqiqa; 1 daqiqa juftlikda CORE varag'i bilan tekshirish. 18–20 to'g'ri — 2 coin.
Uyga vazifa tekshiruvi
4-dars Mashq to'plami: kalit proyektorda, o'quvchilar daftarni almashtirib juftlikda belgilaydi; eng ko'p xato qilingan 2 band doskada tushuntiriladi.
YANGI MAVZU — Present Perfect Continuous

Formula jadvali (grammar.formulas): tasdiq S + have/has + been + V-ing → inkor haven't/hasn't been + V-ing → savol Have/Has + S + been + V-ing? → How long …? + for/since → iz (natija ko'rinadi). Har qatorga misol + tarjima; grammar.presentation savol-javoblari juftlikda. + 3 CCQ (grammar.notes).
Parts of the body (tana a'zolari) — CORE 20

TPR (3 daq): ustoz ko'rsatadi, o'quvchilar takrorlaydi — "Touch your elbow!". Keyin har so'z misol gapi bilan (vocab.core); 5 ta so'z bilan "My … has been hurting since/for …" og'zaki. Shaxsiy sog'liq haqida so'ralmaydi (vocab.how).
Kombinatsiya

Kombinatsiya — o'quvchi bugungi formula jadvalini (tasdiq → inkor → savol, har qatorga 1 misol + o'zbekcha tarjima) yoddan, to'xtamasdan aytib chiqadi va 1 daqiqada necha marta to'liq aytgani sanaladi. Bugun: S + have/has been + V-ing / S + haven't/hasn't been + V-ing / Have/Has + S + been + V-ing? Juftlikda: biri aytadi, biri sanaydi. 1 daqiqada 3 marta — warm-up, 4 marta — normativ, 5 marta — 2 coin.
Sinf mashqlari
Majburiy: have/has been + V-ing (6 daq, yakka), Iz — sabab (5 daq, yakka), How long…? (6 daq, juftlik), Mini-vazifa: At the doctor's (6 daq, juftlik). ZAXIRA: Tana a'zolari — TPR, Xatoni toping.
Reading
Islam Makhachev matni: o'qish + glossary (4 daq) → PPC gaplarni topish (3 daq) → TRUE / FALSE / NOT GIVEN (3 daq) → tana a'zolari savoli (2 daq).
Listening
Ustoz transcript'ni 2 marta o'qiydi: 1-marta gist savol, 2-marta topshiriqlar; javoblar birga tekshiriladi.
Xatolar ustida ishlash + exit ticket
6 daqiqa: darsdagi ko'p uchragan xatolar doskada (been + V-ing, holat fe'llari, since bilan PPC); STRONG lug'at — kuchlilarga (+1 coin). Oxirgi 3 daqiqa: Exit ticket (class_ex oxirida).
Uyga vazifa
Mashq to'plami (12 band), "Mening haftam" yozma ishi, ovozli normativ (CORE 20) — majburiy; tarjima — qo'shimcha. Ovozli normativ 6-darsgacha yuboriladi.

intro: Present Perfect Continuous — ish o'tganda boshlangan va HOZIRGACHA davom etyapti (yoki hozirgina to'xtadi, izi ko'rinadi).
Urg'u — jarayon va davomiylik: "I have been waiting for two hours" (2 soatdan beri kutyapman).
Present Perfect esa natijaga urg'u beradi: "I have waited" (kutdim — tugadi). Farqi 6-darsda chuqur o'rganiladi.
Holat fe'llari (know, like, have=ega bo'lmoq, be) continuous'da ishlatilmaydi: "I have known him" (has been knowing — xato).
formulas: She hasn't been singing for a long time.
Have you been watching the games?
How long + have/has + S + been + V-ing?
How long have you been learning English?
… been + V-ing + for davr / since nuqta
It has been raining since morning.
I'm tired because I've been running.
presentation: How long have you been learning English?
I have been learning English for two years.
Why are your eyes red?
Because I have been reading all night.
Has it been raining?
Yes, it has been raining since morning.
How long has your leg been hurting?
It has been hurting for three days.
What have you been doing?
I have been cleaning the house.
Have you been waiting long?
No, I have only been waiting for five minutes.
Why is your hair wet?
I have been swimming.
How long has she been working here?
She has been working here since 2021.
Have they been playing football?
Yes, they have been playing all afternoon.
Why does your back hurt?
Because I have been sitting at the computer all day.
notes: for + davr, since + nuqta — 3-dars qoidasi shu yerda ham.
Holat fe'llari (know, believe, own, love) — Present Perfect Simple: "I have known her for years".
"all day / all morning / lately / recently" — Present Perfect Continuous bilan tez-tez keladi.
Tana a'zolari bilan: "My head has been aching" = "I have had a headache".
CCQ: I have been waiting for two hours. — Did I start in the past? (Yes) — Am I still waiting now? (Yes) — Is the focus on 'how long'? (Yes)
CCQ: Her eyes are red. She has been crying. — Is she crying right now? (Not necessarily) — Can we see the result? (Yes — red eyes)
CCQ: It has been raining since 8 o'clock. — When did it start? (At 8) — Is it raining now? (Yes)
CCQ: I have known him for years. — Why not 'have been knowing'? (know — holat fe'li, continuous'da ishlatilmaydi)
mistakes: I have been knowing him for years.
I have known him for years.
She has been work all day.
She has been working all day.
How long have you been waiting?
It has been raining since morning.

how: CORE 20 — bosh, yuz, bo'yin va qo'l (yelkadan bilakkacha); STRONG — qo'l panjasi, tana va oyoq; SUPER — ichki a'zolar va qo'shimcha so'zlar.
Ustoz ko'rsatib aytadi (TPR): "Touch your elbow!" — tez o'yin 2 daqiqa. Har so'z bilan "My … has been hurting since …".

Ustozga eslatma: tana — nozik mavzu. So'zlar faqat tanishtiriladi; o'quvchilarning tanasi, vazni yoki tashqi ko'rinishi haqida gapirilmaydi va sinfdoshlar solishtirilmaydi. "My … has been hurting" gaplari to'qima personaj (Jasur, Tom) yoki sport vaziyati nomidan aytiladi; o'quvchidan shaxsiy kasalligi so'ralmaydi.

reading.title: Islam Makhachev — years of hard work
text: Islam Makhachev was born in 1991 in Dagestan, Russia. He started wrestling and sambo as a boy. He and Khabib Nurmagomedov have known each other for many years — they trained in the same gym, and Khabib's father was their coach.
Islam had his first UFC fight in 2015. In 2022 he became the UFC lightweight champion, and in 2024 he defended his title. Many fans have been calling him one of the best fighters in the world.

Life as a fighter is hard on the body. Imagine a fighter who has been running in the mountains all morning: his legs are tired, but in the afternoon he still has to wrestle for two hours. Many fighters who have been training for a long time have pain in their knees, shoulders or backs.

Young people in many countries, including Uzbekistan, have been watching Islam's fights for years. Aziz, 15, from Namangan, has been going to a wrestling club since September. "I've been training three times a week," he says. "My arms have been hurting, but I feel stronger."

transcript: Doctor: Good morning, Jasur. Sit down, please. What's the problem?
Jasur: Good morning, doctor. My head has been aching for three days, and my nose has been running since Sunday.
Doctor: I see. Have you been sleeping well?
Jasur: Not really. I've been studying for my exams, so I've been going to bed at two o'clock.
Doctor: How long have you been studying like this?
Jasur: For about two weeks. My eyes have been hurting too, and my neck is stiff.

Doctor: You've been sitting at the computer for too long. Open your mouth, please. Your throat is a little red, but it's nothing serious. Drink warm tea and take a break every forty minutes. And sleep for eight hours!
Jasur: Thank you, doctor. Should I come back?
Doctor: Yes, come back on Friday.

lessons.title: Present Perfect vs Present Perfect Continuous
lessons.grammar_topic: PRESENT PERFECT vs PRESENT PERFECT CONTINUOUS (natija — jarayon)
lessons.book_ref: Asosiy material — shu reja (formula jadvali, mashqlar, matn). Ixtiyoriy qo'shimcha: Student's book IELTS 2.0, Lesson 6 — dars kitobsiz ham to'liq o'tiladi.
objectives: PP (natija, How many?, tugagan ish) va PPC (jarayon, How long?, davom etayotgan ish) farqini 3 ta CCQ ga to'g'ri javob berib ko'rsatadi.
'PP yoki PPC — tanlang' mashqidagi 10 gapdan kamida 8 tasida zamonni to'g'ri tanlaydi.
Kiyim CORE 20 so'zlari bilan Mini-vazifada 45–60 soniya gapiradi (kamida 2 PP + 2 PPC gap).
Reading: TRUE / FALSE / NOT GIVEN ning 5 bandidan kamida 4 tasini to'g'ri belgilaydi.
Kombinatsiya: 6 qatorli jadvalni 1 daqiqada kamida 2 marta aytadi (normativ).
materials: Formula jadvali — rejaning Grammatika bo'limi (grammar.formulas), proyektor yoki doska
Clothes (kiyimlar) CORE 20 varag'i.
Kahoot: 'O'tgan dars Kahooti' tugmasi (5-dars savollari)
timeline: Salomlashish + kirish savoli
Ustoz doskaga ikki gap yozadi: "You've cleaned your shoes! They look new." va "I've been cleaning shoes — look at my hands!" Savol: qaysi birida NATIJA, qaysi birida JARAYON?
Kahoot — 5-dars takrori: Present Perfect Continuous + Parts of the body
'O'tgan dars Kahooti' tugmasi (5-dars Kahooti: 20 savol, har biriga 15 soniya). Bugungi dars Kahootini ochmang — u 7-dars boshida o'ynaladi.
YOZMA NORMATIV — 5-dars lug'ati: Parts of the body (CORE 20)
Ustoz 20 so'zni o'zbekcha aytadi, o'quvchi inglizchasini yozadi — 5 daqiqa; 1 daqiqa juftlikda CORE varag'i bilan tekshirish. 18–20 to'g'ri — 2 coin.
Uyga vazifa tekshiruvi
5-dars Mashq to'plami kaliti proyektorda, juftlikda tekshiriladi; eng ko'p xato qilingan 2 band doskada.
YANGI MAVZU — Present Perfect vs Present Perfect Continuous

Formula jadvali (grammar.formulas): PP va PPC (+ / − / ?). Keyin 3 farq (grammar.intro): natija — jarayon; How many? — How long?; tugagan — davom etayotgan. Juftlar doskada yonma-yon, o'quvchi o'zi juft tuzadi; presentation juftlikda. + 3 CCQ (grammar.notes).
Clothes (kiyimlar) — CORE 20
Ustoz so'zni aytadi, o'quvchilar takrorlaydi; har o'quvchi 2–3 so'z bilan "I've been wearing … since …" yoki "I've bought …" gapini aytadi.
Kombinatsiya

Kombinatsiya — o'quvchi bugungi formula jadvalini (tasdiq → inkor → savol, har qatorga 1 misol + o'zbekcha tarjima) yoddan, to'xtamasdan aytib chiqadi va 1 daqiqada necha marta to'liq aytgani sanaladi. Bugun: S + have/has + V3 / haven't + V3 / Have + S + V3? / S + have/has been + V-ing / haven't been + V-ing / Have + S + been + V-ing? Juftlikda: biri aytadi, biri sanaydi. 1 daqiqada 1 marta — warm-up, 2 marta — normativ, 3 marta — 2 coin.
Sinf mashqlari

Majburiy: PP yoki PPC — tanlang (6 daq, yakka), Fe'lni to'g'ri shaklda (5 daq, yakka), How many / How long (5 daq, juftlik), Mini-vazifa: Kiyimlar haqida gapiring (7 daq, juftlik). ZAXIRA: Do'konda, Xatoni toping.
Reading
Matn: 1-o'qish — umumiy mazmun; keyin PP/PPC ajratish, TRUE / FALSE / NOT GIVEN (5 band), 2 qisqa savol.
Listening
Ustoz transcript'ni 2 marta o'qiydi: 1-marta gist savol, 2-marta topshiriqlar; javoblar birga tekshiriladi.
Xatolar ustida ishlash + exit ticket
Ko'p uchragan 3–4 xato doskada (grammar.mistakes). Oxirgi 3 daqiqa — Exit ticket. ZAXIRA mashqlar — kuchlilarga.
Uyga vazifa
Mashq to'plami, yozma ish, ovozli normativ, Progress Test 1 ga tayyorgarlik; qo'shimcha — tarjima. Test — 7-dars boshida.

intro: PRESENT PERFECT — NATIJA: "You've washed my shirt! It looks new." (ko'ylak toza — natija ko'rinadi).
PRESENT PERFECT CONTINUOUS — JARAYON va DAVOMIYLIK: "I've been ironing clothes all morning. I'm tired."
"How many?" → Present Perfect ("She's read ten books this summer"); "How long?" → PPC ("She's been reading that book all day").
Tugagan ish → PP ("I've written you an email"); davom etishi mumkin → PPC ("I've been writing emails").
Holat fe'llari (know, have, be, like) — faqat PP.
formulas: I've bought three T-shirts this week.
Men bu hafta uchta futbolka sotib oldim.
She hasn't found a dress for the wedding yet.
U to'y uchun hali ko'ylak topmadi.

presentation: What have you been doing? Your hands are dirty.

How long have you been wearing that jacket?

Have you ever worn a suit?

notes: Natija/son → PP; davomiylik/"all day"/"how long" → PPC.
live / work / study / teach — ikkalasi ham bo'ladi: "I've lived here for 5 years" = "I've been living here for 5 years".
PPC ba'zan norozilik: "Who's been eating my chocolate?!"
Progress Test 1 (7-dars boshida, 40 daqiqa; 1–6-darslar): A Grammatika 30 · B Lug'at 20 · C Tarjima 10 · D Reading 20 · E Writing 20 = 100 ball.
CCQ: I've painted my room. — Is the job finished? (Yes) — Can we see the result now? (Yes)
CCQ: I've been painting my room. — Are we talking about the activity or the result? (The activity) — Why are my clothes dirty? (Because I've been painting)
CCQ: She's read three books. / She's been reading for three hours. — Which sentence tells us how many? (The first) — Which tells us how long? (The second)
CCQ: I've had this coat for years. — Can we say "I've been having this coat"? (No — have = ega bo'lmoq, holat fe'li → PP)
mistakes: She's been reading for two hours.
How many pages have you been writing?
How many pages have you written?
I've been having this coat for years.
I've had this coat for years.
Who has eaten my chocolate? (yarmi qolgan)

class_ex.title: Mini-vazifa: Kiyimlar haqida gapiring (IELTS Part 1)
class_ex.instr: Juftlikda: har savolga 45–60 soniya javob bering — kamida 2 PP va 2 PPC gap. Sherik sanaydi, keyin almashasiz.
items: What kind of clothes do you usually wear at weekends?

homework_intro: Normativ — belgilangan vaqt ichida bajariladigan o'lchovli me'yor (lug'at yoki formula); me'yorni bajargan o'quvchi rejadagi coin'ni oladi.

Uyga vazifa: 4 majburiy band (~45 daq) + 1 qo'shimcha. Ovozli normativni 7-darsdan oldin yuboring. 7-dars — test darsi: Mashq to'plami daftarda ustozga topshiriladi, ustoz kalit bilan tekshirib qaytaradi.

homework.title: MAJBURIY: Yozma ish — Mening kiyimlarim (~10 daq)
homework.instr: 6–8 gap: 3–4 ta PP (I've bought / I've worn … times), 3–4 ta PPC (I've been wearing … since / for …). Kamida 5 ta CORE kiyim so'zi.
answers: Namuna: This year I've bought two T-shirts and a new jacket. I've worn the jacket five times. I've been wearing my old trainers since last summer. My sister has been looking for a wedding dress for a week — she has tried on ten dresses! I've never worn a tie.
Mezon: mini_writing rubrikasi (3 × 0–2) — PP/PPC tanlovi to'g'ri, 6–8 gap, kamida 5 ta CORE so'z.

homework.answers: Mezon: 20 so'zdan kamida 18 tasi to'g'ri talaffuz va tarjima bilan, 1.5 daqiqada

homework.title: MAJBURIY: Progress Test 1 ga tayyorgarlik (~20 daq)
homework.instr: Test 7-dars boshida, 40 daqiqa, 1–6-darslar. Formulalarni (box) va CORE 20 varaqlarini takrorlang, har bo'limdan bitta namuna savolni bajaring.
box: 1-dars: S + have/has + V3; ever / never; been to — gone to
2-dars: Present Perfect (vaqt aytilmaydi) vs Past Simple (aniq vaqt: yesterday, in 2020)
3-dars: How long? — since + nuqta / for + davr; because + Present Perfect
4-dars: yet (inkor/savol oxirida), still (haven't oldida), already / just (have va V3 orasida)
5-dars: S + have/has + been + V-ing (jarayon, How long?)
6-dars: PP (natija, How many?) vs PPC (jarayon, How long?); holat fe'llari — faqat PP
Lug'at: Narrative verbs, Birth, Marriage, Death, Parts of the body, Clothes — CORE 20
items: A (Grammatika) — tanlang: We have lived in this flat ___ 2019. (since / for / already)
B (Lug'at) — inglizchasini yozing: shortik
C (Tarjima) — inglizchaga: «Men bu filmni allaqachon ko'rganman.»
D (Reading) — "Lola has been working at a clothes shop for three years. She has sold hundreds of dresses." TRUE / FALSE / NOT GIVEN: Lola started working at the shop last month.
E (Writing) — 50–60 so'z: Clothes and shopping in my family. Present Perfect, Present Perfect Continuous, yet / already ishlating.
answers: I have already seen this film. / I've already seen this film.

Namuna (54 so'z): My family has been busy with shopping lately. My brother has already bought a new suit for his friend's wedding. My mum has been looking for a warm coat since October, but she hasn't found one yet. I've been wearing my old hoodie all week because it's cold. I haven't bought new trainers yet. Mezon: writing_a2 rubrikasi (4 × 0–5); PPC yoki yet / already bo'lmasa — 'Topshiriqni bajarish' 3 balldan, 'Grammatika' 4 balldan oshmaydi.

reading.title: Hasanboy Dusmatov and a young boxer from Andijan
text: Hasanboy Dusmatov is a boxer from Uzbekistan. He was born in 1993 in Andijan. He is not a big man — he fights in one of the lightest divisions in boxing — but he has become a very well-known sportsman in his country.

In 2016, at the Olympic Games in Rio, he won a gold medal. He also received the Val Barker Trophy — a special prize for the best boxer of the tournament. In 2024, in Paris, he won his second Olympic gold medal.

Aziz is 15, and he lives in Andijan too. He has been training at a boxing club for two years. "I've watched Hasanboy's Olympic fights many times," he says. Aziz has been wearing the same training clothes since he started: a grey T-shirt, black shorts and old trainers. His mum has bought him new boxing gloves twice, because he has been training so hard.
Today Aziz's arms are tired. He has been hitting the bag all afternoon. "I haven't won a medal yet," he says, "but I have learned a lot."
glossary: hit the bag — qopni (boks qopini) urmoq

tasks.title: 2-tinglash: raqam va kiyim
tasks.instr: Write ONE WORD AND/OR A NUMBER for each answer.
items: Timur has been looking for a coat for ___ weeks.
Coats and jackets are ___ percent cheaper.
Boots have been half price since ___.
You can take a maximum of ___ items into the changing room.
Buy two sweaters and get a ___ free.

transcript: Malika: Good afternoon! Welcome to our winter sale. Can I help you?
Timur: Yes, please. I've been looking for a warm coat for two weeks, but I haven't found one yet.
Malika: Well, you're lucky. We've reduced the price of all coats and jackets by forty percent.
Timur: Great! And what about boots? My old ones have been hurting my feet all winter.
Malika: We've been selling boots for half price since Saturday. Only a few pairs are left.
Timur: OK. Can I try on this coat, please?
Malika: Of course. The changing rooms are over there, but they've been very busy all day, so please take a maximum of three items.
Timur: No problem. Oh, and I need a scarf and some gloves too.
Malika: Today only, if you buy two sweaters, you get a scarf free.
Timur: Perfect! I've already chosen two sweaters.

lessons.title: Comparative Degree
lessons.grammar_topic: COMPARATIVE (-er than / more … than / as … as)
lessons.book_ref: Asosiy material — shu reja (formula jadvali, mashqlar, matn). Ixtiyoriy qo'shimcha: Student's book IELTS 2.0, Lesson 7 — dars kitobsiz ham to'liq o'tiladi.
objectives: Progress Test 1 (1–6-darslar) ni 40 daqiqada yakka yozadi; tahlilda o'z xatolarini belgilaydi.
Qisqa sifatlarga -er, uzunlariga more qo'shib than bilan taqqoslaydi: 10 ta gapdan kamida 8 tasida to'g'ri shakl yozadi.
as … as / not as … as bilan tenglik va farqni aytadi: 5 ta gapdan kamida 4 tasini to'g'ri qayta yozadi.
Jadval bo'yicha 6 ta taqqoslash gapidan kamida 5 tasini to'g'ri tuzadi; good → better, bad → worse istisnolarini va much / a bit ni to'g'ri ishlatadi.
Tashqi ko'rinish CORE 20 dan kamida 5 so'z bilan to'qima personajlarni taqqoslovchi gap aytadi (masalan, James is heavier than Miss Bennet).
Kombinatsiya: comparative jadvalini (tasdiq → inkor → savol) 1 daqiqada kamida 4 marta aytadi (normativ).
materials: Formula jadvali — rejaning Grammatika bo'limi (grammar.formulas), proyektor yoki doska
Physical appearance (tashqi ko'rinish) CORE 20 varag'i.
Kahoot: 'O'tgan dars Kahooti' tugmasi (6-dars savollari)
Progress Test 1 varag'i (A/B variant) va kaliti — test paketi 'pt1'
timeline: Salomlashish + test yo'riqnomasi
Salomlashish (1 daq). Yo'riqnoma (2 daq): telefonlar yig'iladi, partalar ajratiladi; varaqlar A/B variantda; 40 daqiqa, 5 bo'lim (A–E); javob faqat varaqqa, ruchka bilan; savol bo'lsa qo'l ko'taring.
Kahoot — 6-dars takrori: Present Perfect vs Present Perfect Continuous + Clothes
'O'tgan dars Kahooti' tugmasi (6-dars Kahooti: 20 savol, har biriga 15 soniya). Bugungi dars Kahootini ochmang — u 8-dars boshida o'ynaladi.
TEST — Progress Test 1 (1–6-darslar)

40 daqiqa, yakka, qog'ozda. Varaq: test paketi 'pt1' (A/B variant — qo'shni partalarga har xil); kalit faqat ustozda. Bo'limlar: A Grammatika 30 · B Lug'at 20 · C Tarjima 10 · D Reading 20 · E Writing 20 = 100 ball. Vaqt: A 10 · B 5 · C 5 · D 10 · E 10 daqiqa.
TEST TAHLILI — Progress Test 1

Varaqlar va qoralamalar yig'ilgach: kalit proyektorga CHIQARILMAYDI va o'qib berilmaydi (qayta topshirishda boshqa variant yoziladi). Varaqlarni tez ko'zdan kechirib, eng ko'p uchragan 3–5 xato turini (been/gone, ago + Past Simple, since/for, yet/already o'rni) doskada test savolining o'zi bilan emas, YANGI misol bilan tushuntiring. A–C shu kuni, D–E 2 kun ichida tekshiriladi; o'tish qoidasi test paketida.
YANGI MAVZU — Comparative (-er than / more … than / as … as)

Formula jadvali (grammar.formulas): 1 bo'g'in → adj-er + than; 2+ bo'g'in → more + adj + than; teng → as + adj + as, teng emas → not as + adj + as; istisno good → better, bad → worse, far → further; much / a bit + comparative. Warm-up: proyektorda ikki shahar (Tashkent / Samarkand) yoki jadvaldagi to'qima personajlar (Tina / James) — "Which is bigger? Who is taller?"; sinfdoshlar taqqoslanmaydi. Presentation'dan 3 juftlikni ustoz modellaydi, qolgani juftlikda savol-javob zanjiri. + 3 CCQ (grammar.notes).
Physical appearance (tashqi ko'rinish) — CORE 20
Ustoz aytadi, sinf takrorlaydi + tarjima (har so'zga ~20 soniya); 5–6 so'z bilan comparative gap (vocab.core misollari). Faqat to'qima personajlar — vocab.how dagi eslatma.
Kombinatsiya

Kombinatsiya — o'quvchi bugungi formula jadvalini (tasdiq → inkor → savol, har qatorga 1 misol + o'zbekcha tarjima) yoddan, to'xtamasdan aytib chiqadi va 1 daqiqada necha marta to'liq aytgani sanaladi. Bugun: S + be + adj-er / more + adj + than / S + be + not as + adj + as / Be + S + adj-er / more + adj + than …? (Tom is taller than Ali. — Ali isn't as tall as Tom. — Is Tom taller than Ali?). Juftlikda: biri aytadi, biri sanaydi. 1 daqiqada 3 marta — warm-up, 4 marta — normativ, 5 marta — 2 coin.
Sinf mashqlari

Majburiy: Comparative yozing (7 daq, yakka), as … as (5 daq, juftlik), Jadval bo'yicha taqqoslang (8 daq, yakka + juftlikda tekshirish). ZAXIRA: Odamni tasvirlang, Ikki personajni taqqoslang, Xatoni toping.
Xatolar ustida ishlash + exit ticket
Ko'p uchragan xatolar doskada (more tall, taller that, as taller as, very taller) — 4 daqiqa; oxirgi 3 daqiqa: Exit ticket (class_ex oxirida), yakka, varaqqa.
Uyga vazifa
Test darsi bo'lgani uchun Reading va mini-vazifa uyga o'tadi: MAJBURIY — Mashq to'plami, Reading, Mini-vazifa, Ovozli normativ (~42 daq); QO'SHIMCHA — Tarjima.

intro: Bir bo'g'inli sifat: tall → taller than; big → bigger (undosh ikkilanadi); nice → nicer.
Ikki va undan ko'p bo'g'in: more difficult than, more beautiful than. -y bilan tugagan: happy → happier, easy → easier.
Istisno: good → better, bad → worse, far → further, little → less, much/many → more.
Tenglik: as tall as; farq: not as tall as (= shorter than). Kuchaytirish: much taller, a bit taller, far more expensive.
formulas: Your house is bigger than ours.
Maths is more difficult than English.
X + be + as + adj + as + Y
My house is as old as your house.
X + be + not as + adj + as + Y
A lemon isn't as sweet as an orange.
My English is better than yours.
much / a lot / a bit + comparative
He is much taller than his brother.
presentation: Who is taller, you or your brother?
My brother is taller than me.
Is English more difficult than maths?
No, maths is more difficult than English.
Is your sister as tall as you?
Yes, she is as tall as me.
Which is bigger, Tashkent or Samarkand?
Tashkent is much bigger than Samarkand.
Is Tina older than Miss Bennet?
No, Tina is younger than Miss Bennet.
Who is more talkative in your family?
My mum is more talkative than my dad.
Is winter colder than autumn?
Yes, winter is much colder.
Is this phone better than the old one?
Yes, it's better and faster.
Is a bus as fast as a car?
No, a bus isn't as fast as a car.
Which city is further from Tashkent, Bukhara or Khiva?
Khiva is further from Tashkent than Bukhara.
notes: "than" dan keyin: than me / than I am — ikkalasi ham to'g'ri; og'zaki nutqda "than me".
Ikki bo'g'inli, -y/-er/-ow/-le bilan tugaganlar -er oladi: happier, cleverer, narrower, simpler.
"as … as" inkori — "not as … as" yoki "not so … as".
Tashqi ko'rinishni tasvirlash: He is tall and slim, with short dark hair. Taqqoslash: She looks younger than her sister.
CCQ: Tom is taller than Ali. — Are Tom and Ali the same height? (No) — Who is taller? (Tom) — Is Ali taller? (No)
CCQ: Ali isn't as tall as Tom. — Is Ali taller than Tom? (No) — Is Ali shorter? (Yes)
CCQ: Tina is as old as Aziza. — Is one of them older? (No) — Are they the same age? (Yes)
mistakes: She is more tall than me.
She is as taller as me.
She is as tall as me.

how: CORE 20 — tashqi ko'rinish (chiroy, soch, qomat); STRONG — soch, yuz, uslub; SUPER — iboralar (have a … nose).
Har so'zga taqqoslash: "X is more attractive than Y" / "X is as slim as Y" — to'qima personajlar (Tina, James, Miss Bennet) bilan. good-looking → better-looking.

Ustozga eslatma: skinny, plump, overweight, bald, heavy — faqat tanishtiriladi va to'qima personajlar tasvirida ishlatiladi; sinfdoshlarga nisbatan ishlatilmaydi, o'quvchilarning tashqi ko'rinishi haqida shaxsiy savol berilmaydi va ular solishtirilmaydi.

normativ: Normativ — belgilangan vaqt ichida bajariladigan o'lchovli me'yor (lug'at yoki formula); me'yorni bajargan o'quvchi rejadagi coin'ni oladi.
Ovozli (uyda): CORE 20 so'z + tarjima, 1.5 daqiqa — 1 coin.
Yozma (8-dars boshida): CORE 20, o'zbekchadan inglizchaga, 5 daqiqa, kamida 18 to'g'ri — 2 coin. STRONG 20 — ixtiyoriy, kuchlilar uchun +1 coin.

class_ex.title: Progress Test 1 (1–6-darslar): ustoz uchun o'tkazish tartibi va ball jadvali
class_ex.instr: Test 7-dars boshida, Kahootdan keyin yoziladi: 40 daqiqa, yakka, qog'ozda. Keyin shu darsning o'zida 10 daqiqalik TEST TAHLILI.
items: 1. Darsdan oldin: A va B variantni teng sonda chop eting — har o'quvchiga 1 varaq, qo'shni partalarga har xil variant. Kalit, ball varag'i va rubrika faqat ustozda. Proyektorga faqat o'quvchi yo'riqnomasi va taymer chiqariladi — savollar va kalit test paytida proyektorga CHIQARILMAYDI.
2. Salomlashish (3 daq): o'quvchi yo'riqnomasini proyektorda ko'rsatib, ovoz chiqarib o'qing. Telefon, lug'at va daftarlar sumkaga; partada faqat ruchka va bitta toza qoralama varaq.
3. Kahoot (6-dars savollari, 8 daq) — isinish. So'ng varaqlarni yuzini pastga qilib tarqating; o'quvchi ism-familiya, guruh, sana va variant harfini yozadi.

4. TEST (40 daq): 'Start' deb taymerni yoqing. Tavsiya etilgan vaqt: A Grammatika 10 · B Lug'at 5 · C Tarjima 5 · D Reading 10 · E Writing 10 daqiqa. 10-, 15-, 20-, 30-daqiqalarda keyingi bo'limga o'tishni ovoz chiqarib eslating; 35-daqiqada '5 daqiqa qoldi' deng. Savolga javob tushuntirilmaydi — faqat topshiriq shartini qayta o'qib berasiz.
5. 40-daqiqada test varaqlari ham, qoralama varaqlar ham yig'iladi — o'quvchida test savollari va javoblari qolmaydi.

6. TEST TAHLILI (10 daq): kalit proyektorga CHIQARILMAYDI va o'qib berilmaydi (qayta topshirishda boshqa variant yoziladi — javoblar oldindan ma'lum bo'lmasin). Varaqlarni tezda ko'zdan kechirib, eng ko'p uchragan 3–5 xato turini doskada tushuntiring (odatda: been/gone, ago bilan Past Simple, since/for, yet/already o'rni) — test savolining o'zini emas, shu qoidaga o'xshash YANGI gap bilan. D va E kaliti ham ko'rsatilmaydi.

7. Tekshirish: A–C — shu kuni kalit bo'yicha; D–E — 2 kun ichida. A (1–8): to'g'ri harf — 2 ball. A (9–15): to'g'ri shakl va to'g'ri imlo — 2 ball; zamon to'g'ri, lekin bitta harf imlo xatosi yoki qisqartma belgisi (') tushib qolgan — 1 ball; noto'g'ri zamon — 0. B: to'g'ri — 1, bitta harf imlo xatosi — 0.5, ikki va undan ko'p xato yoki boshqa so'z — 0; fe'llarda uchala shakl to'g'ri bo'lsa 1 ball (bitta shaklda bitta harf xatosi — 0.5). C: har gap 2 ball — 1 ball to'g'ri zamon/qolip, 1 ball so'z tartibi va lug'at (mayda artikl xatosi ballni kesmaydi). D: har javob 2.5 ball; 6–8 da 3 so'zdan ortiq yoki matndagi so'z noto'g'ri yozilgan bo'lsa — 0. E: writing_a2 rubrikasi (4 mezon × 0–5).
8. Natija tizimga bo'limlar kesimida kiritiladi: A, B, C, D, E alohida + jami. Keyingi qadam (O'TDI / QAYTA TOPSHIRISH / REMEDIAL) quyidagi jadval bo'yicha belgilanadi.

9. Qayta topshirish: o'quvchi birinchi marta yozmagan variantdan beriladi (asosan B variant; testda B variantni yozgan o'quvchiga — A variantning shu bo'limi). Tahlilda hech bir variant kaliti ko'rsatilmagani uchun savollar o'quvchiga yangi bo'ladi. Faqat past bo'lim(lar) yoziladi: minimumdan past bo'lim(lar) bo'lsa — o'shalar; minimumdan past bo'lim bo'lmasa (50 ≤ jami < 70) — foizi eng past 2 bo'lim. Vaqti — shu bo'limlarning test vaqti.
answers: O'TDI: jami ≥ 70 VA har bo'limda minimum bajarilgan (A ≥ 12, B ≥ 8, C ≥ 4, D ≥ 8, E ≥ 8) → 8-darsdan davom etadi; eng past bo'limi bo'yicha uyga 1 ta qo'shimcha mashq.

QAYTA TOPSHIRISH: 50 ≤ jami < 70 YOKI biror bo'lim o'z maksimumining 40% idan past → 7 kun ichida boshqa variantdan faqat past bo'lim(lar) qayta yoziladi: minimumdan past bo'lim(lar) bo'lsa — o'shalar; minimumdan past bo'lim bo'lmasa — foizi eng past 2 bo'lim. Qayta topshirishdan keyingi jami 70 dan yuqori hisoblanmaydi.
REMEDIAL: jami < 50 → ustoz 2 ta qo'shimcha mashg'ulot o'tkazadi (har biri 30 daqiqa, zaif bo'limlar bo'yicha), so'ng B variant to'liq qayta yoziladi (B variantni yozgan o'quvchi — A variant).
Ballar 0.5 qadam bilan qo'yiladi va yaxlitlanmaydi: 69.5 — QAYTA TOPSHIRISH (jami < 70), 49.5 — REMEDIAL (jami < 50).

Misol 1: A 14 · B 15 · C 6 · D 17.5 · E 13 = 65.5 → QAYTA TOPSHIRISH (50 ≤ jami < 70): minimumdan past bo'lim yo'q, shuning uchun eng past foizli 2 bo'lim (A — 47%, C — 60%) qayta yoziladi; yakuniy jami 70 dan oshmaydi.
Misol 2: A 10 · B 18 · C 8 · D 20 · E 16 = 72 → jami yetarli, lekin A < 12 → QAYTA TOPSHIRISH faqat A bo'limi (15 savol, 10 daqiqa).
Misol 3: A 8 · B 7 · C 2 · D 12.5 · E 9 = 38.5 → REMEDIAL (jami < 50): 2 × 30 daqiqa (grammatika + lug'at), so'ng to'liq qayta yozish.
class_ex.note: Final Testdagi 'jami ≥ 85 → kuchli guruh' qoidasi Progress Testlarga taalluqli emas; lekin jami ≥ 85 olgan o'quvchilarga STRONG lug'at ro'yxati tavsiya qilinadi.

class_ex.title: O'quvchi uchun yo'riqnoma (proyektorda, test boshlanishidan oldin)
class_ex.instr: Read the rules before the test. (Test boshlanishidan oldin qoidalarni o'qing.)
items: 1. Test 40 daqiqa, 5 bo'lim, jami 100 ball: A Grammatika 30 · B Lug'at 20 · C Tarjima 10 · D Reading 20 · E Writing 20.
2. Tavsiya etilgan vaqt: A — 10, B — 5, C — 5, D — 10, E — 10 daqiqa. Ustoz har bo'lim vaqti tugaganini eslatadi.
3. Varaq tepasiga ism-familiya, guruh, sana va variant harfini (A yoki B) yozing.
4. Faqat ruchka. Telefon, lug'at, daftar — sumkada. Qo'shningiz bilan gaplashmang: ko'chirilgan javob hisobga olinmaydi.
5. A bo'lim: 1–8 — to'g'ri variant harfini aylantiring; 9–15 — qavsdagi fe'lni to'g'ri shaklda yozing (kerak bo'lsa have/has, been, not, ever, just, already ham qo'shiladi).
6. B bo'lim: o'zbekcha so'zning inglizchasini yozing; fe'llarda uchala shakl (V1 – V2 – V3). Bitta harf xatosi — 0.5 ball.
7. C bo'lim: gapni inglizchaga tarjima qiling. Zamon va so'z tartibiga e'tibor bering.
8. D bo'lim: matnni o'qing. 1–5: TRUE — matnda shunday yozilgan; FALSE — matnda aksi yozilgan; NOT GIVEN — matnda bu haqida ma'lumot yo'q. 6–8: javobni matndan oling, ko'pi bilan 3 so'z.
9. E bo'lim: 50–60 so'z. Present Perfect, Present Perfect Continuous va yet/already ni albatta ishlating. Oxirida so'zlar sonini yozing.
10. Test tugagach, test varag'i va qoralama varaq ustozga topshiriladi. Tahlilda ustoz eng ko'p uchragan xatolarni doskada tushuntiradi.

11. O'tish: jami kamida 70 ball va har bo'limda kamida 40% (A 12, B 8, C 4, D 8, E 8). 50 ≤ jami < 70 yoki biror bo'lim 40% dan past bo'lsa — 7 kun ichida past bo'limni qayta yozasiz; jami 50 dan past bo'lsa — qo'shimcha mashg'ulotlardan keyin testni to'liq qayta yozasiz.
class_ex.answers: Ustoz uchun: yo'riqnoma salomlashish bosqichida proyektorda ko'rsatiladi va ovoz chiqarib o'qiladi (2 daqiqa). O'quvchilardan 5- va 8-bandlarni o'z so'zlari bilan qaytarib aytishni so'rang. Test savollari va kalit proyektorga chiqarilmaydi (tahlilda ham).

box: Dilnoza is sixteen, and she lives in Namangan with her parents. This month has been very busy for her family. Two weeks ago, her older sister gave birth to twins, a boy and a girl. The babies were born at night, and the whole family came to the hospital in the morning. Since then, Dilnoza's mother has been cooking for the young mum every day. Dilnoza has already held both babies, but she hasn't changed a nappy yet!

Her cousin Jasur is getting married next Saturday. He has known his bride since 2019. The wedding will be in a big restaurant. Dilnoza has been helping her aunt with the wedding for five days. She has bought a new dress and some shoes, but she still hasn't found a nice scarf.

box: Otabek is fifteen, and he lives in Fergana. His family has had a lot of news this month. Last Sunday, his grandparents celebrated their fortieth wedding anniversary. They have been married for forty years, and they still walk in the park together every evening. More than fifty guests came to the party.

Otabek's aunt is pregnant. Her due date is in March, and the family has already bought a cot and a pram. They haven't chosen a name for the baby yet. Otabek has been visiting his aunt every weekend since January.

This week Otabek has been playing football every evening. On Tuesday he fell and hurt his knee, so he went to the doctor. The doctor said, "You haven't broken anything, but don't run for a week." Now Otabek can't play, so he has been reading comics at home. He has read four comics since Wednesday. "I have never been so bored in my life," he says.
items: 1. Otabek's grandparents have been married for forty years.
2. Fewer than fifty guests came to the party.
3. Otabek's aunt wants a baby girl.
4. The family has chosen a name for the baby.
5. The doctor is a friend of Otabek's father.
why: "They have been married for forty years".
Qiz yoki o'g'il xohlashi haqida hech narsa yo'q.
"They haven't chosen a name for the baby yet".
class_ex.note: Original matn, 158 so'z; qahramon to'qima. Har javob — 2.5 ball. T/F/NG o'rniga Yes/No yoki qisqartma (T, F, NG) — to'liq ball.

class_ex.title: B variant — E. Writing (20 ball, writing_a2 rubrikasi)
class_ex.instr: Write about your month. What have you done this month? What have you been doing lately? What haven't you done yet? Write 50–60 words. Use the Present Perfect, the Present Perfect Continuous, yet and already. (50–60 so'z yozing: Present Perfect, Present Perfect Continuous, yet va already majburiy.)
items: 1. Start: This month has been…
2. What have you done? — 2 sentences (Present Perfect, already).
3. What have you been doing lately? — 2 sentences (Present Perfect Continuous, for / since / lately).
4. What haven't you done yet? — 1–2 sentences (yet / still).
5. Finish with a short sentence about your feelings. Write the number of words at the end.
answers: Namuna javob (A2, 58 so'z): This month has been very interesting. I have been to my cousin's wedding, and I have already bought a new suit for it. Lately I have been studying hard because my exams are in June. I have been sleeping only six hours a night! But I haven't finished my science project yet, so I am a little worried.
Majburiy qoliplar namunada: Present Perfect (have been to, have bought, haven't finished), PPC (have been studying, have been sleeping), already, yet; bog'lovchilar: and, because, but, so.
Baholash: writing_a2 rubrikasi (quyidagi jadval) — 4 mezon × 0–5 = 20 ball. PPC yoki yet/already umuman bo'lmasa — Topshiriqni bajarish 3 balldan, Grammatika 4 balldan oshmaydi.
class_ex.note: Namuna o'quvchilarga test tahlilida ko'rsatilmaydi (qayta topshirishda shu variant yozilishi mumkin); faqat baholagandan keyin, yakka tartibda.

reading.title: Messi or Ronaldo — who is better?
text: For twenty years, football fans have argued about one question: who is better, Lionel Messi or Cristiano Ronaldo? Let's compare them.
Ronaldo is taller than Messi, and he is more muscular and more athletic. He is about two years older. Messi is shorter and slimmer, but many fans think he is quicker with the ball and more creative.

In 2024, Ronaldo had more official goals than Messi, but Messi won the World Cup with Argentina in 2022. Ronaldo is more popular on social media: he has more followers than Messi. Many people say Messi is quieter and more modest; he doesn't talk as much as Ronaldo.

Their characters are different too. Many fans think Ronaldo is more confident and more ambitious. For them, Messi is as talented as Ronaldo, but he is shyer and lets his game speak. Uzbek fans are divided: in Tashkent you will find as many Messi shirts as Ronaldo shirts!
