kahoot.q: My brother is ___ than me.
kahoot.explain: 1 bo'g'inli sifat → -er + than: taller than.

kahoot.q: Maths is ___ than English.
kahoot.explain: 2+ bo'g'in → more + adj + than.

kahoot.q: My English is ___ than yours.
kahoot.explain: good → better → the best (istisno).

kahoot.q: Qaysi gapda XATO bor?
options: She is slimmer than her sister.
Your hat is more stylish than mine.
kahoot.explain: Solishtirishda THAN: taller than me. «that» — xato.

kahoot.q: She is as ___ as her mother.
kahoot.explain: Tenglik: as + ODDIY sifat + as.

kahoot.q: big → ?
kahoot.explain: Undosh-unli-undosh → oxirgi undosh ikkilanadi: big → bigger.

kahoot.q: easy → ?
kahoot.explain: -y bilan tugagan: y → i + er: easy → easier.

kahoot.q: A lemon isn't ___ an orange.
kahoot.explain: Teng emas: not as + adj + as.

kahoot.q: He is ___ taller than his brother.
kahoot.explain: Comparative oldidan much / a lot / a bit: much taller. «very taller» — xato.

kahoot.q: Tarjima: «Sening uying biznikidan kattaroq.»
options: Your house is bigger than ours.
Your house is more big than ours.
Your house is biggest than ours.
Your house is bigger that ours.
kahoot.explain: big → bigger + than.

kahoot.q: My old phone was bad, but this one is ___.
kahoot.explain: bad → worse → the worst (istisno).

kahoot.q: Qaysi gap TO'G'RI?
options: Tashkent is more bigger than Samarkand.
kahoot.explain: bigger than; more + -er birga ishlatilmaydi.

kahoot.q: Antonim: slim ↔ ?
kahoot.explain: slim — ozg'in; plump — to'ladan kelgan. thin, skinny — sinonimlar.

kahoot.q: A man with no hair on his head is ___.
kahoot.explain: bald — kal.

kahoot.q: «kelishgan» (erkak haqida) inglizcha qanday?
kahoot.explain: handsome — kelishgan (erkak); pretty — chiroyli (qiz, bola).

kahoot.q: She has lots of small brown spots on her face. She is ___.
kahoot.explain: freckled — sepkilli.

kahoot.q: He goes to the gym every day. He is very ___.
kahoot.explain: muscular — mushakdor, baquvvat.

kahoot.q: My grandmother is 70, but she looks 50. She looks very ___.
kahoot.explain: youthful — yosh ko'rinadigan.

kahoot.q: Antonim: curly hair ↔ ___ hair
kahoot.explain: curly — jingalak, straight — tekis soch.

kahoot.q: He isn't tall, and he isn't short. He is of ___.
kahoot.explain: medium height — o'rta bo'yli.

lessons.title: Superlative Degree
lessons.grammar_topic: SUPERLATIVE (the -est / the most …)
lessons.book_ref: Asosiy material — shu reja (formula jadvali, mashqlar, matn). Ixtiyoriy qo'shimcha: Student's book IELTS 2.0, Lesson 8 — dars kitobsiz ham to'liq o'tiladi.
objectives: Superlative'ni to'g'ri tuzadi (the + adj-est / the most + adj / the best, the worst) va guruhni in / of bilan aytadi: 8 ta gapdan kamida 6 tasida to'g'ri shakl.
Comparative (2 narsa, than) va superlative (3+, the … in/of) ni farqlaydi: 'Ta'til matni' ning 7 bo'shlig'idan kamida 5 tasi to'g'ri.
Xarakter sifatlari CORE 20 bilan odamni tasvirlaydi: "the kindest person I know" qolipida 6 gap (mini-vazifa).
Reading: Khusanov haqidagi matnda superlative'larni topadi; TRUE / FALSE / NOT GIVEN ning 5 bandidan kamida 4 tasi to'g'ri.
Kombinatsiya: superlative formula jadvalini 1 daqiqada kamida 4 marta (normativ) aytadi.
materials: Formula jadvali — rejaning Grammatika bo'limi (grammar.formulas), proyektor yoki doska
Character (xarakter sifatlari) CORE 20 varag'i.
Kahoot: 'O'tgan dars Kahooti' tugmasi (7-dars savollari)
timeline: Salomlashish + kirish savoli

"Who is the most famous person from Uzbekistan?", "Which cartoon character is the funniest?" — 3–4 o'quvchi javob beradi (mashhur odamlar yoki multfilm qahramonlari haqida; sinfdoshlar solishtirilmaydi).
Kahoot — 7-dars takrori: Comparative Degree + Physical appearance
'O'tgan dars Kahooti' tugmasi (7-dars Kahooti: 20 savol, har biriga 15 soniya). Bugungi dars Kahootini ochmang — u 9-dars boshida o'ynaladi.
YOZMA NORMATIV — 7-dars lug'ati: Physical appearance (CORE 20)
Ustoz 20 so'zni o'zbekcha aytadi, o'quvchi inglizchasini yozadi — 5 daqiqa; 1 daqiqa juftlikda CORE varag'i bilan tekshirish. 18–20 to'g'ri — 2 coin.
Uyga vazifa tekshiruvi
7-dars Mashq to'plami — kalit proyektorda, o'quvchi o'zi belgilaydi; 7-dars Reading va mini-vazifasidan 2–3 javob og'zaki tekshiriladi.
YANGI MAVZU — Superlative (the -est / the most)

Formula jadvali (grammar.formulas): 1 bo'g'in → the + adj-est; 2+ bo'g'in → the most + adj; istisno: the best / the worst / the furthest; in + joy/guruh, of + all; the … I have ever + V3; one of the + superlative + ko'plik. So'ng grammar.presentation bo'yicha savol-javob. + 3 CCQ (grammar.notes).
Character (xarakter sifatlari) — CORE 20
Har so'z: talaffuz → tarjima → vocab misoli; o'quvchi oila a'zosi, mashhur odam yoki multfilm qahramoni haqida "the most … person" gapi tuzadi (vocab.how dagi Ustozga eslatma).
Kombinatsiya

Kombinatsiya — o'quvchi bugungi formula jadvalini (tasdiq → inkor → savol, har qatorga 1 misol + o'zbekcha tarjima) yoddan, to'xtamasdan aytib chiqadi va 1 daqiqada necha marta to'liq aytgani sanaladi. Bugun: S + is + the + adj-est / the most + adj (in/of …) / S + isn't + the + adj-est / the most + adj / Is + S + the + adj-est / the most + adj? (This is the biggest room in our house. / This isn't the biggest room in our house. / Is this the biggest room in our house?) Juftlikda: biri aytadi, biri sanaydi. 1 daqiqada 3 marta — warm-up, 4 marta — normativ, 5 marta — 2 coin.
Sinf mashqlari
Majburiy: Comparative yoki superlative (6 daq, yakka), Ta'til matni (6 daq, yakka), Xarakter: kim eng…? (6 daq, juftlik), Ever bilan (5 daq, yakka). ZAXIRA: David / Tom / George, Xatoni toping.
Reading
Jony Academy matni (Khusanov): 1-o'qish — 7 ta superlative'ni topish; 2-o'qish — TRUE / FALSE / NOT GIVEN; oxirida xarakter savoli. Javoblar birga tekshiriladi.
Writing / speaking mini-vazifa

Mini-vazifa: The most important person — juftlikda 2 ta IELTS Part 1 savoli, har biriga 45 soniya javob (5 daq); so'ng yakka 6 gap yozadi, kamida 3 ta superlative (7 daq). Mezon: speaking_mini va mini_writing.
Xatolar ustida ishlash + exit ticket
4 daqiqa: mini-vazifadagi eng ko'p uchragan 3 xato doskada (the most tall, of/in, "the" tushib qolishi); kuchlilarga STRONG so'zlar bilan 2 gap. Oxirgi 3 daqiqa: Exit ticket (class_ex oxirgi mashqi).
Uyga vazifa
Mashq to'plami, yozma ish va ovozli normativ — majburiy (ovozli normativ 9-darsgacha); tarjima va kartochkalar — qo'shimcha.

intro: Superlative — uch va undan ko'p narsa ichida ENG: the tallest boy in the class.
1 bo'g'in: the + adj-est (the biggest — undosh ikkilanadi; the nicest). -y: the happiest.
2+ bo'g'in: the most + adj (the most beautiful). Istisno: the best, the worst, the furthest, the least, the most.
Superlative'dan keyin: in + joy/guruh (in the world, in our class), of + all (of all my friends). Ko'pincha Present Perfect bilan: "the best film I have ever seen".
formulas: Everest is the highest mountain in the world.
I'm the most curious man in the world.
the best / the worst / the furthest

notes: Superlative'dan oldin har doim "the" (yoki my/his: my best friend).
Comparative — ikki narsa (than); superlative — uch va undan ko'p (the … in/of).
"the most" o'rniga "the least" — eng kam: the least expensive = the cheapest.
Xarakter so'zlarida juftlarni birga yodlang: reliable = trustworthy; modest = humble; careful ↔ careless; hard-working ↔ lazy; shy ↔ outgoing.
CCQ: Ali is the tallest in the class. — Are there other students in the class? (Yes) — Is anyone taller than Ali? (No)
CCQ: Tom is taller than Sam. / Tom is the tallest of the three boys. — Which sentence compares only two people? (the first) — How many boys are in the second sentence? (three)
CCQ: This is the best film I have ever seen. — Have I seen many films? (Yes) — Is any other film better? (No)
mistakes: He is the most tall in the class.
He is the tallest in the class.
She is the best student of the class.
She is the best student in the class.
He is the most intelligent student.
This is the more interesting book of all.

reading.title: Abdukodir Khusanov — a young defender from Tashkent
text: Abdukodir Khusanov is a football player. He was born in 2004 in Tashkent, one of the biggest cities in Central Asia. As a boy, he trained at a football academy in his home city. He plays in defence.
Later he played for clubs in Belarus and in France. In January 2025 he joined Manchester City in England. For many Uzbek fans, it was the best news of the winter.

Aziz, 15, from Namangan, is a big fan. "Khusanov is my favourite player," he says. "I think he is the calmest defender in his team and one of the most hard-working. He is also very modest. For me, he is the best example for young players in Uzbekistan."

Aziz trains three times a week. His coach says Aziz is the most punctual boy in the team: he is never late. "My dream is simple," Aziz says. "First the best academy in our region, then a big club in Europe."

lessons.title: Past Perfect
lessons.grammar_topic: PAST PERFECT (had + V3) — o'tgandan ham oldin
lessons.book_ref: Asosiy material — shu reja (formula jadvali, mashqlar, matn). Ixtiyoriy qo'shimcha: Student's book IELTS 2.0, Lesson 9 — dars kitobsiz ham to'liq o'tiladi.
objectives: had + V3 qolipini tasdiq, inkor va savolda tuzadi: 10 ta gapdan kamida 8 tasini to'g'ri to'ldiradi.
Ikki o'tgan ishdan OLDINGISINI Past Perfect, keyingisini Past Simple bilan beradi (by the time / when / before / after / because): 6 ta gapdan kamida 5 tasida to'g'ri tanlaydi.
Sog'liq CORE 20 ni biladi va "By the time …, I had already …" qolipida 3 ta gap aytadi.
Reading: Shomurodov matnida voqealar tartibini Past Perfect bilan tiklaydi (6 dan 5).
Mini-vazifa: "A time I was ill" — 6–8 gap, kamida 2 ta Past Perfect.
Kombinatsiya: 1 daqiqada 3 / 4 / 5 marta (warm-up / normativ / 2 coin).
materials: Formula jadvali — rejaning Grammatika bo'limi (grammar.formulas), proyektor yoki doska
Health (sog'liq) CORE 20 varag'i.
Kahoot: 'O'tgan dars Kahooti' tugmasi (8-dars savollari)
timeline: Salomlashish + kirish savoli
Ustoz: "When I arrived at school this morning, the lesson had already started." Doskaga vaqt chizig'i: 1) lesson started 2) I arrived. Qaysi biri OLDIN?
Kahoot — 8-dars takrori: Superlative Degree + Character
'O'tgan dars Kahooti' tugmasi (8-dars Kahooti: 20 savol, har biriga 15 soniya). Bugungi dars Kahootini ochmang — u 10-dars boshida o'ynaladi.
YOZMA NORMATIV — 8-dars lug'ati: Character (CORE 20)
Ustoz 20 so'zni o'zbekcha aytadi, o'quvchi inglizchasini yozadi — 5 daqiqa; 1 daqiqa juftlikda CORE varag'i bilan tekshirish. 18–20 to'g'ri — 2 coin.
Uyga vazifa tekshiruvi
8-dars Mashq to'plami: kalit proyektorda, o'quvchilar daftarni almashtirib juftlikda belgilaydi; eng ko'p xato qilingan 2 band doskada tushuntiriladi.
YANGI MAVZU — Past Perfect

Formula jadvali (grammar.formulas): tasdiq S + had + V3 → inkor hadn't + V3 → savol Had + S + V3? → by the time / never … before / because. Doskada vaqt chizig'i: ikki o'tgan nuqtadan OLDINGISI — had + V3, keyingisi — Past Simple. Har qatorga misol + tarjima; grammar.presentation savol-javoblari juftlikda. + 3 CCQ (grammar.notes).
Health (sog'liq) — CORE 20
Har so'z misol gapi bilan (vocab.core); 5 ta so'z bilan "By the time the doctor came, I had already …" og'zaki. O'quvchidan shaxsiy kasalligi so'ralmaydi — to'qima personaj nomidan gapiriladi.
Kombinatsiya

Kombinatsiya — o'quvchi bugungi formula jadvalini (tasdiq → inkor → savol, har qatorga 1 misol + o'zbekcha tarjima) yoddan, to'xtamasdan aytib chiqadi va 1 daqiqada necha marta to'liq aytgani sanaladi. Bugun: S + had + V3 / S + hadn't + V3 / Had + S + V3? Juftlikda: biri aytadi, biri sanaydi. 1 daqiqada 3 marta — warm-up, 4 marta — normativ, 5 marta — 2 coin.
Sinf mashqlari

Majburiy: had + V3 (6 daq, yakka), Past Simple yoki Past Perfect (6 daq, yakka), Vaqt chizig'i (6 daq, juftlik), Juftlikda: Had you ever … before …? (5 daq, juftlik). ZAXIRA: Lug'at: mos so'z, Xatoni toping.
Reading
Eldor Shomurodov matni: o'qish + glossary (4 daq) → Past Perfect gaplarni topish (3 daq) → TRUE / FALSE / NOT GIVEN (3 daq) → Qaysi biri oldin? (2 daq).
Writing / speaking mini-vazifa
Mini-vazifa: A time I was ill — 6–8 gap yozma (8 daq, kamida 2 ta Past Perfect), keyin juftlikda 2 ta IELTS Part 1 savoliga og'zaki javob (4 daq). Mezon: mini_writing rubrikasi.
Xatolar ustida ishlash + exit ticket

4 daqiqa: darsdagi ko'p uchragan xatolar doskada (had + V2 o'rniga V3, bitta ishda Past Perfect, qisqa javob "Yes, I had"); STRONG lug'at — kuchlilarga (+1 coin). Oxirgi 3 daqiqa: Exit ticket (class_ex oxirida).
Uyga vazifa
Mashq to'plami (12 band), "Kechagi kunim" yozma ishi, ovozli normativ (CORE 20) — majburiy; tarjima — qo'shimcha. Ovozli normativ 10-darsgacha yuboriladi.

intro: Past Perfect — o'tgan zamondagi ikki ishdan OLDINGISI: "By the time I arrived, they had already left" (ular ketgan — oldin; men keldim — keyin).
Formula: had + V3 (hamma shaxs uchun had). Qisqa: I'd, he'd, hadn't.
Ko'pincha: by (the time), when, before, after, already, never … before, just.
Faqat bitta o'tgan ish bo'lsa — Past Simple. Past Perfect faqat ikkinchi o'tgan nuqta bilan solishtirganda.
formulas: I had started my business by 2020.
I hadn't started my business by 2020.
Had you started your business by 2020?
By the time + Past Simple, S + had + V3
By the time I arrived, they had already left.
Men kelguncha ular allaqachon ketishgan edi.
She had never visited that city before her trip.
Sayohatidan oldin u o'sha shaharda hech bo'lmagan edi.
The store closed because they had sold everything.
Do'kon yopildi, chunki hamma narsani sotib bo'lishgan edi.
presentation: Had the lesson started when you arrived?
Yes, it had already started.
Why was she so tired yesterday?
Because she hadn't slept the night before.
Had you ever been to hospital before last year?
No, I had never been to hospital before.
What had the doctor done before you arrived?
He had already seen five patients.
Why did he go to the doctor?
Because his cough hadn't stopped for two weeks.
Had they finished the operation by 10 o'clock?
Yes, they had finished it by 9.30.
Why couldn't you get in?
Because I had left my key at home.
Had you taken the medicine before the pain went away?
Yes, I had taken two tablets.
What had happened before the ambulance came?
He had fallen off his bike.
Had she recovered by the weekend?
No, she hadn't recovered yet.
notes: after / before bilan tartib aniq bo'lsa, Past Simple ham to'g'ri (After I took the medicine, I felt better); Past Perfect oldingi ishni ta'kidlaydi. by the time va when (oldin tugagan ish) bilan Past Perfect kerak.
"after + Past Perfect, Past Simple": After I had taken the medicine, I felt better.
"when" bilan: When I got there, they had already started (oldin boshlagan).
Sog'liq bilan: had caught a cold, had broken a leg, had recovered, had taken medicine.
CCQ: When I arrived, the lesson had started. — What happened first? (The lesson started) — Did I see the start of the lesson? (No)
CCQ: When I arrived, the lesson started. — Did I see the start of the lesson? (Yes) — What happened first here? (I arrived)
CCQ: By the time the doctor came, I had taken the medicine. — Did I take the medicine before or after the doctor came? (Before)
CCQ: She had never been ill before she was 20. — Was she ill before 20? (No) — Was she ill later? (Yes)
mistakes: By the time I arrived, they already left.
She had went to the doctor.
She had gone to the doctor.
Had you finished when I called? — Yes, I did.
Before she found her keys, she had search for hours.

reading.title: Eldor Shomurodov — from Jarkurgan to Europe
text: Eldor Shomurodov was born in 1995 in Jarkurgan, a small town in Surkhandarya. He played for Bunyodkor in Tashkent, and by 2017 he had already scored goals for the club in the Uzbek league.

In 2017 he moved to Russia and played for Rostov. In 2020 he moved again — this time to Genoa in Italy. Before he arrived in Italy, he had spent three years in Russia. In 2021 Roma bought him, and in 2022 Roma, with coach José Mourinho, won the UEFA Conference League. Shomurodov was in the team.
In June 2025 Uzbekistan qualified for the FIFA World Cup for the first time. Uzbekistan had never played at a World Cup before. By then, Shomurodov had worn the national team shirt for many years.

Sardor, 16, from Termez, is a big fan of Eldor. Last year he hurt his knee in a school match, but he didn't tell his coach. He had played with a knee problem for weeks before he finally went to the doctor. By the time he saw the doctor, the pain had become much worse. The doctor told him to rest for a month. Now Sardor has recovered, and he never plays with pain.

kahoot.q: ___ you ___ breakfast before you took the pill?

kahoot.q: When I got to the clinic, the doctor ___ home.

lessons.title: Future Perfect
lessons.grammar_topic: FUTURE PERFECT (will have + V3) — kelajakdagi nuqtagacha tugagan ish
lessons.book_ref: Asosiy material — shu reja (formula jadvali, mashqlar, matn). Ixtiyoriy qo'shimcha: Student's book IELTS 2.0, Lesson 10 — dars kitobsiz ham to'liq o'tiladi.
objectives: "By + vaqt, S + will have + V3" va "S + won't have + V3" qoliplarini tuzadi: 8 ta gapdan kamida 6 tasini to'g'ri to'ldiradi.
Savol shakli (Will + S + have + V3?) va "by the time + Present Simple" ni tanib oladi: tanlash mashqida 6 dan kamida 5 ta to'g'ri.
"By 2030 I will have …" mini-vazifasida 6 gapdan kamida 5 tasini to'g'ri yozadi.
His-tuyg'u CORE 20: 20 so'zdan kamida 16 tasini tarjima qiladi va "I feel … because …" qolipida 3 ta gap aytadi.
Reading: BTS matnidan Future Perfect gaplarni topadi, T/F/NG da 5 dan kamida 4 ta.
Kombinatsiya: 1 daqiqada 3 / 4 / 5 marta (warm-up / normativ / 2 coin).
materials: Formula jadvali — rejaning Grammatika bo'limi (grammar.formulas), proyektor yoki doska
Feelings and emotions (his-tuyg'ular) CORE 20 varag'i.

Ustoz: "By 2030 I will have finished university. And you?" — har o'quvchi bitta "By 2030 I will have …" gapi aytadi.
Kahoot — 9-dars takrori: Past Perfect + Health
'O'tgan dars Kahooti' tugmasi (9-dars Kahooti: 20 savol, har biriga 15 soniya). Bugungi dars Kahootini ochmang — u 11-dars boshida o'ynaladi.
YOZMA NORMATIV — 9-dars lug'ati: Health (CORE 20)
Ustoz 20 so'zni o'zbekcha aytadi, o'quvchi inglizchasini yozadi — 5 daqiqa; 1 daqiqa juftlikda CORE varag'i bilan tekshirish. 18–20 to'g'ri — 2 coin.
Uyga vazifa tekshiruvi
9-dars Mashq to'plami: kalit proyektorda, o'quvchilar daftarni almashtirib juftlikda belgilaydi; eng ko'p xato qilingan 2 band doskada tushuntiriladi.
YANGI MAVZU — Future Perfect

Formula jadvali (grammar.formulas): tasdiq By + vaqt, S + will have + V3 → inkor S + won't have + V3 → savol Will + S + have + V3? (tanib olish) → by the time + Present Simple (tanib olish). Doskada vaqt chizig'i: hozir → ish tugaydi → kelajak nuqta (by 2030). grammar.presentation: ustoz 3 juftlikni modellaydi, qolganlari juftlikda. + 3 CCQ (grammar.notes).
Feelings and emotions (his-tuyg'ular) — CORE 20
Har so'z misol gapi bilan (vocab.core); keyin 5 ta so'z bilan "I feel … because …" og'zaki (vocab.how).
Kombinatsiya

Kombinatsiya — o'quvchi bugungi formula jadvalini (tasdiq → inkor → savol, har qatorga 1 misol + o'zbekcha tarjima) yoddan, to'xtamasdan aytib chiqadi va 1 daqiqada necha marta to'liq aytgani sanaladi. Bugun: S + will have + V3 / S + won't have + V3 / Will + S + have + V3? Juftlikda: biri aytadi, biri sanaydi. 1 daqiqada 3 marta — warm-up, 4 marta — normativ, 5 marta — 2 coin.
Sinf mashqlari

Majburiy: will have + V3 (6 daq, yakka), Tanlang: by the time va savol (5 daq, yakka), By 2035 — mening hayotim (6 daq, juftlik), His-tuyg'uni toping (6 daq, juftlik). ZAXIRA: Vaziyatga qarab, Xatoni toping.
Reading
BTS matni: o'qish + glossary (4 daq) → Future Perfect gaplarni topish (3 daq) → TRUE / FALSE / NOT GIVEN (3 daq) → his-tuyg'u so'zlari (2 daq).
Writing / speaking mini-vazifa
Mini-vazifa: By 2030 (class_ex): 8 daqiqa — 6 gap yozish (5 tasdiq, 1 inkor); 4 daqiqa — juftlikda 2 ta Part 1 savoli. Mezon: mini_writing.
Xatolar ustida ishlash + exit ticket

4 daqiqa: darsdagi ko'p uchragan xatolar doskada (grammar.mistakes: by the time + will, will have + V1, until o'rniga by); STRONG lug'at — kuchlilarga (+1 coin). Oxirgi 3 daqiqa: Exit ticket (class_ex oxirida).
Uyga vazifa
Mashq to'plami (12 band), "2035-yilda men" yozma ishi, ovozli normativ (CORE 20) — majburiy; tarjima — qo'shimcha. Ovozli normativ 11-darsgacha yuboriladi.

intro: Future Perfect — kelajakdagi bir nuqtaga kelib TUGAGAN bo'ladigan ish: "By 2030, I will have finished university."
Formula: will have + V3 (hamma shaxs). Qisqa: I'll have finished; won't have finished.
Ko'pincha: by + vaqt (by 2030, by Monday, by then). "by the time + Present Simple" ("by the time you arrive") — bugun faqat tanib olinadi.
Past Perfect — o'tgan nuqtagacha (had); Future Perfect — kelajak nuqtagacha (will have). Ikkalasi ham "perfect" — tugallangan.
formulas: I will have finished university by 2030.
I won't have finished university by 2030.
Will you have finished university by 2030?
By the time + Present Simple, S + will have + V3
By the time you arrive, the film will have started.
By + vaqt, S + will have + V3 + for + davr
By next June they will have been married for 25 years.
Kelasi iyungacha ular turmush qurganiga 25 yil bo'ladi.
It's 9 pm — she will have arrived home by now.
Soat 9 — u hozirgacha uyga yetib borgan bo'lsa kerak.
presentation: Will you have finished your homework by 8 o'clock?
Yes, I will have finished it by then.
What will you have achieved by 2030?
I will have graduated and found a good job.
Will the film have started by the time we arrive?
Yes, it will have already started.
How long will they have been married next year?
They will have been married for 25 years.
Will you have learned English by the end of the course?
I hope I will have learned a lot.
Will he have spent all his money before the end of the holiday?
Yes, he will probably have spent it all.
Will the world have changed by 2100?
Yes, computers will have taken over many jobs.
Will she have calmed down by tomorrow?
I think she will have calmed down.
Will you have read the book by Friday?
No, I won't have read it by Friday.
Will the rain have stopped by the evening?
I hope it will have stopped by then.
notes: "by" — "…gacha": by Monday, by the end of the year, by then, by the time (+ Present Simple, will emas!).
Future Perfect + for: "By June I will have worked here for five years."
Qiziquvchilar uchun: hozirgi taxmin — "They will have arrived by now" (ehtimol yetib borishgan).
His-tuyg'u so'zlari: feel + sifat (feel anxious), be + sifat (be relieved); sabab bilan: "I feel relieved because the exams have finished."
CCQ: By 2030 I will have finished university. — Am I a student now? (Yes) — Will I finish before 2030 or after? (Before / by 2030) — In 2030, will I still be a student? (No)
CCQ: By 6 o'clock I will have cleaned my room. — Is my room clean now? (No) — At 6 o'clock, will it be clean? (Yes)
CCQ: I will have finished the book by Friday. — Can I finish it on Wednesday? (Yes) — On Saturday? (No — by = …gacha, eng kechi bilan Juma)
CCQ: She won't have left by 8. — At 8 o'clock, is she still here? (Yes)
mistakes: By the time you will arrive, we will have eaten.
By the time you arrive, we will have eaten.
I will have finished it until Friday.
I will have finished it by Friday.
Tugash muddati → by (…gacha); until — davom etish uchun.
She will has left by then.
She will have left by then.
will have + V3, been kerak emas.
I will have finish it by 2030.
I will have finished it by 2030.

reading.title: BTS — music, feelings and fans
text: BTS is a South Korean music group with seven members: RM, Jin, Suga, J-Hope, Jimin, V and Jungkook. The group started in 2013. At that time not many people knew them, but a few years later they became famous all over the world. Their fans are called "ARMY", and there are ARMY fans in many countries, including Uzbekistan.

Why do so many young people love them? Many of their songs are about real emotions: stress at school, loneliness, fear of the future and the joy of being young. In 2018 RM gave a short speech at the United Nations. He told young people to love themselves and to speak about their feelings.
In interviews, some members have talked openly about stress and anxiety. Many fans say this makes them feel less lonely: famous people have negative feelings too, and it is normal to talk about them.
Between 2022 and 2025 all seven members did their military service in Korea. By the summer of 2025, they had all finished it. By 2030, BTS will have been together for 17 years.

Madina, 16, from Tashkent, is a big fan. "Their songs help me when I feel stressed or homesick," she says. "By the end of this year, I will have learned ten of their songs in Korean. By the time I finish school, I will have started a Korean course. By 2030, I will have saved enough money for a concert ticket, and I'll be delighted! And I won't have lost my love for their music by then."

lessons.title: Before, After, By the time, As soon as, Since
lessons.grammar_topic: BOG'LOVCHILAR: BEFORE / AFTER / BY THE TIME / AS SOON AS / SINCE
lessons.book_ref: Asosiy material — shu reja (formula jadvali, mashqlar, matn). Ixtiyoriy qo'shimcha: Student's book IELTS 2.0, Lesson 11 — dars kitobsiz ham to'liq o'tiladi.
objectives: Beshta vaqt bog'lovchisini zamon juftligi bilan qo'llaydi: 10 ta gapdan kamida 8 tasida to'g'ri bog'lovchini tanlaydi.
Ikki gapni after/before bilan bitta gapga birlashtiradi (Past Perfect + Past Simple): 6 tadan kamida 5 tasi to'g'ri.
by the time bilan Future Perfect va Past Perfect gaplar tuzadi; by the time / as soon as dan keyin will ishlatmaydi (exit ticket'da 3 dan kamida 2).

YANGI MAVZU — Before, after, by the time, as soon as, since

Formula jadvali (grammar.formulas): 5 bog'lovchi va ularning zamon juftlari; after/before ketma-ketlikni o'zi ko'rsatadi. Doskada vaqt chizig'i: 1-ish → 2-ish; grammar.presentation savol-javoblari juftlikda. + 3 CCQ (grammar.notes).
Countries and nationalities (mamlakat va millatlar) — CORE 20

Har juft: mamlakat → millat, vocab.core misol gapi bilan. 2 daqiqa — urg'u ko'chishi drili: JaPAN → JapaNESE, CHIna → ChiNESE, ITaly → iTALian, EGypt → eGYPtian (sinf urg'uli bo'g'inda qarsak chalib takrorlaydi). -ese — urg'u qo'shimchaga, -ian — undan oldingi bo'g'inga. Millat va til — bosh harf bilan.
Kombinatsiya

Kombinatsiya — o'quvchi bugungi formula jadvalini (tasdiq → inkor → savol, har qatorga 1 misol + o'zbekcha tarjima) yoddan, to'xtamasdan aytib chiqadi va 1 daqiqada necha marta to'liq aytgani sanaladi. Bugun bog'lovchilar guruhlab aytiladi: 1) before + after: Before + V2, had + V3 / After + had + V3, V2; 2) by the time: By the time + V1, will have + V3 / By the time + V2, had + V3; 3) as soon as + since: As soon as + V1, will + V1 / have/has + V3 + since + V2. Juftlikda: biri aytadi, biri sanaydi. 1 daqiqada 1 marta — warm-up, 2 marta — normativ, 3 marta — 2 coin.
Sinf mashqlari

Majburiy: AFTER / BEFORE bilan birlashtiring (6 daq, yakka), Bog'lovchini tanlang (6 daq, yakka), Gapni tugating (5 daq, yakka), Mamlakat va millat (6 daq, juftlik). ZAXIRA: Matn: kulgili voqea, Xatoni toping.
Reading
Al-Farg'oniy matni: o'qish + glossary (4 daq) → bog'lovchili gaplarni topish (3 daq) → TRUE / FALSE / NOT GIVEN (3 daq) → mamlakat va millatlar (2 daq).
Writing / speaking mini-vazifa

Mini-vazifa: My morning — 6 gap (before / after / as soon as), yozma, 7 daqiqa; so'ng juftlikda 2 ta IELTS Part 1 savoli ("Which country would you like to visit?"), 5 daqiqa. Namuna va mezon — class_ex'da.
Xatolar ustida ishlash + exit ticket

4 daqiqa: darsdagi ko'p uchragan xatolar doskada (by the time / as soon as + will, since + davr, millat kichik harf bilan — grammar.mistakes); STRONG lug'at — kuchlilarga (+1 coin). Oxirgi 3 daqiqa: Exit ticket (class_ex oxirida).
Uyga vazifa
Mashq to'plami (12 band), "Orzuimdagi sayohat" yozma ishi, ovozli normativ (CORE 20) — majburiy; tarjima — qo'shimcha. Ovozli normativ 12-darsgacha yuboriladi.

intro: BEFORE: Before + Past Simple, Past Perfect (oldinroq ish — had + V3).

AFTER: After + Past Perfect (yoki Past Simple), Past Simple — "After I had finished my work, I went for a walk." = "After I finished my work, I went for a walk." (after ketma-ketlikni o'zi ko'rsatadi).
BY THE TIME: By the time + Present Simple, Future Perfect (kelajak) / By the time + Past Simple, Past Perfect (o'tgan).
AS SOON AS: As soon as + Past Simple, Past Simple (o'tgan) / As soon as + Present Simple, will (kelajak).
SINCE: Present Perfect + since + Past Simple (boshlanish nuqtasi).
formulas: Before + Past Simple, S + had + V3
Before he visited Japan, he had never tasted sushi.
Yaponiyaga borishidan oldin u hech qachon sushi yemagan edi.
After + S + had + V3 (yoki V2), Past Simple
After I had finished my work, I went for a walk.
By the time + Present Simple, S + will have + V3
By the time you arrive, I will have cooked dinner.
Sen kelguncha men ovqat pishirib bo'laman.
By the time + Past Simple, S + had + V3
By the time we got there, the shop had closed.
As soon as + Past Simple, Past Simple
As soon as I finished, I called you.
S + have/has (not) + V3 + since + Past Simple
I haven't seen her since we graduated from college.
presentation: What had you done before you came to class?
Before I came to class, I had done my homework.
What did you do after you had finished school yesterday?
After I had finished school, I went to football.
Will you have eaten by the time I arrive?
Yes, by the time you arrive, I will have eaten.
What did you do as soon as you got home?
As soon as I got home, I turned on my phone.
How long have you known Ali?
I've known him since we were in primary school.
notes: "by the time" — bog'lovchi (keyin gap keladi); "by" — predlog (by 2030). Ko'pincha perfect zamon bilan keladi (By 2030 I will have finished), lekin "I will finish it by 2030" ham to'g'ri.
as soon as = darhol, …bilanoq; kelajakda will yo'q: as soon as it stops (raining).
Millatlar: mamlakat ham, millat ham bosh harf bilan: Japan — Japanese; tilni ham: "She speaks Japanese".
after/before ketma-ketlikni o'zi ko'rsatadi, shuning uchun "After I finished, I went home" ham to'g'ri. Past Perfect ixtiyoriy — u oldinlikni ta'kidlaydi.
CCQ: After I had finished my work, I went for a walk. — What happened first? (I finished my work) — Did I work and walk at the same time? (No)
CCQ: By the time you arrive, I will have cooked dinner. — Will dinner be ready when you arrive? (Yes) — Will I start cooking after you arrive? (No)
CCQ: As soon as I finish, I'll call you. — Will I call before I finish? (No) — Will I wait a long time after I finish? (No — immediately)
CCQ: I haven't seen her since we graduated. — When did I last see her? (When we graduated) — Have I seen her after that? (No)
mistakes: After I finished my work, I had gone out.
After I finished / had finished my work, I went out.
Keyingi ish — Past Simple (had gone emas); after-qismda Past Simple ham, Past Perfect ham to'g'ri.
By the time you will arrive…
As soon as I will finish, I'll call.
As soon as I finish, I'll call.
I haven't seen him since 3 years.
I haven't seen him for 3 years. / since 2023.

reading.title: Al-Farghani — the scholar from Fergana who measured the Nile
text: Ahmad al-Farghani was born around 800 in Fergana. In Europe he is known as Alfraganus. Before he became famous, he had moved to Baghdad, where many great scientists were working at the House of Wisdom.

There he wrote "Elements of Astronomy". In the 12th century the book was translated into Latin, and European scholars used his work for centuries. By the time Columbus sailed to America in 1492, the book had been in Latin for more than 300 years. Columbus used Farghani's numbers, but he made a mistake with the units — this is one reason why he thought the Earth was smaller than it is.

After Farghani had lived in Baghdad for many years, the ruler sent him to Egypt. There, in 861, he helped to build the Nilometer in Cairo — an instrument to measure the level of the River Nile. As soon as the water started to rise, people could see if the year would be good for their fields. The Nilometer still stands today; since it was built, it has been repaired many times, but the idea is the same.
Farghani died around 870. Today there is a monument to him in Fergana, and his name is known in both Uzbekistan and Egypt — a scholar from Fergana between two countries.

lessons.title: Past Perfect Continuous
lessons.grammar_topic: PAST PERFECT CONTINUOUS (had been + V-ing) — o'tgan nuqtagacha davom etgan jarayon
lessons.book_ref: Asosiy material — shu reja (formula jadvali, mashqlar, matn). Ixtiyoriy qo'shimcha: Student's book IELTS 2.0, Lesson 12 — dars kitobsiz ham to'liq o'tiladi.
objectives: had been + V-ing qolipini tanib oladi va tanlaydi: 8 ta gapdan kamida 6 tasida to'g'ri shaklni to'ldiradi.
Past Perfect (natija) va Past Perfect Continuous (jarayon)ni ajratadi: 6 ta tanlash bandidan kamida 4 tasida to'g'ri tanlaydi.
Ob-havo CORE 20 ni biladi va "A rainy day" mini-vazifasida 45–60 soniya gapiradi (kamida 4 ta CORE so'z).
Reading: Hamilton matnidan PPC gaplarni topadi, T/F/NG da 5 dan kamida 4.
Listening: ob-havo ma'lumotidan gap-fill'da 7 dan kamida 5 ta to'g'ri javob.
Kombinatsiya: 1 daqiqada 3 / 4 / 5 marta (warm-up / normativ / 2 coin).
materials: Formula jadvali — rejaning Grammatika bo'limi (grammar.formulas), proyektor yoki doska
Weather (ob-havo) CORE 20 varag'i.
Kahoot: 'O'tgan dars Kahooti' tugmasi (11-dars savollari)
timeline: Salomlashish + kirish savoli
Ustoz: "When I came in, you had been talking for ten minutes!" — o'quvchilar: "Had we?" Doskaga vaqt chizig'i: talking (davom) → I came in.
Kahoot — 11-dars takrori: Before, After, By the time, As soon as, Since + Countries and nationalities
'O'tgan dars Kahooti' tugmasi (11-dars Kahooti: 20 savol, har biriga 15 soniya). Bugungi dars Kahootini ochmang — u 13-dars boshida o'ynaladi.
YOZMA NORMATIV — 11-dars lug'ati: Countries and nationalities (CORE 20)

Ustoz 20 so'zni o'zbekcha aytadi, o'quvchi inglizchasini yozadi — 5 daqiqa (ustoz mamlakatni o'zbekcha aytadi, o'quvchi mamlakat + millatni bosh harf bilan yozadi — 20 juft); 1 daqiqa juftlikda CORE varag'i bilan tekshirish. 18–20 to'g'ri — 2 coin.
Uyga vazifa tekshiruvi
11-dars Mashq to'plami: kalit proyektorda, o'quvchilar daftarni almashtirib juftlikda belgilaydi; eng ko'p xato qilingan 2 band doskada tushuntiriladi.
YANGI MAVZU — Past Perfect Continuous

Formula jadvali (grammar.formulas): tasdiq S + had been + V-ing → inkor hadn't been + V-ing → savol Had + S + been + V-ing? → How long …? → sabab (iz) → has been / had been. Doskada vaqt chizig'i: jarayon → o'tgan nuqta (when / by the time). Tanib olish darajasi: 3–4 qolip gap. grammar.presentation: ustoz 3 juftlikni modellaydi, qolganini juftlikda. + 3 CCQ (grammar.notes).
Weather (ob-havo) — CORE 20

Har so'z misol gapi bilan (vocab.core); ustoz so'raydi: "What's the weather like today? What's the temperature?" — o'quvchilar CORE so'zlar bilan javob beradi. Kuchlilar 3 ta so'z bilan "It had been … for … when …" gapini aytadi.
Kombinatsiya

Kombinatsiya — o'quvchi bugungi formula jadvalini (tasdiq → inkor → savol, har qatorga 1 misol + o'zbekcha tarjima) yoddan, to'xtamasdan aytib chiqadi va 1 daqiqada necha marta to'liq aytgani sanaladi. Bugun: S + had been + V-ing / S + hadn't been + V-ing / Had + S + been + V-ing? Juftlikda: biri aytadi, biri sanaydi. 1 daqiqada 3 marta — warm-up, 4 marta — normativ, 5 marta — 2 coin.
Sinf mashqlari

Majburiy: had been + V-ing (6 daq, yakka), Past Perfect yoki Past Perfect Continuous (5 daq, yakka), Iz — sabab (5 daq, juftlik), Mini-vazifa: A rainy day (7 daq, juftlik). ZAXIRA: Uch zamon, Lug'at: ob-havo ma'lumoti, Xatoni toping.
Reading
Lewis Hamilton matni: o'qish + glossary (4 daq) → PPC gaplarni topish (3 daq) → TRUE / FALSE / NOT GIVEN (3 daq) → ob-havo so'zlari (2 daq).
Listening
Ustoz transcript'ni 2 marta o'qiydi: 1-marta gist savol, 2-marta topshiriqlar; javoblar birga tekshiriladi.
Xatolar ustida ishlash + exit ticket

6 daqiqa: darsdagi ko'p uchragan xatolar doskada (grammar.mistakes: been + V-ing, holat fe'llari, has been / had been, for / since); STRONG lug'at — kuchlilarga (+1 coin). Oxirgi 3 daqiqa: Exit ticket (class_ex oxirida).
Uyga vazifa
Mashq to'plami (12 band), "Ob-havo kundaligi" yozma ishi, ovozli normativ (CORE 20) — majburiy; tarjima — qo'shimcha. Ovozli normativ 13-darsgacha yuboriladi.

intro: Past Perfect Continuous — o'tgandagi bir nuqtagacha DAVOM ETGAN jarayon: "They had been waiting for hours by the time he came."
Formula: had been + V-ing. Qisqa: I'd been waiting; hadn't been.
Ko'pincha: for / since / how long / all day + by the time / when / before.
Farq: Past Perfect — natija (had finished); PPC — jarayon (had been working). Present Perfect Continuous — hozirgacha; Past Perfect Continuous — o'tgan nuqtagacha.
formulas: They had been waiting for hours by the time he came.
U kelguncha ular soatlab kutishgan edi.
She hadn't been waiting for hours by the time he came.
U kelguncha u soatlab kutmagan edi.
Had you been watching the games for an hour by the time they called?
Ular qo'ng'iroq qilganda sen bir soatdan beri o'yin ko'rayotgan edingmi?
How long + had + S + been + V-ing?
How long had it been raining when you left?
Sen ketganingda qancha vaqtdan beri yomg'ir yog'ayotgan edi?
Past Simple + because + had been + V-ing
The ground was wet because it had been raining.
Yer ho'l edi, chunki yomg'ir yog'ib turgan edi.
It has been snowing since morning. / It had been snowing for hours when we left.
Ertalabdan beri qor yog'yapti. / Biz ketganimizda soatlab qor yog'ib turgan edi.
presentation: How long had you been waiting when the bus came?
I had been waiting for twenty minutes.
Why was the ground wet this morning?
Because it had been raining all night.
Had it been snowing for long when you left?
Yes, it had been snowing since morning.
Why were you so tired yesterday?
I had been studying for six hours.
How long had they been living in Tashkent before they moved?
They had been living there for ten years.
Why was the road icy?
Because it had been freezing all night.
What had you been doing before I called?
I had been watching the weather forecast.
How long had the storm been going on when the lights went out?
It had been going on for an hour.
notes: Holat fe'llari (know, have, be, like) — Past Perfect Simple: "I had known him for years".
"when" bilan: When I arrived, they had been waiting for an hour (jarayon oldin boshlangan).
Ob-havo gaplari: It had been raining / snowing / freezing … (it + had been + V-ing).
Forecast (prognoz) tinglaganda: sunny → rain → storm kabi ketma-ketlikka e'tibor.

CCQ: It had been raining for hours when we left. — Did the rain start before we left? (Yes) — Did it rain for a short time or a long time? (A long time — for hours) — Is the focus on the activity and how long? (Yes)
CCQ: She was tired because she had been working. — Was she working before she was tired? (Yes) — Do we know if she finished the work? (No / not important) — Result or activity? (Activity)

CCQ: By 8 o'clock she had written three letters. / She had been writing letters all morning. — Which sentence tells us how many? (The first — had written, natija) — Which one is about the activity? (The second — had been writing)
mistakes: She had being working all day.
She had been working all day.
It had been rain for hours when we left.
It had been raining for hours when we left.
I had been knowing him for years.
I had known him for years.
How long have you been waiting when the bus came?
How long had you been waiting when the bus came?
She had been working here since three years.

items: Hikoya: A rainy day I remember (6–8 gap)
Part 1: Do you like rainy days? Why?
Part 1: What's the weather like in your city in winter?
answers: Namuna: Last April there was a big storm in our city. It had been raining for three hours when I left school. The sky was dark, and there was lightning. The temperature was only ten degrees, so I was cold. I waited at the bus stop for twenty minutes. When I got home, I was very wet. My mum made hot tea for me. The next day the forecast was for sunny weather.
Namuna: Yes, I do. I like rainy days because the air is fresh and I can stay at home and read. But I don't like strong wind and storms.
Namuna: In winter it is usually cold in my city, about zero degrees. Sometimes it snows, and some mornings are freezing, so the roads are icy.

reading.title: Lewis Hamilton — racing in the rain
text: Lewis Hamilton was born in 1985 in England. His father worked more than one job so that his son could race karts. Lewis started karting at eight, and by the age of ten he had been racing for two years. By 2024 he had won a record seven Formula 1 world championships, the same number as Michael Schumacher.

Many of his best victories happened in bad weather. Most drivers do not like rain: the track is slippery, the tyres do not grip well, and it is hard to see. But Hamilton often drives very well in the wet. At Silverstone in 2008, it had been raining before the start, so the track was very wet. Many drivers spun off the track during the race, but Hamilton won by more than a minute.

In Brazil in 2008, the last race of the season, the situation was even more dramatic. Hamilton needed to finish in the top five to become champion. It had been raining just before the start, so the race started late. In the last laps, the rain came back. Near the end, Hamilton dropped to sixth place. But on the last lap he passed one more car, finished fifth and became world champion for the first time.

Aziz, 15, from Namangan, watched a video of that race with his father. "I had been reading about it for weeks, but the video was even more exciting," he says. Now, when the forecast says "rain" before a race, Aziz is happy: rain races are often the most exciting.

tasks.instr: Write ONE WORD AND/OR A NUMBER for each answer.
items: Before this morning, it had been raining for ___ days.

transcript: Forecaster: Good evening, and here is the weather.
Forecaster: What a week! It had been raining for three days before the sun finally came out this morning. The rivers had been rising since Sunday, and some roads were closed.

Forecaster: In the mountains, it had been snowing all night, and the temperature had been falling for hours. At six o'clock this morning it was minus five degrees there. Drivers had been waiting on the mountain road for hours when it finally opened at noon.
Forecaster: Now the forecast. Tomorrow will be sunny and warm, around 24 degrees.
Forecaster: On Thursday, a storm will arrive from the west, with strong wind, thunder, lightning and possible hail.
Forecaster: Friday will be cooler and cloudy, about 15 degrees.
Forecaster: The weekend looks calm and mild — perfect for a picnic. See you tomorrow!

kahoot.q: They ___ for hours by the time he came.
kahoot.explain: O'tgan nuqtagacha davom etgan jarayon → had been + V-ing.

kahoot.q: The ground was wet because it ___.
kahoot.explain: O'tgandagi iz → had been + V-ing.

kahoot.q: How long ___ you ___ when the bus came?
kahoot.explain: O'tgan nuqta (when the bus came) → How long had you been waiting?

kahoot.q: Qaysi gapda XATO bor?
options: I had been knowing him for years.
I had known him for years.
It had been snowing all night.
We had been walking for an hour.
kahoot.explain: know — holat fe'li, continuous emas: I had known him.

kahoot.q: Past Perfect Continuous formulasi qaysi?
kahoot.explain: PPC (o'tgan) = had been + V-ing.

kahoot.q: Inkor shaklini tanlang: «She had been working.»
kahoot.explain: Inkor: hadn't been + V-ing.

kahoot.q: She had been working here ___ three years.
kahoot.explain: three years — davr → for.

kahoot.q: Look outside! It ___ snowing since morning.
kahoot.explain: Hozirgacha davom (look outside!) → has been; o'tgan nuqtagacha → had been.

kahoot.q: Tarjima: «U kelganda biz ikki soatdan beri kutayotgan edik.»
options: We had been waiting for two hours when he came.
We have been waiting for two hours when he came.
We had been wait for two hours when he came.
We were been waiting for two hours when he came.
kahoot.explain: O'tgan nuqtagacha davomiylik → had been + V-ing + for.

kahoot.q: Her eyes were red because she ___.
kahoot.explain: O'tgandagi iz → had been crying.

kahoot.q: ___ it been raining for a long time when you left?
kahoot.explain: Savol: Had + S + been + V-ing?

kahoot.q: Past Perfect Continuous nimani bildiradi?
kahoot.explain: had been + V-ing — o'tgandagi bir nuqtagacha DAVOM ETGAN jarayon.

kahoot.q: Small balls of ice falling from the sky are ___.
kahoot.explain: hail — do'l; frost — qirov, fog/mist — tuman.

kahoot.q: A long time with no rain is a ___.
kahoot.explain: drought — qurg'oqchilik; heatwave — jazirama davri.

kahoot.q: After the rain, we saw a beautiful ___ in the sky.
kahoot.explain: rainbow — kamalak.

kahoot.q: A very heavy rain is a ___.
kahoot.explain: downpour — jala; drizzle — shivalab yog'ayotgan yomg'ir.

kahoot.q: A snowstorm with very strong wind is a ___.
kahoot.explain: blizzard — qor bo'roni.

kahoot.q: Antonim: humid ↔ ?
kahoot.explain: humid — nam; dry — quruq. muggy — dim (sinonimga yaqin).

kahoot.q: The sky is completely grey with clouds. It's ___.
kahoot.explain: overcast — to'la bulutli.

kahoot.q: On TV, I watched the weather ___ for tomorrow.
kahoot.explain: weather forecast — ob-havo ma'lumoti.

lessons.title: Future Perfect Continuous + Revision
lessons.grammar_topic: FUTURE PERFECT CONTINUOUS (will have been + V-ing) + 7–12-darslar takrori
lessons.vocab_topic: Revision — vaqt ifodalari va perfect zamon so'zlari
lessons.book_ref: Asosiy material — shu reja (formula jadvali, mashqlar, matn). Ixtiyoriy qo'shimcha: Student's book IELTS 2.0, Lesson 13 — dars kitobsiz ham to'liq o'tiladi.
objectives: FPC (will have been + V-ing) ni tanib oladi va tanlaydi: 6 perfect zamon jadvalini to'g'ri to'ldiradi, 3 CCQ ga to'g'ri javob beradi.
'Vaqt ifodasi → zamon' mashqidagi 6 ifodadan kamida 5 tasiga mos zamonni topadi.
Progress test 2 uchun 7–13-dars formulalarini takrorlaydi: 'Zamonni tanlang (7–12 takror)' dagi 8 gapdan kamida 6 tasini to'g'ri tanlaydi.
Mini-vazifada vaqt ifodalari bilan 45–60 soniya gapiradi; Reading TRUE / FALSE / NOT GIVEN ning 5 bandidan kamida 4 tasini to'g'ri belgilaydi.
Kombinatsiya: FPC jadvalini (3 qator) 1 daqiqada kamida 4 marta aytadi (normativ).
materials: Formula jadvali — rejaning Grammatika bo'limi (grammar.formulas), proyektor yoki doska
Revision — vaqt ifodalari va perfect zamon so'zlari CORE 20 varag'i.
Kahoot: 'O'tgan dars Kahooti' tugmasi (12-dars savollari)
timeline: Salomlashish + kirish savoli
"How long have you been learning English?" — har o'quvchi: "I have been learning English for … years." Ustoz bugungi mavzuga ko'prik qiladi: "By June, I will have been teaching you for a year."
Kahoot — 12-dars takrori: Past Perfect Continuous + Weather
'O'tgan dars Kahooti' tugmasi (12-dars Kahooti: 20 savol, har biriga 15 soniya). Bugungi dars Kahootini ochmang — u 14-dars boshida o'ynaladi.
YOZMA NORMATIV — 12-dars lug'ati: Weather (CORE 20)
Ustoz 20 so'zni o'zbekcha aytadi, o'quvchi inglizchasini yozadi — 5 daqiqa; 1 daqiqa juftlikda CORE varag'i bilan tekshirish. 18–20 to'g'ri — 2 coin.
Uyga vazifa tekshiruvi
12-dars Mashq to'plami kaliti proyektorda, juftlikda tekshiriladi; ko'p xato qilingan 2 band doskada.
YANGI MAVZU — Future Perfect Continuous (tanib olish) + 6 perfect zamon

Formula jadvali (grammar.formulas): FPC — S + will have been + V-ing / won't have been + V-ing / Will + S + have been + V-ing? — 3 misol, faqat tanib olish. Keyin 6 perfect zamon (formulas 4–6): SIMPLE = natija/son, CONTINUOUS = jarayon/qancha vaqt. Presentation juftlikda. + 3 CCQ (grammar.notes).
Revision — vaqt ifodalari va perfect zamon so'zlari — CORE 20
Ustoz ifodani aytadi, o'quvchilar takrorlaydi; har o'quvchi 2–3 ifoda bilan mos zamonda gap aytadi (so far → I have … so far).
Kombinatsiya

Kombinatsiya — o'quvchi bugungi formula jadvalini (tasdiq → inkor → savol, har qatorga 1 misol + o'zbekcha tarjima) yoddan, to'xtamasdan aytib chiqadi va 1 daqiqada necha marta to'liq aytgani sanaladi. Bugun: S + will have been + V-ing / S + won't have been + V-ing / Will + S + have been + V-ing? Juftlikda: biri aytadi, biri sanaydi. 1 daqiqada 3 marta — warm-up, 4 marta — normativ, 5 marta — 2 coin.
Sinf mashqlari

Majburiy: Oltita perfect zamon (5 daq, yakka), Zamonni tanlang (7–12 takror) (6 daq, yakka), Vaqt ifodasi → zamon (5 daq, juftlik), Mini-vazifa: Ingliz tili va rejalarim (7 daq, juftlik). ZAXIRA: will have been + V-ing, Xatoni toping.
Reading
1-o'qish — umumiy mazmun; keyin zamonlarni topish, TRUE / FALSE / NOT GIVEN (5 band), 3 qisqa savol.
PT2 FORMATI BILAN TANISHUV
'PT2 formati bilan tanishuv' mashqi: A–E namuna bandlari — 8 daqiqa yakka, 4 daqiqa kalit bilan tekshirish; 3 daqiqa — test tuzilmasi va writing_a2 rubrikasi bilan tanishuv. Test — 14-dars boshida.
Xatolar ustida ishlash + exit ticket

Ko'p uchragan 3–4 xato doskada (grammar.mistakes). Oxirgi 3 daqiqa — Exit ticket. ZAXIRA: Listening — vaqt qolsa, xatolar bosqichi o'rnida (ustoz transcript'ni 2 marta o'qiydi: 1-marta gist savol, 2-marta topshiriqlar).
Uyga vazifa
Mashq to'plami, Progress Test 2 ga tayyorgarlik, ovozli normativ; qo'shimcha — yozma ish (Mening 2035-yilim) va tarjima. Test — 14-dars boshida.

intro: Future Perfect Continuous — kelajakdagi nuqtaga kelib QANCHA VAQT davom etgan bo'lishini aytadi: "By 2027 I will have been studying English for 3 years."
Formula: will have been + V-ing. Ko'pincha: by + vaqt / by the time + Present Simple + for + davr.
Perfect oilasi: have V3 / have been Ving (Present); had V3 / had been Ving (Past); will have V3 / will have been Ving (Future).
Qoida bitta: SIMPLE = natija/son; CONTINUOUS = jarayon/qancha vaqt.
formulas: I will have been studying English for 2 years by 2027.
2027-yilga kelib 2 yildan beri ingliz tili o'rganayotgan bo'laman.
I won't have been waiting for two hours by the time they come.
Ular kelguncha ikki soat kutayotgan bo'lmayman.
Will you have been working for that company for 2 years by 2027?
2027-yilga kelib o'sha kompaniyada 2 yildan beri ishlayotgan bo'lasanmi?
Takror: Present Perfect / Present Perfect Continuous
I have written 3 letters. / I have been writing all day.
3 ta xat yozdim. / Kun bo'yi yozyapman.
Takror: Past Perfect / Past Perfect Continuous
I had written 3 letters by noon. / I had been writing for 2 hours when you called.
Tushgacha 3 xat yozgan edim. / Sen qo'ng'iroq qilganingda 2 soatdan beri yozayotgan edim.
Takror: Future Perfect / Future Perfect Continuous
will have + V3 / will have been + V-ing
By 5 I will have written 3 letters. / By 5 I will have been writing for 3 hours.
5 gacha 3 xat yozib bo'laman. / 5 ga kelib 3 soatdan beri yozayotgan bo'laman.
presentation: How long will you have been learning English by next summer?
I will have been learning it for three years.
By the time the coach comes, how long will the team have been training?
They will have been training for an hour.
How long has Ronaldo been playing football?
He has been playing professionally since 2002.
By 2027, how long will he have been playing?
He will have been playing for 25 years.
How many countries have you visited so far?
I have visited two so far.
By the end of the year, how many books will you have read?
I will have read ten books.
notes: A2 darajada FPC faqat TANIB OLISH uchun: formula + 3 misol; o'quvchi gapdagi shaklni topadi va tanlaydi, erkin gap tuzish talab qilinmaydi (kuchlilar uchun — ZAXIRA mashq).
"by the time" — Present Simple bilan (will emas); "by then" = o'sha vaqtga kelib.
Vaqt ifodalari: so far / lately / recently / yet → Present Perfect; by the time / before / when (o'tgan) → Past Perfect; by 2030 / by then → Future Perfect.
Progress Test 2 (14-dars boshida, 40 daqiqa; 7–13-darslar): A Grammatika 30 · B Lug'at 20 · C Tarjima 10 · D Reading 20 · E Writing 20 = 100 ball.
CCQ: By 2027 I will have been studying English for 3 years. — Am I studying English now? (Yes) — Will I still be studying in 2027? (Yes) — Is it about how long or how many? (How long)
CCQ: By Friday I will have written three essays. / By Friday I will have been writing essays for a week. — Which sentence tells us how many? (The first) — Which tells us how long? (The second)
CCQ: I had been waiting for an hour when the bus came. / By 6 pm I will have been waiting for an hour. — Which one is about the past? (The first) — Which one is about the future? (The second)
mistakes: I will have been study for 2 years.
I will have been studying for 2 years.
By the time you will come, I will have been waiting.
I will have been known him for 10 years.
I will have known him for 10 years.
By 2030 I have been living here for 20 years.
By 2030 I will have been living here…

how: CORE 20 — perfect zamonlar bilan keladigan vaqt ifodalari; STRONG — bog'lovchi va ketma-ketlik so'zlari (ixtiyoriy, +1 coin); SUPER — 7–12-darslardan qiyin so'zlar takrori.
Har ifodaga o'quvchi mos zamon bilan gap tuzadi: "so far → I have … so far".
core: I have read 50 pages so far.
Have you seen any good films lately?
Come at 8 — I will have finished by then.
By the time you read this, I will have left.
Sen buni o'qiguncha men ketib bo'lgan bo'laman.
I'll cook; in the meantime, set the table.
Men ovqat pishiraman; shu orada dasturxon yoz.
We met in 2020 and have been friends ever since.
Up to now, nobody has complained.
I haven't seen you for ages!
It has been raining all day long.
She had been ill the whole week.
It's 9 o'clock — he has probably arrived by now.
Soat 9 bo'ldi — u hozirga kelib yetib kelgan bo'lsa kerak.
I had bought the tickets the day before.
Chiptalarni bir kun oldin sotib olgan edim.
I had never flown before that day.
After he had left, we talked.
When I arrived, they had gone.
Men kelganimda ular ketib bo'lgan edi.
While I was cooking, he called.
Men ovqat pishirayotganimda u qo'ng'iroq qildi.
I'll call as soon as I land.
How long had you been waiting?
strong: First I woke up, then I had breakfast, and finally I left.
Avval uyg'ondim, keyin nonushta qildim, nihoyat chiqdim.
Meanwhile, the storm had been getting stronger.
Ayni paytda bo'ron kuchayib borgan edi.
He had previously worked in a bank.
Afterwards, we went for a walk.
At that time, I had been living in Bukhara for a year.
O'sha paytda Buxoroda bir yildan beri yashayotgan edim.
These days everybody has been talking about AI.
Bu kunlarda hamma sun'iy intellekt haqida gapiryapti.
In ten years' time I will have become a doctor.
O'n yildan keyin shifokor bo'lib bo'laman.
By the end of the year, I will have saved $1000.
At last, the rain has stopped.
Once I had finished, I felt relieved.
I have been to Samarkand twice.
U bir necha marta qo'ng'iroq qildi.
This is the first time I have eaten sushi.
The last time I saw him was in May.
Uni oxirgi marta mayda ko'rgan edim.
I have seen a lot of changes in my lifetime.
By 2030 she will have been teaching for 20 years — a long career!
2030-yilga kelib u 20 yildan beri o'qituvchilik qilayotgan bo'ladi — uzoq faoliyat!
Her biggest achievement has been the Olympic gold.
Uning eng katta yutug'i — Olimpiya oltini.
My goal is to get 7.0 by 2027.
super: She is more attractive than her sister.
The goalkeeper is tall and well-built.
Darvozabon baland bo'yli va baquvvat qomatli.
He is my most reliable friend.
My brother is the most stubborn person in our family.
Our neighbours are the most hospitable people I know.
Qo'shnilarimiz men biladigan eng mehmondo'st odamlar.
The symptoms had started a week before.
Alomatlar bir hafta oldin boshlangan edi.
The doctor had written a prescription.
I'll be relieved when the test has finished.
He was disappointed with his score.
She is anxious about the results.
She became a citizen after five years.
U besh yildan keyin fuqaro bo'ldi.
A thunderstorm had been coming closer all afternoon.
Tushdan keyin momaqaldiroq yaqinlashib kelgan edi.
The drought had been going on for months.
It had been freezing all night.
He became a professional player at 17.
normativ: Normativ — belgilangan vaqt ichida bajariladigan o'lchovli me'yor (lug'at yoki formula); me'yorni bajargan o'quvchi rejadagi coin'ni oladi.
Ovozli (uyda): CORE 20 + tarjima, 1.5 daqiqa — 1 coin. Bu CORE 20 ning yozma tekshiruvi — 14-darsda Progress Test 2 ning B bo'limida. STRONG — ixtiyoriy, +1 coin.

Present Perfect Continuous

Past Perfect Continuous

class_ex.title: Zamonni tanlang (7–12 takror)
class_ex.instr: To'g'ri variantni tanlang
items: I have read / had read 50 pages so far.
By the time we arrived, the film had started / has started.
By 2030 she will have finished / will finish university.

by then (kelajak)

class_ex.title: Mini-vazifa: Ingliz tili va rejalarim (IELTS Part 1)
class_ex.instr: Juftlikda: har savolga 45–60 soniya javob — kamida 2 ta PP/PPC va 1 ta Future Perfect gap, vaqt ifodalari bilan. Sherik sanaydi, keyin almashasiz.
items: How long have you been learning English?
What are your plans for this year?
answers: Namuna: I've been learning English for three years so far. Ever since I started, I've been watching cartoons in English. By now I have finished two courses.
Namuna: By the end of the year, I will have finished IELTS 2.0, and by then I will have read five English books. In the meantime, I'm learning new words every day.
class_ex.note: Mezon: speaking_mini rubrikasi, 3 × 0–2. Yordam: I've been learning … for … / So far I have … / By the end of this year I will have … Qo'shimcha: kuchlilar 1 ta FPC gap qo'shadi.

class_ex.title: PT2 formati bilan tanishuv
class_ex.instr: Har bo'limdan namuna bandni yakka bajaring (8 daqiqa), keyin kalit bilan tekshiring (haqiqiy test savollari emas).
box: Progress Test 2: 14-dars boshida, 40 daqiqa, 100 ball — A Grammatika 30 · B Lug'at 20 · C Tarjima 10 · D Reading 20 · E Writing 20. O'tish: jami kamida 70 ball va har bo'limda kamida 40%.
E bo'lim — writing_a2 rubrikasi (4 × 0–5): topshiriqni bajarish · grammatika · lug'at va imlo · tuzilish va bog'lovchilar.
items: A1 — Tanlang: My brother is ___ than me. (more tall / taller / the tallest)
A2 — Qavsdagi fe'lni to'g'ri shaklda yozing: By the time the doctor arrived, the pain ___ (stop).
B — Inglizchasini yozing: 1) hayajonlangan, zavqlangan 2) bulutli
C — Inglizchaga tarjima qiling: «Men Samarqandga borishimdan oldin hech qachon Registonni ko'rmagan edim.»

D — Matn: "Kamola has been living in Bukhara since 2020. Before she moved there, she had lived in Nukus for ten years. By next year, she will have been teaching at a music school for five years." TRUE / FALSE / NOT GIVEN: 1) Kamola lived in Nukus before she moved to Bukhara. 2) Kamola has lived in Bukhara for ten years. 3) Kamola teaches the piano.
E — Writing (60–70 so'z): Write about a time when you were ill. What had happened before? How did you feel? Use 1 comparative and 1 Past Perfect sentence.
answers: I had never seen the Registan before I went to Samarkand.

Namuna: Last winter I caught a bad cold. The day before, I had been playing football in the snow without a hat. In the morning I had a high temperature, and I felt worse than ever. The doctor gave me some medicine. After I had stayed in bed for three days, I recovered. Mezon: writing_a2 rubrikasi (4 × 0–5).

class_ex.title: ZAXIRA: will have been + V-ing
class_ex.instr: Qavsdagi fe'l bilan Future Perfect Continuous
items: By 2027 I ___ (study) English for three years.
By the time the coach comes, they ___ (train) for an hour.
Next month she ___ (work) at the company for ten years.
By 6 o'clock we ___ (wait) for two hours.

class_ex.title: ZAXIRA: Xatoni toping
class_ex.instr: Har gapda 1 xato
items: By 2027 I will have been study here for 3 years.
By the time you will arrive, I will have been waiting for an hour.
I will have been knowing him for 10 years.
She will has been working here for a year.
answers: I will have known him for 10 years.

class_ex.title: Exit ticket
class_ex.instr: 3 band — yakka, 3 daqiqa.
items: Tanlang: By 2028 my dad ___ in this bank for 20 years. (will have been working / has been working)
To'ldiring: I have read three chapters so ___. (hozirgacha)
O'zingiz gap tuzing: "by then" yoki "by the end of this year" bilan Future Perfect gap.
answers: Namuna: By the end of this year, I will have finished this course.
class_ex.note: 3 dan 2 tasi to'g'ri — maqsadga erishildi.

homework_intro: Normativ — belgilangan vaqt ichida bajariladigan o'lchovli me'yor (lug'at yoki formula); me'yorni bajargan o'quvchi rejadagi coin'ni oladi.

Uyga vazifa: 3 majburiy band (~40 daq) + 2 qo'shimcha. Ovozli normativni 14-darsdan oldin yuboring. 14-dars boshida Progress Test 2 (40 daqiqa, 7–13-darslar) — Mashq to'plamini o'zingiz kalit bilan solishtirasiz.

homework.title: MAJBURIY: Mashq to'plami (~15 daq)
homework.instr: Qavsdagi fe'lni to'g'ri perfect zamonda yozing; 'Tanlang' bandlarida to'g'ri variantni tanlang.
items: I ___ (already / finish) my homework, so I can go out now.
When we got to the station, the train ___ (leave).
By next June, my brother ___ (finish) school.
Tanlang: By 2030 my parents ___ in this house for 25 years. (will have been living / have been living)
Tanlang: Look! It ___ all morning — the streets are wet. (has been raining / will have been raining)
Tanlang: By the time you ___ home, I will have cooked dinner. (get / will get)
I ___ (not / see) my cousin since he moved to Tashkent.
How long ___ you ___ (learn) English? — For two years.
Tanlang: By 5 pm tomorrow we ___ for three hours. (will have been driving / had been driving)
Aziz was tired because he ___ (train) all afternoon.

homework.title: MAJBURIY: Progress Test 2 ga tayyorgarlik (~20 daq)
homework.instr: Test 14-dars boshida, 40 daqiqa, 7–13-darslar. Formulalarni (box) va CORE 20 varaqlarini takrorlang, har bo'limdan bitta namuna savolni bajaring.
box: 7–8-dars: comparative (-er than / more … than / as … as); superlative (the -est / the most …)
9-dars: Past Perfect — had + V3; 10-dars: Future Perfect — will have + V3
11-dars: before / after / by the time / as soon as / since (kelajakda — Present Simple)
12-dars: Past Perfect Continuous — had been + V-ing; 13-dars: FPC — will have been + V-ing (faqat tanlash)
Lug'at: 7–13-darslar CORE 20 (appearance, character, health, emotions, countries, weather, vaqt ifodalari)
items: A (Grammatika) — tanlang: Samarkand is ___ city I have ever visited. (the most beautiful / more beautiful / most beautiful)
B (Lug'at) — inglizchasini yozing: harorat
C (Tarjima) — inglizchaga: «Biz kelganimizda dars allaqachon boshlangan edi.»

D (Reading) — "Otabek is from Fergana. He had been working as a taxi driver for five years before he opened a small cafe in 2022." TRUE / FALSE / NOT GIVEN: Otabek opened his cafe before he became a taxi driver.
E (Writing) — 60–70 so'z: Describe the weather in your town in winter and in summer. Use 1 comparative, 1 superlative and 1 Past Perfect sentence.
answers: When we arrived, the lesson had already started.

Namuna: In my town, summer is much hotter than winter. July is the hottest month. Last January was colder than usual. One morning I saw snow! It had snowed all night, and the streets were white. I had never seen so much snow before. Mezon: writing_a2 rubrikasi (4 × 0–5).

homework.title: MAJBURIY: Ovozli normativ — vaqt ifodalari CORE 20 (~5 daq)
homework.instr: CORE 20 ifoda + o'zbekcha tarjima, 1.5 daqiqada; Jony Student ilovasiga ovozli yuboring (14-darsgacha).
homework.answers: Mezon: 20 so'zdan kamida 18 tasi to'g'ri talaffuz va tarjima bilan, 1.5 daqiqada

homework.title: QO'SHIMCHA: Yozma ish — Mening 2035-yilim (~10 daq)
homework.instr: 6–8 gap: 3 ta Future Perfect, 2 ta Past Perfect (hozirgi hayotingiz haqida); kuchlilar — yana 2 ta Future Perfect Continuous gap.
answers: Namuna: By 2035 I will have finished university. I will have got a job as an engineer, and by then I will have been working for three years. I will have visited five countries. Before I came to Jony Academy, I had studied English at school for two years.
Mezon: mini_writing rubrikasi (3 × 0–2) — zamonlar to'g'ri, 6–8 gap, kamida 3 ta vaqt ifodasi.

homework.title: QO'SHIMCHA: Tarjima (~5 daq)
homework.instr: O'zbekchadan inglizchaga (perfect zamonlar).
items: 2027-yilga kelib men uch yildan beri ingliz tili o'rganayotgan bo'laman.
Ronaldo 900 dan ortiq gol urgan.

reading.title: Cristiano Ronaldo — 25 years of football
text: Cristiano Ronaldo was born in 1985 on the island of Madeira, Portugal. His family was not rich. He had been playing football for small local teams for several years before Sporting, a big club in Lisbon, noticed him. At 12, he left his family and moved to Lisbon to train there.

By the time he was 18, he had already signed for Manchester United. Since then, he has played for Real Madrid, Juventus and Al-Nassr in Saudi Arabia. In 2024 he scored his 900th official goal, and he has broken many records.

Ronaldo is famous for his discipline and hard work. For more than twenty years, young players all over the world have been watching him and copying his training. Many coaches say the same thing: talent is not enough without hard work.
He has also been generous. He has given money to hospitals and children's charities. Many young people in Uzbekistan follow him online, and he has hundreds of millions of followers on social media.

By 2027, Ronaldo will have been playing professional football for 25 years. Will he have retired by 2030? Nobody knows — but by then he will have been an example for young players for a whole generation.

lessons.title: General vs Special Questions
lessons.grammar_topic: UMUMIY va MAXSUS SAVOLLAR (Yes/No — Wh-questions), barcha zamonlarda
lessons.book_ref: Asosiy material — shu reja (formula jadvali, mashqlar, matn). Ixtiyoriy qo'shimcha: Student's book IELTS 2.0, Lesson 14 — dars kitobsiz ham to'liq o'tiladi.
objectives: Progress Test 2 (7–13-darslar) ni 40 daqiqada yakka yozadi; tahlilda o'z xatolarini belgilaydi.
Yes/No savolni zamonga mos yordamchi fe'l (do/does/did, am/is/are/was/were, have/has/had, will) bilan tuzadi: 6 ta gapdan kamida 5 tasini to'g'ri savolga aylantiradi.
Wh-savolni to'g'ri tartibda (Wh + yordamchi + ega + fe'l) tuzadi: 6 ta ajratilgan qismdan kamida 5 tasiga to'g'ri savol beradi.
Ega savolini (Who broke the window?) ob'ekt savolidan (Who did you call?) farqlaydi: exit ticket'da 3 banddan kamida 2 tasi to'g'ri.
Jinoyat CORE 20 bilan to'qima detektiv so'roqda 8 ta savol (4 umumiy, 4 maxsus) beradi va javob oladi.
Kombinatsiya: savol jadvalini (tasdiq → umumiy savol → maxsus savol) 1 daqiqada kamida 4 marta aytadi (normativ).
materials: Formula jadvali — rejaning Grammatika bo'limi (grammar.formulas), proyektor yoki doska
Crime (jinoyat) CORE 20 varag'i.
Kahoot: 'O'tgan dars Kahooti' tugmasi (13-dars savollari)
Progress Test 2 varag'i (A/B variant) va kaliti — test paketi 'pt2'
timeline: Salomlashish + test yo'riqnomasi
Salomlashish (1 daq). Yo'riqnoma (2 daq): telefonlar yig'iladi, partalar ajratiladi; varaqlar A/B variantda; 40 daqiqa, 5 bo'lim (A–E); javob faqat varaqqa, ruchka bilan; savol bo'lsa qo'l ko'taring.
Kahoot — 13-dars takrori: Future Perfect Continuous + Revision: vaqt ifodalari va perfect zamon so'zlari
'O'tgan dars Kahooti' tugmasi (13-dars Kahooti: 20 savol, har biriga 15 soniya). Bugungi dars Kahootini ochmang — u 15-dars boshida o'ynaladi.
TEST — Progress Test 2 (7–13-darslar)

40 daqiqa, yakka, qog'ozda. Varaq: test paketi 'pt2' (A/B variant — qo'shni partalarga har xil); kalit faqat ustozda. Bo'limlar: A Grammatika 30 · B Lug'at 20 · C Tarjima 10 · D Reading 20 · E Writing 20 = 100 ball. Vaqt: A 10 · B 5 · C 5 · D 10 · E 10 daqiqa.
TEST TAHLILI — Progress Test 2

Varaqlar yig'ilgach: A–C bo'limlari kaliti proyektorda, o'quvchi o'z qoralamasi bo'yicha xatosini belgilaydi; eng ko'p uchragan 3 xato doskada tushuntiriladi. D–E ni ustoz 2 kun ichida tekshirib, natijani tizimga kiritadi; o'tish qoidasi test paketida.
YANGI MAVZU — Umumiy va maxsus savollar (Yes/No va Wh-questions)

Formula jadvali (grammar.formulas): umumiy — yordamchi + S + V? (Are you working? Do you speak English? Will you go?); maxsus — savol so'zi + yordamchi + S + V? (Where are you working? When do you speak English?); yordamchi zamonga qarab: do/does/did, am/is/are/was/were, have/has/had, will; ega savoli — Who/What + V, yordamchisiz (Who broke the window?). Warm-up: ustoz "Somebody has taken my pen!" deydi — sinf detektiv savollari beradi (Did you leave it here? When did you last see it?). Presentation'dan 3 juftlikni ustoz modellaydi, qolgani juftlikda savol-javob zanjiri. + 3 CCQ (grammar.notes).
Crime (jinoyat) — CORE 20
Ustoz aytadi, sinf takrorlaydi + tarjima (har so'zga ~20 soniya); robbery – robber – rob uchligi; 5–6 so'z bilan savol (vocab.core misollari). Faqat to'qima voqealar — vocab.how dagi eslatma.
Kombinatsiya

Kombinatsiya — o'quvchi bugungi formula jadvalini (tasdiq → inkor → savol, har qatorga 1 misol + o'zbekcha tarjima) yoddan, to'xtamasdan aytib chiqadi va 1 daqiqada necha marta to'liq aytgani sanaladi. Bugun: S + V (They caught the thief.) / Did + S + V1? (Did they catch the thief?) / Wh + did + S + V1? (When did they catch the thief?) — tasdiq → umumiy savol → maxsus savol, har qatorga o'zbekcha tarjima. Juftlikda: biri aytadi, biri sanaydi. 1 daqiqada 3 marta — warm-up, 4 marta — normativ, 5 marta — 2 coin.
Sinf mashqlari

Majburiy: Umumiy savol tuzing (6 daq, yakka), Maxsus savol tuzing (6 daq, yakka + juftlikda tekshirish), Detektiv so'roq (8 daq, juftlik). ZAXIRA: Who — ega yoki ob'ekt?, Jinoyat — jinoyatchi — fe'l, Xatoni toping.
Xatolar ustida ishlash + exit ticket
Ko'p uchragan xatolar doskada (Where you live? / Did she went? / Who did steal? / What means…? — grammar.mistakes) — 4 daqiqa; oxirgi 3 daqiqa: Exit ticket (class_ex oxirida), yakka, varaqqa.
Uyga vazifa
Test darsi bo'lgani uchun Reading va mini-vazifa uyga o'tadi: MAJBURIY — Mashq to'plami, Reading, Intervyu, Ovozli normativ (~45 daq); QO'SHIMCHA — Tarjima.

intro: Umumiy savol (Yes/No): YORDAMCHI + EGA + FE'L: Do you live here? Has she called? Will they come?
Maxsus savol: SAVOL SO'ZI + yordamchi + ega + fe'l: Where do you live? Why has she called?
Yordamchi fe'l zamonga qarab: Present Simple — do/does; Past Simple — did; Continuous — am/is/are/was/were; Perfect — have/has/had; Future — will.
Ega savoli: Who / What + fe'l (yordamchisiz): Who stole the car? What happened?
formulas: Are you working? / Do you speak English? / Will you go with us?
Ishlayapsanmi? / Inglizcha gapirasanmi? / Biz bilan borasanmi?
Where are you working? / When do you speak English? / Why will you go?
Qayerda ishlayapsan? / Qachon inglizcha gapirasan? / Nega borasan?
Did + S + V1? / Wh + did + S + V1?
Did the police catch the thief? / When did they catch him?
Has anyone seen the robber? / What had he stolen?
Kimdir o'g'rini ko'rdimi? / U nima o'g'irlagan edi?
Who broke the window? / What happened?
Who are you waiting for? / What are you looking at?
presentation: Did you hear about the robbery last night?
Yes, I did. It was on the news.
Where did it happen?
It happened at the bank on Navoi Street.
Have the police caught the robbers yet?
No, they haven't caught them yet.
How many people were there?
There were three men.
Who saw them?
A taxi driver saw them.
What were they wearing?
They were wearing black masks.
Will the bank open tomorrow?
Yes, it will open at nine.
Were you scared when you heard the news?
Yes, I was a bit scared.
How long had they been planning it?
The police think they had been planning it for months.
What are you going to do now?
I'm going to lock my door!
notes: Savol so'zlari: what, which, who, whom, whose, where, when, why, how, how long/many/much/often/far.
"Who" ega bo'lsa — yordamchi yo'q: Who called? Who stole it? Lekin ob'ekt bo'lsa: Who did you call?
Qisqa javob yordamchi bilan: Did he? — Yes, he did. / Has she? — No, she hasn't.
Yangiliklar tili: A man has been arrested. The police are looking for… Detektiv savollari: Where were you at 9 pm?
the police — doim ko'plik: The police are / have … (Have the police caught the robbers? Are the police looking for him?).
CCQ: Did they catch the thief? / Where did they catch him? — Can we answer the first with 'Yes/No'? (Yes) — The second? (No — we need a place)
CCQ: Who called the police? — Do we know who called? (No) — Is 'Who' the person who did the action? (Yes) — Is there 'did'? (No)
CCQ: Who did you call? — Who made the call? (You) — Do we ask about the person you called? (Yes) — Do we need 'did'? (Yes)

how: CORE 20 — jinoyat–jinoyatchi–fe'l uchliklari; STRONG — sud, jazo va ko'cha xavfsizligi; SUPER — zamonaviy jinoyatlar (cyber, fraud, scam).
Uchlik: robbery – robber – to rob. Har so'zga to'qima voqea haqida savol: "Who robbed the bank?" / "What did the thief steal?"

Ustozga eslatma: murder, murderer, attack, assault, go to prison — faqat tanishtiriladi, to'qima voqealar (yangilik, film) misolida; o'quvchi yoki oilasining jinoyat tajribasi haqida shaxsiy savol berilmaydi, sinfdoshlar 'gumondor' deb ko'rsatilmaydi.

class_ex.title: Progress Test 2 (7–13-darslar): ustoz uchun o'tkazish tartibi va ball jadvali
class_ex.instr: Test 40 daqiqa, 100 ball, 5 bo'lim. Asosiy test — A variant; B variant qayta topshirish uchun saqlanadi (ikkala variant bir xil tuzilma va qiyinlikda). Agar guruh katta bo'lib, qo'shni partalarga A/B aralash tarqatilsa (14-dars rejasidagi imkoniyat), B variant yozgan o'quvchi qayta topshirishda A variantning o'sha bo'lim(lar)ini yozadi.
items: 1. Dars oldidan: A variantdan har o'quvchiga 1 nusxa (A–E bo'limlar, E bo'lim uchun chiziqli joy bilan), guruh uchun 1 ta ball varag'i chop eting. B variantni chop etib, papkada saqlang (A/B aralash tarqatilsa — ikkalasidan kerakli sonda). Kalit sahifalarini o'quvchilarga bermang; test tugaguncha proyektorga chiqarmang.
2. Salomlashish bosqichi (3 daq): proyektorga faqat 'O'quvchi uchun yo'riqnoma' ni chiqaring va o'qib bering. Telefon, lug'at va daftarlar sumkaga olinadi; o'quvchilar alohida-alohida o'tiradi.
3. Kahoot (8 daq, 13-dars takrori) — testdan oldingi isinish. Keyin varaqlarni yuzini pastga qilib tarqating va taymerni proyektorga chiqaring (40:00).

4. Vaqt taqsimoti (ustoz ovoz chiqarib e'lon qiladi): 0–10 daq — A. Grammatika; 10–15 — B. Lug'at; 15–20 — C. Tarjima; 20–30 — D. Reading; 30–40 — E. Writing. Har bo'lim vaqti tugashidan 1 daqiqa oldin ogohlantiring.

5. Test paytida savollarga javob bermang (faqat topshiriq tushunarsiz bo'lsa, o'zbekcha ko'rsatmani qayta o'qib bering). Gaplashish yoki ko'chirishni ko'rsangiz — ogohlantiring; takrorlansa ishni yig'ib oling va holatni ball varag'iga yozing.

6. 40:00 tugagach varaqlarni yig'ing. TEST TAHLILI (10 daq): faqat A–C bo'limlar kalitini proyektorga chiqaring (A/B aralash yozilgan bo'lsa — ikkala variantniki; D va E kaliti ko'rsatilmaydi — ularni ustoz 2 kun ichida tekshiradi); eng ko'p xato qilingan 3–4 savolni doskada tahlil qiling (ballar keyin aytiladi).

7. Tekshirish (dars tugagach, 48 soat ichida): A — har savol 2 yoki 0 (9–15 da to'g'ri zamon, lekin bitta harf imlo xatosi — 1; kalitda ' / ' bilan berilgan har bir variant to'liq to'g'ri; A12 va B12 dagi Past Simple — 1, qarang: why); B — 1 / 0.5 (bitta harf xatosi) / 0; C — har gap 1 (zamon/qolip) + 1 (so'z tartibi va lug'at); D — har savol 2.5 yoki 0 (qisqa javob 3 so'zdan oshsa — 0; ma'noni buzmaydigan imlo xatosi — ball beriladi); E — writing_a2 rubrikasi, 4 mezon × 0–5.
8. Natijani tizimga bo'limlar kesimida kiriting (A, B, C, D, E alohida + jami) va 15-darsda har o'quvchiga natija hamda keyingi qadamni ayting.
class_ex.answers: BALL → NATIJA → KEYINGI QADAM. (1) Jami 70–100 VA har bo'limda chegara bajarilgan (A ≥ 12, B ≥ 8, C ≥ 4, D ≥ 8, E ≥ 8) → O'TDI → kurs odatdagidek davom etadi; ball tizimga kiritiladi. (2) Jami 70 va undan yuqori, lekin biror bo'lim chegaradan past → QAYTA TOPSHIRISH → 7 kun ichida B variantdan faqat o'sha bo'lim(lar) qayta yoziladi. Yangi jami = eski jami − bo'limning eski bali + yangi bali, CHEKLOVSIZ (70 ga tushirilmaydi); ball varag'ida faqat chegara bajarilgani belgilanadi. (3) Jami 50–69 → QAYTA TOPSHIRISH → 7 kun ichida B variantdan past bo'limlar qayta yoziladi: chegaradan past bo'limlar va o'z maksimumining 70% idan kam olingan bo'limlar (A < 21, B < 14, C < 7, D < 14, E < 14). Yangi jami = eski jami − qayta yozilgan bo'limlarning eski bali + yangi bali; qayta topshirishdan keyingi jami 70 dan yuqori hisoblanmaydi. (4) Jami 50 dan kam → REMEDIAL → ustoz 2 ta qo'shimcha mashg'ulot o'tkazadi (har biri 30 daqiqa, eng zaif bo'limlar bo'yicha: masalan A past bo'lsa — 7–13-dars formulalari, D past bo'lsa — T/F/NG strategiyasi), so'ng B variant to'liq (40 daqiqa) qayta yoziladi; bu natija ham 70 dan yuqori hisoblanmaydi. 70 lik cheklov faqat (3) va (4)-holatlarga tegishli. Qayta topshirishdan keyin ham jami 70 dan past qolsa yoki biror bo'lim chegarasi bajarilmasa — ustoz o'quv bo'limiga xabar beradi. Natija (asosiy va qayta topshirish) tizimga bo'limlar kesimida kiritiladi.
class_ex.note: Vaqt manbai: 14-dars SHABLON T — 3 salomlashish + yo'riqnoma | 8 Kahoot | 40 TEST | 10 TEST TAHLILI | 15 yangi mavzu | 8 CORE 20 | 4 Kombinatsiya | 20 sinf mashqlari | 7 xatolar + exit ticket | 5 uyga vazifa = 120.

class_ex.title: O'quvchi uchun yo'riqnoma — Progress Test 2 (1 sahifa)
class_ex.type: Proyektorga chiqariladi va test varag'ining 1-sahifasida chop etiladi
class_ex.instr: Test boshlanishidan oldin diqqat bilan o'qing.
items: 1. Test 40 daqiqa davom etadi va 5 bo'limdan iborat: A. Grammatika — 30 ball (10 daq); B. Lug'at — 20 ball (5 daq); C. Tarjima — 10 ball (5 daq); D. Reading — 20 ball (10 daq); E. Writing — 20 ball (10 daq). Jami — 100 ball.
2. Test 7–13-darslarda o'tilgan grammatika va lug'atdan tuzilgan. Yangi mavzu yo'q.
3. Javoblarni ruchka bilan, faqat test varag'iga yozing. Tuzatmoqchi bo'lsangiz, eski javobni bir chiziq bilan o'chirib, yoniga yangisini yozing.
4. Telefon, lug'at va daftar sumkada turadi. Gaplashish va boshqa o'quvchining ishiga qarash mumkin emas: ustoz ogohlantiradi, takrorlansa ish yig'ib olinadi.
5. Ustoz har bo'lim vaqti tugaganini aytadi — keyingi bo'limga o'ting. Vaqt qolsa, oxirida javoblaringizni qayta tekshiring.

L7: 2+ bo'g'inli sifat → more + adj + than.

When her plane landed in Toronto, it had been snowing for two days. The weather was much colder than in Samarkand: the temperature was minus twenty degrees! By the time she got to her aunt's house, her hands were red and she was very tired. Nodira was delighted with the snow, but on the first evening she felt a little homesick.

On the third day she caught a cold. She had a cough and a headache, so her aunt gave her some medicine. After she had rested for two days, she recovered and went skating with her cousin, Emily. reading.title: An interview with Detective Aziza Karimova
text: Aziza Karimova, 29, is a detective in Tashkent. She has been a detective for six years. We asked her about her job.
Q: Did you always want to be a detective? — A: No, I didn't. At school I wanted to be a lawyer, but at university I changed my mind.
Q: What does a detective do? — A: We investigate crimes. We talk to victims and witnesses and look for evidence.
Q: Which crimes are common in the city? — A: Theft is the most common crime. Thieves steal phones on buses and in markets, and now there are a lot of online scams.
Q: Have you ever been scared at work? — A: Yes, once. Two years ago a robber ran into a shop with a knife. We caught him quickly, and nobody was hurt.
Q: Is an arrested person always guilty? — A: No. Sometimes the police arrest the wrong person, so a good detective checks everything.
Q: What will you do next year? — A: I will study cybercrime, because criminals are moving online.
Q: What is your advice to teenagers? — A: Never share your passwords. If someone steals your phone, call the police at once.
