kahoot.q: ___ the police catch the thief yesterday?
kahoot.explain: «yesterday» — Past Simple. Umumiy savol: Did + ega + V1 (catch).

kahoot.q: Where ___ you live?
kahoot.explain: Wh + yordamchi + ega + fe'l. you → do: Where do you live?

kahoot.q: Qaysi gap TO'G'RI?
kahoot.explain: Ega haqida savol (Who/What) — yordamchisiz: Who + V2 (stole).

kahoot.q: Qaysi gapda XATO bor?
kahoot.explain: did dan keyin fe'l 1-shaklda: Did she go home? (went emas).

kahoot.q: What ___ this word mean?
kahoot.explain: this word — u (3-shaxs birlik) → does + V1: What does this word mean?

kahoot.q: Has anyone ___ the robber?
kahoot.explain: Perfect savol: Has + ega + V3. see – saw – seen → seen.

kahoot.q: Tarjima qiling: «Politsiya o'g'rini qachon tutdi?»
options: When did the police catch the thief?
When the police caught the thief?
When did the police caught the thief?
When do the police catch the thief?
kahoot.explain: O'tgan zamon maxsus savol: When + did + ega + V1 (catch).

kahoot.q: Who ___ the window? — Tom broke it.
kahoot.explain: Ega savoli — yordamchisiz, fe'l V2: Who broke the window?

kahoot.q: Who are you waiting ___?
kahoot.explain: wait for — kutmoq. Predlog savol oxirida qoladi: Who are you waiting for?

kahoot.q: ___ you come with us to the court tomorrow?
kahoot.explain: «tomorrow» — kelajak: Will + ega + V1? (Will you come...?)

kahoot.q: Qaysi savolda so'z tartibi TO'G'RI?
options: Why has she called the police?
Why she has called the police?
Why has called she the police?
Why she called has the police?
kahoot.explain: Maxsus savol: Wh + yordamchi (has) + ega (she) + V3 (called).

kahoot.q: «You are a witness.» Umumiy savolga aylantiring.
kahoot.explain: to be bilan savol: yordamchi (are) egadan OLDINGA chiqadi: Are you...?

kahoot.q: A person who steals things from shops is a ___.
kahoot.explain: shoplifter — do'kondan o'g'irlovchi. burglar — uy o'g'risi, murderer — qotil.

kahoot.q: A burglar ___ our house last night and took the TV.
kahoot.explain: break into — buzib kirmoq. break down — buzilmoq, break up — ajrashmoq.

kahoot.q: The driver had to ___ a fine for speeding.
kahoot.explain: pay a fine — jarima to'lamoq. Doim «pay» bilan.

kahoot.q: Qaysi so'z «guilty» ning ANTONIMI?
kahoot.explain: guilty — aybdor, innocent — aybsiz. suspect — gumondor, victim — jabrlanuvchi.

kahoot.q: Three men ___ a bank in the city centre.
kahoot.explain: rob — kimnidir/joyni (bankni) talamoq; steal — narsani (pulni) o'g'irlamoq.

kahoot.q: A person who sees a crime and tells the police about it is a ___.
kahoot.explain: witness — guvoh. victim — jabrlanuvchi, judge — sudya.

kahoot.q: «dalil» — inglizcha qanday?
kahoot.explain: evidence — dalil. punishment — jazo, court — sud, arrest — hibsga olmoq.

kahoot.q: The police ___ the man and took him to the police station.
kahoot.explain: arrest — hibsga olmoq: politsiya odamni bo'limga olib ketadi. attack — hujum qilmoq, rob — talamoq, warn — ogohlantirmoq.

lessons.title: Conditionals Type 2 and 3
lessons.grammar_topic: CONDITIONALS 2–3 (if + Past Simple, would + V1 / if + Past Perfect, would have + V3)
lessons.book_ref: Asosiy material — shu reja (formula jadvali, mashqlar, matn). Ixtiyoriy qo'shimcha: Student's book IELTS 2.0, Lesson 15 — dars kitobsiz ham to'liq o'tiladi.
objectives: 2-tur shart gapini tuzadi (If + Past Simple, would + V1; If I were you, I would …): 'Type 2' mashqining 6 bandidan kamida 5 tasi to'g'ri; 5 ta sayohat muammosiga "If I were you…" maslahati.
3-tur shartni tanib oladi va faqat afsus qolipida ishlatadi (If I had + V3, I would have + V3): Type 1 / 2 / 3 tanlash mashqining 6 bandidan kamida 5 tasi to'g'ri; qolip bo'yicha 5 ta afsus gapi.
Sayohat CORE 20 bilan IELTS Part 2 mini-kartochkasiga ("Describe a trip you would like to take") 1 daqiqa gapiradi, kamida 3 ta Type 2 gap bilan.
Reading: Ibn Sino matnidagi 2 ta shart gapini topib turini aytadi; TRUE / FALSE / NOT GIVEN ning 5 bandidan kamida 4 tasi to'g'ri.
Kombinatsiya: Type 2 formula jadvalini (tasdiq → inkor → savol) 1 daqiqada kamida 4 marta (normativ) aytadi.
materials: Formula jadvali — rejaning Grammatika bo'limi (grammar.formulas), proyektor yoki doska
Travelling (sayohat) CORE 20 varag'i.
Kahoot: 'O'tgan dars Kahooti' tugmasi (14-dars savollari)
timeline: Salomlashish + kirish savoli
"If you won a free ticket, where would you go?" — 3–4 o'quvchi bitta gap bilan javob beradi: "If I won a free ticket, I would go to …".
Kahoot — 14-dars takrori: General vs Special Questions + Crime
'O'tgan dars Kahooti' tugmasi (14-dars Kahooti: 20 savol, har biriga 15 soniya). Bugungi dars Kahootini ochmang — u 16-dars boshida o'ynaladi.
YOZMA NORMATIV — 14-dars lug'ati: Crime (CORE 20)
Ustoz 20 so'zni o'zbekcha aytadi, o'quvchi inglizchasini yozadi — 5 daqiqa; 1 daqiqa juftlikda CORE varag'i bilan tekshirish. 18–20 to'g'ri — 2 coin.
Uyga vazifa tekshiruvi
14-dars Mashq to'plami — kalit proyektorda, o'quvchi o'zi belgilaydi; 14-dars uyga o'tgan Reading va mini-vazifasidan 2–3 javob og'zaki tekshiriladi.
YANGI MAVZU — Conditionals Type 2 (+ Type 3 afsus qolipi)

Formula jadvali (grammar.formulas): Type 2 — If + Past Simple, S + would + V1 (hozirgi yoki kelajakdagi xayoliy holat; hamma shaxsga were: If I were you, I would …); if-gap keyin kelsa vergul qo'yilmaydi. Type 3 — faqat afsus qolipi: If I had + V3, I would have + V3 (o'tganda bo'lmagan, endi o'zgartirib bo'lmaydi) — tanib olish va 5–6 qolip gap. So'ng grammar.presentation: ustoz 1-, 2- va 7-juftlikni modellaydi (7-juftlik — yagona Type 3 afsus namunasi, uni faqat ustoz aytadi); qolgan 7 ta Type 2 juftligini o'quvchilar juftlikda savol-javob zanjiri qilib aytadi. + 3 CCQ (grammar.notes).
Travelling (sayohat) — CORE 20
Har so'z: talaffuz → tarjima → vocab misoli; o'quvchi so'z bilan 1 ta Type 2 gap aytadi ("If I had a ticket, I would …").
Kombinatsiya

Kombinatsiya — o'quvchi bugungi formula jadvalini (tasdiq → inkor → savol, har qatorga 1 misol + o'zbekcha tarjima) yoddan, to'xtamasdan aytib chiqadi va 1 daqiqada necha marta to'liq aytgani sanaladi. Bugun: If + S + V2, S + would + V1 / If + S + V2, S + wouldn't + V1 / Would + S + V1 + if + S + V2? (If I had time, I would travel. — Vaqtim bo'lsa, sayohat qilardim. / If I had time, I wouldn't stay at home. — Vaqtim bo'lsa, uyda o'tirmasdim. / Would you travel if you had time? — Vaqting bo'lsa, sayohat qilarmiding?) Juftlikda: biri aytadi, biri sanaydi. 1 daqiqada 3 marta — warm-up, 4 marta — normativ, 5 marta — 2 coin.
Sinf mashqlari
Majburiy: Type 2 (6 daq, yakka), Sayohat muammolari (6 daq, juftlik), Type 1, 2 yoki 3? (5 daq, yakka), Afsus (Type 3) (6 daq, yakka). ZAXIRA: Type 3, Xatoni toping.
Reading
Jony Academy matni (Ibn Sino): 1-o'qish — 2 ta shart gapini topish va turini aytish; 2-o'qish — TRUE / FALSE / NOT GIVEN; oxirida 'Agar…' (3 gap). Javoblar birga tekshiriladi.
Writing / speaking mini-vazifa

Mini-vazifa: A trip I would like to take — juftlikda 2 ta IELTS Part 1 savoli (3 daq); Part 2 mini-kartochka: 1 daqiqa tayyorgarlik + 1 daqiqa gapirish, keyin rollar almashadi (5 daq); sherik speaking_mini bo'yicha baholaydi, har kim 1 ta afsus gapi yozadi (4 daq).
Xatolar ustida ishlash + exit ticket

4 daqiqa: mini-vazifadagi eng ko'p uchragan 3 xato doskada (grammar.mistakes: if-gapda would, was → were, would have + V2); kuchlilarga STRONG so'zlar bilan 2 gap. Oxirgi 3 daqiqa: Exit ticket (class_ex oxirgi mashqi).
Uyga vazifa
Mashq to'plami, yozma ish va ovozli normativ — majburiy (ovozli normativ 16-darsgacha); tarjima va kartochkalar — qo'shimcha.

intro: Type 2 — HOZIR/KELAJAKDA xayoliy, real emas: "If I won the lottery, I would buy a mansion" (yutish ehtimoli kam).
Type 3 — O'TGANDA bo'lmagan, endi o'zgartirib bo'lmaydi: "If I had studied harder, I would have passed the exam."
"were" hamma shaxs uchun rasmiy: If I were you… If she were here…
Qiziquvchilar uchun: would o'rniga could/might: If I had time, I could travel. If they had left earlier, they might have caught the train.
formulas: If + Past Simple, S + would + V1
If I won the lottery, I would buy a mansion.
Lotereya yutsam, katta uy sotib olardim.
S + would + V1 + if + Past Simple
She would travel around the world if she had more time.
Vaqti ko'proq bo'lsa, u dunyo bo'ylab sayohat qilardi.
If + Past Perfect, S + would have + V3
If I had studied harder, I would have passed the exam.
S + would have + V3 + if + Past Perfect
They would have caught the train if they had arrived on time.
If I were you, I would + V1
If I were you, I would book the ticket now.
Sening o'rningda bo'lsam, chiptani hozir olardim.
What would you do if + Past Simple?
What would you do if you missed your flight?

notes: Type 1 (real): If it rains, we'll stay in. Type 2 (xayoliy): If it rained in the desert, plants would grow. Type 3 (o'tgan): If it had rained, the trip would have been cancelled.
"If I were you" — maslahat berishning eng tabiiy shakli.
Qisqa shakllar: I'd (would), I'd have (would have), wouldn't have.
Sayohat so'zlarini juftlab yodlang: check in / check out, set off / get back, take off / land.
CCQ: If I had a car, I would drive to Samarkand. — Do I have a car? (No) — Is this about now or the past? (Now)
CCQ: If I had studied, I would have passed. — Did I study? (No) — Did I pass? (No) — Past or present? (Past)
CCQ: If it rains tomorrow, we'll stay in. / If it rained in the desert, plants would grow. — Which sentence is real and possible? (the first) — Does it often rain in the desert? (No)
mistakes: If I would win, I would buy a car.
If I won, I would buy a car.
If I had studied, I would pass.
If I had studied, I would have passed.
If I was you, I would go.
If I were you, I would go.
If she had have money, she would travel.
If she had money, she would travel.

reading.title: Ibn Sina — the traveller who wrote the book of medicine
text: Abu Ali ibn Sina — known in Europe as Avicenna — was born in 980 near Bukhara. He was a child genius: by the age of ten he had learned the whole Quran, and at sixteen he was already treating patients as a doctor. When the ruler of Bukhara fell ill, the young Ibn Sina cured him. As a reward, he was allowed to use the palace library — a very large library with many rare books.

But his life was not easy. When the Samanid state fell, Ibn Sina had to leave Bukhara. For the rest of his life he was a traveller: he lived in Gurganj (Khorezm), Rey, Hamadan, Isfahan and other cities. He often worked at night, and he wrote some of his books on the road. Sometimes he was in prison; sometimes he was a minister.

His most famous book, "The Canon of Medicine", was an important medical textbook in Europe for hundreds of years. In it he described hundreds of medicines, and he wrote that some illnesses can pass from one person to another. He also wrote about philosophy, music, mathematics and astronomy — hundreds of works in total.

Ibn Sina died in 1037 in Hamadan. Today, many hospitals, schools and streets in Uzbekistan have his name. If he had stayed in one city with a quiet life, would he have written so much? Perhaps not. If he were alive today, he would probably be a scientist, a doctor and a traveller at the same time.

lessons.title: During vs While, If vs Unless
lessons.grammar_topic: DURING vs WHILE; IF vs UNLESS
lessons.book_ref: Asosiy material — shu reja (formula jadvali, mashqlar, matn). Ixtiyoriy qo'shimcha: Student's book IELTS 2.0, Lesson 16 — dars kitobsiz ham to'liq o'tiladi.
objectives: during (+ ot) va while (+ gap / V-ing) ni farqlaydi: 8 ta gapdan kamida 6 tasida to'g'ri tanlaydi.
if / unless ni 1-tur shart gapda to'g'ri tanlaydi: 6 ta gapdan kamida 5 tasi to'g'ri.
"if … not" gapini unless bilan qayta yozadi (unless'dan keyin inkorsiz): 5 tadan kamida 4 tasi to'g'ri.
Food and drinks CORE 20 bilan restoran rol o'yinida during / while / unless ni kamida 3 marta ishlatadi (Mini-vazifa: At a restaurant).
Reading: MrBeast haqidagi matnda TRUE / FALSE / NOT GIVEN ning 5 bandidan kamida 4 tasi to'g'ri.
Kombinatsiya: 1 daqiqada during/while jadvali — 1 / 2 / 3 marta, if/unless jadvali — 3 / 4 / 5 marta (warm-up / normativ / 2 coin).
materials: Formula jadvali — rejaning Grammatika bo'limi (grammar.formulas), proyektor yoki doska
Food and drinks (taom va ichimliklar) CORE 20 varag'i.
Kahoot: 'O'tgan dars Kahooti' tugmasi (15-dars savollari)
timeline: Salomlashish + kirish savoli

Ustoz: "During the lesson, don't eat. While I'm talking, listen." — savol: during'dan keyin nima keldi (ot), while'dan keyin nima (gap)? Keyin: "Unless you do your homework, you won't get a coin." — unless nimani anglatadi (agar …masa)?
Kahoot — 15-dars takrori: Conditionals Type 2 and 3 + Travelling
'O'tgan dars Kahooti' tugmasi (15-dars Kahooti: 20 savol, har biriga 15 soniya). Bugungi dars Kahootini ochmang — u 17-dars boshida o'ynaladi.
YOZMA NORMATIV — 15-dars lug'ati: Travelling (CORE 20)
Ustoz 20 so'zni o'zbekcha aytadi, o'quvchi inglizchasini yozadi — 5 daqiqa; 1 daqiqa juftlikda CORE varag'i bilan tekshirish. 18–20 to'g'ri — 2 coin.
Uyga vazifa tekshiruvi
15-dars Mashq to'plami kaliti proyektorda: o'quvchi o'zi tekshiradi; 2 ta ko'p xato band doskada.
YANGI MAVZU — During vs While; If vs Unless

Formula jadvali (grammar.formulas): DURING + ot (during the winter / during her vacation); WHILE + gap yoki V-ing (while I was cooking / while watching); IF = agar; UNLESS = agar …masa (= if … not), unless'dan keyin inkor yo'q: I won't go outside unless it stops raining. Unless savolda ishlatilmaydi — savol if bilan, unless javobda. So'ng grammar.presentation: ustoz 3 juftlikni modellaydi, qolganlari juftlikda savol-javob zanjiri; mistakes — doskada. + 3 CCQ (grammar.notes).
Food and drinks (taom va ichimliklar) — CORE 20

Har so'z: talaffuz → tarjima → vocab misoli; 5–6 so'z bilan o'quvchi during / while yoki if / unless gapi tuzadi (Add the spices while the meat is cooking. / Unless you follow the recipe, the cake won't be good.).
Kombinatsiya

Kombinatsiya — o'quvchi bugungi formula jadvalini (tasdiq → inkor → savol, har qatorga 1 misol + o'zbekcha tarjima) yoddan, to'xtamasdan aytib chiqadi va 1 daqiqada necha marta to'liq aytgani sanaladi. Bugun (2 jadval): 1) During + ot / While + S + was + V-ing / S + V + while + V-ing (During the lesson, I don't eat. / While I was cooking, she was cleaning. / She fell asleep while watching the film.); 2) If + Present Simple, will + V1 / Unless + Present Simple, will + V1 / Will + S + V1 if …? (If it rains, we'll stay in. / Unless it stops raining, I won't go out. / Will you come if it rains?). Juftlikda: biri aytadi, biri sanaydi. 1 daqiqada: during/while — 1 marta — warm-up, 2 marta — normativ, 3 marta — 2 coin; if/unless — 3 marta — warm-up, 4 marta — normativ, 5 marta — 2 coin.
Sinf mashqlari
Majburiy: during yoki while (6 daq, yakka), if yoki unless (5 daq, yakka), unless bilan qayta yozing (6 daq, yakka), Retsept (6 daq, juftlik, speaking). ZAXIRA: Xatoni toping.
Reading
Jony Academy matni (MrBeast): 1-o'qish — during / while / unless gaplarini topish; 2-o'qish — TRUE / FALSE / NOT GIVEN va 4 ta qisqa savol. Javoblar birga tekshiriladi.
Writing / speaking mini-vazifa

Mini-vazifa: At a restaurant (class_ex): 6 daq — juftlikda rol o'yini (mijoz + ofitsiant, during / while / unless kamida 3 marta), keyin rollarni almashish; 6 daq — 2 ta IELTS Part 1 savoli, har biriga 45–60 soniya javob. Mezon: speaking_mini.
Xatolar ustida ishlash + exit ticket

4 daqiqa: mini-vazifadagi eng ko'p uchragan 3 xato doskada (grammar.mistakes: During I was eating → While; unless + inkor; if/unless + will); kuchlilarga STRONG so'zlar bilan 2 gap. Oxirgi 3 daqiqa: Exit ticket (class_ex oxirgi mashqi).
Uyga vazifa
Mashq to'plami, yozma ish va ovozli normativ — majburiy (ovozli normativ 17-darsgacha); tarjima — qo'shimcha. homework_intro ni o'qing.

intro: DURING + OT: during the winter, during the lesson, during her holiday. "Nima davomida?"
WHILE + GAP (S + V) yoki V-ing: while I was cooking; while cooking. "…yotgan paytda".
IF — agar (shart bo'lsa); UNLESS — agar …masa (shart bo'lmasa) = if … not. Unless'dan keyin inkor yo'q!
1-tur shart: If/Unless + Present Simple, will + V1. "Unless it stops raining, I won't go out."
formulas: During the winter, it snows a lot.
During her vacation in France, she learned French.
Fransiyadagi ta'tili davomida u fransuz tilini o'rgandi.
While + S + was + V-ing, S + was + V-ing
While I was cooking, she was cleaning the house.
Men ovqat pishirayotganimda u uyni tozalayotgan edi.
She fell asleep while watching the film.
If it rains, we'll stay indoors.
Unless + Present Simple, will + V1 (= if … not)
I won't go outside unless it stops raining.
presentation: What do you usually eat during the lesson break?
During the break I usually eat a snack.
What were you doing while your mum was cooking?
While she was cooking, I was setting the table.
Did you eat anything while watching the film?
Yes, I ate popcorn while watching it.
What will you cook if guests come?
If guests come, I'll cook plov.
Will you eat dessert?
Yes, unless I'm too full.
When do you drink tea — during or after meals?
We drink tea during and after meals.
What happened while you were at the restaurant?

notes: during — predlog (ot bilan); while — bog'lovchi (gap bilan). "During I was cooking" — xato.
unless = if not: "Unless you hurry, you'll be late" = "If you don't hurry…"
unless'dan keyin inkor qo'yilmaydi: "unless it doesn't rain" — xato.
unless odatda savolda ishlatilmaydi: savol if bilan beriladi, unless javobda keladi — Will you eat dessert? — Yes, unless I'm too full.
Taom so'zlari: meal (ovqatlanish vaqti), dish (taom), cuisine (oshxona uslubi), ingredient (masalliq).
CCQ: During the lesson, don't eat. — Is "the lesson" a noun or a sentence? (A noun → during) — Is there a verb after during? (No)
CCQ: While I was cooking, the phone rang. — Is there a subject + verb after while? (Yes: I was cooking → while) — Did the cooking and the call happen at the same time? (Yes)
CCQ: I won't go out unless it stops raining. — Is it raining now? (Yes) — If the rain doesn't stop, will I go out? (No) — Unless = if … not? (Yes)
CCQ: If guests come, I'll cook plov. — Are the guests here now? (No / we don't know) — When will I cook plov? (Only if they come)
mistakes: During I was eating, he called.
While I was eating, he called.
Unless you don't study, you'll fail.
If you will come, we'll eat.
I'll go unless it will rain.

reading.title: MrBeast: a YouTuber who helps people
text: Jimmy Donaldson, known as MrBeast, was born in 1998 in the USA. He started his YouTube channel in 2012, when he was 13. During his first years on YouTube, he made hundreds of videos, but not many people watched them. He didn't give up. While he was still at school, he spent many hours studying what makes a video popular.

In 2017 he became famous for a strange video: he counted to 100,000, and it took him almost two days! After that, his channel grew very fast. Today he has hundreds of millions of subscribers around the world.

MrBeast is famous for giving things away. During his videos he gives money, cars, houses and even an island to ordinary people. But many of his projects are about helping others. In 2020 he started Beast Philanthropy, a charity that gives free food to families in need. In 2023 he paid for eye operations for people who couldn't see, and he built wells in Africa so that villages have clean water.
He also has a chocolate company, Feastables. Some people think his videos are only entertainment, but unless you look at his charity work, you won't understand the whole story.

kahoot.q: ___ the lesson, please don't use your phone.
kahoot.explain: «the lesson» — ot. During + ot: during the lesson.

kahoot.q: ___ I was cooking, my brother was washing the dishes.
kahoot.explain: Keyin gap keladi (I was cooking) → While + ega + fe'l.

kahoot.q: She fell asleep ___ watching the film.
kahoot.explain: while + V-ing ham mumkin: while watching. during + V-ing — xato.

kahoot.q: Qaysi gapda XATO bor?
options: Unless you don't eat, you'll be hungry.
Unless you eat, you'll be hungry.
If you don't eat, you'll be hungry.
You'll be hungry if you don't eat.
kahoot.explain: unless = if ... not. Undan keyin yana inkor qo'yilmaydi: Unless you eat...

kahoot.q: I won't go out ___ it stops raining.
kahoot.explain: Yomg'ir TO'XTAMASA chiqmayman → unless (= if it doesn't stop).

kahoot.q: If it ___ tomorrow, we'll eat inside.
kahoot.explain: If + Present Simple, will + V1. if-gapda will bo'lmaydi: If it rains...

kahoot.q: «Unless» ning ma'nosi qaysi?
kahoot.explain: unless = if ... not (agar ...masa): Unless you hurry = If you don't hurry.

kahoot.q: We'll order pizza unless the restaurant ___ closed.
kahoot.explain: unless + tasdiq, Present Simple: unless it is closed (yopiq bo'lmasa).

kahoot.q: Tarjima: «Tushlik payti u menga qo'ng'iroq qildi.»
options: He called me during I had lunch.
kahoot.explain: «lunch» — ot, shuning uchun during lunch. while dan keyin gap keladi.

kahoot.q: DURING dan keyin nima keladi?
kahoot.explain: During + ot/ot birikma: during the winter, during the meal.

kahoot.q: Qaysi gap TO'G'RI?
options: While we were eating, the lights went out.
During we were eating, the lights went out.
While the meal, the lights went out.
During eating we were, the lights went out.
kahoot.explain: Gap (we were eating) oldidan while; ot (the meal) oldidan during.

kahoot.q: You won't lose weight ___ you eat less sugar.
kahoot.explain: Kamroq shakar YEMASANG ozmaysan → unless (= if you don't eat less).

kahoot.q: At the end of the meal, we asked the waiter for the ___.
kahoot.explain: bill — restorandagi hisob. menu — menyu (ovqat oldidan so'raladi).

kahoot.q: Ice cream is a popular ___ after the main course.
kahoot.explain: dessert — shirinlik (oxirida). starter — ishtahaochar (boshida), soft drink — gazli ichimlik.

kahoot.q: First, ___ up the onions into small pieces.
kahoot.explain: chop up — maydalab to'g'ramoq. heat up — isitmoq, fill up — to'ldirmoq.

kahoot.q: Food that is not cooked is ___.
kahoot.explain: raw — xom. fried — qovurilgan, boiled — qaynatilgan, grilled — panjarada.

kahoot.q: «masalliq» — inglizcha?
kahoot.explain: ingredient — masalliq. recipe — retsept, nutrient — ozuqa moddasi.

kahoot.q: Plov is a famous ___ of Uzbek cuisine.
kahoot.explain: dish — taom (bitta ovqat turi). diet — parhez.

kahoot.q: The food is ready. Let's dig ___!
kahoot.explain: dig in — ovqatni boshlamoq (yeyishga kirishmoq).

kahoot.q: Qaysi so'z «crispy» ga ma'nodosh?
kahoot.explain: crispy = crunchy — qarsildoq. creamy — qaymoqli, yumshoq.

lessons.title: Indirect vs Direct Questions
lessons.grammar_topic: BILVOSITA SAVOLLAR (Could you tell me… / Do you know… / I wonder…)
lessons.book_ref: Asosiy material — shu reja (formula jadvali, mashqlar, matn). Ixtiyoriy qo'shimcha: Student's book IELTS 2.0, Lesson 17 — dars kitobsiz ham to'liq o'tiladi.
objectives: Bilvosita savol iboralarini (Could you tell me / Do you know / I wonder / I'd like to know / Can you remember) ishlatadi: 6 ta Wh-savoldan kamida 5 tasini bilvosita shaklga to'g'ri o'tkazadi (so'z tartibi gapdek, do/does/did yo'q).
Yes/No savolni if / whether bilan bilvosita qiladi: 5 savoldan kamida 4 tasi to'g'ri.
Maktab CORE 20 so'zlari bilan juftlikda 6 ta muloyim savol beradi va javob oladi (Mini-vazifa: New student).
Reading: Al-Xorazmiy matni bo'yicha 5 ta bilvosita savol tuzadi, TRUE / FALSE / NOT GIVEN da 5 dan kamida 4.
Kombinatsiya: 1 daqiqada 3 / 4 / 5 marta (warm-up / normativ / 2 coin).
materials: Formula jadvali — rejaning Grammatika bo'limi (grammar.formulas), proyektor yoki doska
At school (maktabda) CORE 20 varag'i.
Kahoot: 'O'tgan dars Kahooti' tugmasi (16-dars savollari)
timeline: Salomlashish + kirish savoli
Ustoz notanish odam rolida: "Where is the library?" (qo'pol) — "Excuse me, could you tell me where the library is?" (muloyim). Farq: so'z tartibi va ohang.
Kahoot — 16-dars takrori: During vs While, If vs Unless + Food and drinks
'O'tgan dars Kahooti' tugmasi (16-dars Kahooti: 20 savol, har biriga 15 soniya). Bugungi dars Kahootini ochmang — u 18-dars boshida o'ynaladi.
YOZMA NORMATIV — 16-dars lug'ati: Food and drinks (CORE 20)
Ustoz 20 so'zni o'zbekcha aytadi, o'quvchi inglizchasini yozadi — 5 daqiqa; 1 daqiqa juftlikda CORE varag'i bilan tekshirish. 18–20 to'g'ri — 2 coin.
Uyga vazifa tekshiruvi
16-dars Mashq to'plami: kalit proyektorda, o'quvchilar daftarni almashtirib juftlikda belgilaydi; eng ko'p xato qilingan 2 band doskada tushuntiriladi.
YANGI MAVZU — Bilvosita savollar (Indirect questions)

Formula jadvali (grammar.formulas): bevosita Wh + yordamchi + S + V? → bilvosita Ibora + Wh + S + V → be bilan (where the library is) → Yes/No: if/whether + S + V → I wonder … (nuqta bilan) → o'tgan zamon (did yo'qoladi, V2). Har qatorga misol + tarjima. grammar.presentation: ustoz 3 juftlikni modellaydi, qolgan 7 tasini o'quvchilar juftlikda so'raydi va javob beradi. + 3 CCQ (grammar.notes).
At school (maktabda) — CORE 20
Har so'z misol gapi bilan (vocab.core); keyin juftlikda 5 ta so'z bilan "Could you tell me where the … is?" / "Do you know if we have … today?" savollari.
Kombinatsiya

Kombinatsiya — o'quvchi bugungi formula jadvalini (tasdiq → inkor → savol, har qatorga 1 misol + o'zbekcha tarjima) yoddan, to'xtamasdan aytib chiqadi va 1 daqiqada necha marta to'liq aytgani sanaladi. Bugun: Could you tell me + Wh + S + V? / Do you know + if/whether + S + V? / I wonder + Wh/if + S + V. Juftlikda: biri aytadi, biri sanaydi. 1 daqiqada 3 marta — warm-up, 4 marta — normativ, 5 marta — 2 coin.
Sinf mashqlari
Majburiy: Bilvosita savolga o'tkazing (6 daq, yakka), if / whether (6 daq, yakka), Bevosita shaklga qaytaring (5 daq, yakka), Maktab lug'ati + savol (6 daq, juftlik). ZAXIRA: Xatoni toping.
Reading
Al-Xorazmiy matni: o'qish + glossary (4 daq) → bilvosita savollar (4 daq) → TRUE / FALSE / NOT GIVEN (3 daq) → fikr (1 daq).
Writing / speaking mini-vazifa
Mini-vazifa: New student (class_ex): juftlikda rol o'yini — yangi o'quvchi 6 ta bilvosita savol beradi, keyin rollar almashadi (8 daq); 2 ta IELTS Part 1 savoli (4 daq). Mezon: speaking_mini.
Xatolar ustida ishlash + exit ticket

4 daqiqa: darsdagi ko'p uchragan xatolar doskada (grammar.mistakes: "where is the…", does/did qolishi, if tushib qolishi); STRONG lug'at — kuchlilarga (+1 coin). Oxirgi 3 daqiqa: Exit ticket (class_ex oxirida).
Uyga vazifa
Mashq to'plami (12 band), "Yangi maktab" savollari, ovozli normativ (CORE 20) — majburiy; tarjima — qo'shimcha. Ovozli normativ 18-darsgacha yuboriladi.

intro: Bevosita: "Where is the gym?" — bilvosita: "Could you tell me where the gym is?" — ega fe'ldan OLDIN, savol tartibi yo'q.
Present/Past Simple'da do/does/did yo'qoladi: "When does the lesson start?" → "Do you know when the lesson starts?"
Yes/No savol → if / whether: "Is the library open?" → "Do you know if the library is open?"
Oxiridagi belgi: ibora savol bo'lsa (Could you tell me…?) — "?", gap bo'lsa (I wonder…) — ".".
formulas: What time does the movie start?
Could you tell me what time the movie starts?
Do you know where the library is?
Do you know if the lab is open today?
I wonder why the teacher is late.
Can you remember what the homework was?
presentation: Could you tell me where the principal's office is?
It's on the second floor, next to the library.
Do you know what time the PE lesson starts?
It starts at ten.
Can you tell me if the computer lab is open?
Yes, it's open until six.
I wonder who our new maths teacher is.
I think it's Mr Karimov.
Do you know whether we have a test tomorrow?
Yes, we have a history test.
Could you tell me how much the textbook costs?
It costs 80,000 soums.
Can you remember what the homework was?
We had to read chapter five.
Do you know why the cafeteria is closed?
Because they are painting it.
I'd like to know how many students are in the class.
There are twenty.
Could you tell me where I can find a calculator?
You can borrow one from the librarian.
notes: Muloyim so'rov iboralari: Could you tell me…? / Do you know…? / Would you mind telling me…? / I'd like to know… / I wonder…
"whether" rasmiyroq, "if" og'zaki — ikkalasi ham to'g'ri.
Bilvosita savolda "will" qoladi: Do you know when the bus will come?
Maktab so'zlari: subject (fan), facility (sharoit), supplies (jihoz), staff (xodimlar).

CCQ: I wonder why the teacher is late. — Am I asking a person directly? (No, I'm thinking) — "?" or "."? (".")

reading.title: Al-Khwarizmi — a great scholar from Khorezm
text: Do you know where the word "algorithm" comes from? It comes from the name of a scholar who lived more than 1,000 years ago. His name was Muhammad ibn Musa al-Khwarizmi. "Al-Khwarizmi" means "from Khorezm" — a region in today's Uzbekistan. He was probably born there around the year 780.

Al-Khwarizmi worked in Baghdad at the House of Wisdom — a famous library and research centre. Scholars from many countries worked there. They translated old books and wrote new ones. Al-Khwarizmi wrote a book called "Al-Jabr", and this is where the word "algebra" comes from. In the book he explained how to solve equations step by step.

He also wrote a book about Indian numbers — 1, 2, 3 … and zero. Later this book was translated into Latin, and it helped people in Europe learn these numbers. Today we use them every day — in maths lessons, on phones and on calculators.

Al-Khwarizmi also wrote about geography and made tables for astronomy — the study of the stars and planets. He died around 850. Today many people call him "the father of algebra". There is a monument to him in Khiva, and a crater on the Moon is named after him.
glossary: be named after — nomi bilan atalmoq

lessons.title: Wish Sentences
lessons.grammar_topic: WISH (+ Past Simple / Past Perfect / could; wish + would — tanib olish)
lessons.book_ref: Asosiy material — shu reja (formula jadvali, mashqlar, matn). Ixtiyoriy qo'shimcha: Student's book IELTS 2.0, Lesson 18 — dars kitobsiz ham to'liq o'tiladi.
objectives: wish + Past Simple (hozir) va wish + Past Perfect (o'tgan) farqini 3 ta CCQ ga to'g'ri javob berib ko'rsatadi.
'wish + qaysi zamon?' mashqidagi 8 gapdan kamida 6 tasida fe'l shaklini to'g'ri yozadi (V2/were, had + V3, could + V1).
wish + would ni tanib oladi va tanlaydi: 'Hozirmi, o'tganmi?' mashqidagi 6 gapdan kamida 5 tasini to'g'ri belgilaydi.
Mini-vazifa: xarid haqida 3 ta wish gapi (1 hozir, 1 o'tgan, 1 could) aytadi va 2 ta Part 1 savoliga 45–60 soniyadan javob beradi.
Reading: TRUE / FALSE / NOT GIVEN ning 5 bandidan kamida 4 tasini, Listening gap-fill'ning 6 bandidan kamida 5 tasini to'g'ri bajaradi.
Kombinatsiya: 4 qatorli jadvalni 1 daqiqada kamida 2 marta aytadi (normativ).
materials: Formula jadvali — rejaning Grammatika bo'limi (grammar.formulas), proyektor yoki doska
Shopping (xarid) CORE 20 varag'i.
Kahoot: 'O'tgan dars Kahooti' tugmasi (17-dars savollari)
timeline: Salomlashish + kirish savoli
Ustoz: "I wish I had a million dollars. I wish it were Friday. I wish I hadn't eaten so much." — o'quvchilar har biriga "Me too!" yoki o'z wish'i.
Kahoot — 17-dars takrori: Indirect vs Direct Questions + At school
'O'tgan dars Kahooti' tugmasi (17-dars Kahooti: 20 savol, har biriga 15 soniya). Bugungi dars Kahootini ochmang — u 19-dars boshida o'ynaladi.
YOZMA NORMATIV — 17-dars lug'ati: At school (CORE 20)
Ustoz 20 so'zni o'zbekcha aytadi, o'quvchi inglizchasini yozadi — 5 daqiqa; 1 daqiqa juftlikda CORE varag'i bilan tekshirish. 18–20 to'g'ri — 2 coin.
Uyga vazifa tekshiruvi
17-dars Mashq to'plami kaliti proyektorda, juftlikda tekshiriladi; eng ko'p xato qilingan 2 band doskada.
YANGI MAVZU — Wish sentences

Formula jadvali (grammar.formulas): 4 qator — hozir (wish + V2 / were), o'tgan (wish + had + V3), imkoniyat (wish + could + V1) — faol ishlatiladi; wish + would (boshqa odamdan norozilik) — faqat tanib olish. Har qatorda misol + tarjima; keyin ustoz savol beradi, o'quvchi javob beradi (grammar.presentation, 8 juft), so'ng juftlikda. + 3 CCQ (grammar.notes).
Shopping (xarid) — CORE 20
Ustoz so'zni aytadi, o'quvchilar takrorlaydi (talaffuz); keyin har o'quvchi 2–3 so'z bilan wish gapi aytadi: "I wish the discount were bigger." / "I wish I hadn't lost the receipt."
Kombinatsiya

Kombinatsiya — o'quvchi bugungi formula jadvalini (tasdiq → inkor → savol, har qatorga 1 misol + o'zbekcha tarjima) yoddan, to'xtamasdan aytib chiqadi va 1 daqiqada necha marta to'liq aytgani sanaladi. Bugun: I wish + S + V2 (were) / I wish + S + had + V3 / I wish + S + could + V1 / I wish + S + would + V1. Juftlikda: biri aytadi, biri sanaydi. 1 daqiqada 1 marta — warm-up, 2 marta — normativ, 3 marta — 2 coin.
Sinf mashqlari

Majburiy: wish + qaysi zamon? (6 daq, yakka), Vaziyat → wish (6 daq, juftlik), Hozirmi, o'tganmi? (5 daq, yakka), Mini-vazifa: My shopping regrets (6 daq, juftlik). ZAXIRA: Do'konda muammo, Xatoni toping.
Reading
Matn: 1-o'qish — umumiy mazmun; keyin Kamolaning wish gaplarini topish, TRUE / FALSE / NOT GIVEN (5 band), o'z wish gaplari.
Listening
Ustoz transcript'ni 2 marta o'qiydi: 1-marta gist savol, 2-marta topshiriqlar; javoblar birga tekshiriladi.
Xatolar ustida ishlash + exit ticket
Ko'p uchragan 3–4 xato doskada (grammar.mistakes). Oxirgi 3 daqiqa — Exit ticket. ZAXIRA mashqlar — kuchlilarga.
Uyga vazifa
Mashq to'plami, yozma ish, ovozli normativ; qo'shimcha — tarjima va flashcard.

intro: I wish + Past Simple — HOZIR boshqacha bo'lishini xohlash: "I wish I had a big house" (uyim yo'q). "were" hamma shaxs uchun: I wish I were taller. (So'zlashuvda I / he / she / it bilan "was" ham to'g'ri: I wish it was Friday.) Hozir bo'layotgan ish uchun ham shu qolip: "I wish it weren't raining."
I wish + Past Perfect — O'TGANNI o'zgartirish (bo'lmaydi): "I wish I hadn't eaten so much cake."
I wish + could — hozir qila olmayotgan narsani qila olishni xohlash: "I wish I could drive."
I wish + S + would — faqat TANIB OLISH: boshqa odam yoki narsa o'zgarishini xohlash (norozilik): "I wish he would stop interrupting me." O'zi haqida ishlatilmaydi.
formulas: S + wish + S + V2 (were) / didn't + V1
I wish I had a big house. / I wish it weren't raining.
Qaniydi katta uyim bo'lsa. / Qaniydi yomg'ir yog'mayotgan bo'lsa.
S + wish + S + had / hadn't + V3
I wish I hadn't eaten so much cake.
I wish I could travel around the world.
Qaniydi dunyo bo'ylab sayohat qila olsam.
I wish he would stop interrupting me.

Do you wish you were somewhere else now?
Yes, I wish I were at the shopping centre.

notes: wish + Past Simple = hozir (Past emas!); wish + Past Perfect = o'tgan.
"I wish I would" — xato; o'zi haqida "could" yoki Past Simple: I wish I could sing. / I wish I were taller.

Qiziquvchilar uchun: If only = wish, kuchliroq: If only I had more money! Rasmiy "wish + to V" (I wish to speak to the manager) ham bor, lekin kundalik nutqda "I'd like to …" ishlatiladi: "I'd like to buy a laptop."
Xarid so'zlari: discount (chegirma), refund (pulni qaytarish), receipt (chek), bargain (arzon xarid).
CCQ: I wish I had a car. — Do I have a car now? (No) — Are we talking about now or the past? (Now)
CCQ: I wish I hadn't bought these shoes. — Did I buy the shoes? (Yes) — Can I change the past? (No) — Am I sorry now? (Yes)
CCQ: I wish I could swim. — Can I swim now? (No) — Do I want to swim? (Yes)
CCQ: I wish my brother would stop taking my phone. — Is my brother taking my phone? (Yes) — Who must change: me or my brother? (My brother)
mistakes: I wish I have a car.
I wish I had a car.
I wish I would be taller.
I wish I didn't buy it yesterday.
I wish I hadn't bought it yesterday.
I wish she would stop talking.

reading.title: Elon Musk: a life of big plans
text: Kamola is 16 and lives in Samarkand. She wants to be an engineer, so for a school project she chose Elon Musk. Here is what she found out — and what she wishes.

Elon Musk was born in 1971 in South Africa. As a boy, he loved books and computers, and he taught himself to write programs. At the age of 12, he sold his first video game for about 500 dollars. "I wish I had started programming at 12!" Kamola writes. "I wish I could write my own game."

At 17, Musk moved to Canada, and later he went to the USA. In 1995 he started his first internet company with his brother, and in 1999 they sold it for about 300 million dollars. Later he helped to create PayPal, an online payment system. In 2002 eBay bought PayPal. Then Musk put a lot of his money into two companies: SpaceX (rockets) and Tesla (electric cars). In 2008 both companies nearly went bankrupt, but they survived.

Today SpaceX rockets carry cargo and astronauts to the International Space Station, and Tesla sells electric cars in many countries. In 2022 Musk bought Twitter, and later he renamed it X. "Our town doesn't have a robotics club. I wish it had one," Kamola says. "And I wish I hadn't wasted so much time on games last year. But now I'm learning to code every day."

lessons.title: Infinitive of Purpose
lessons.grammar_topic: MAQSAD INFINITIVI (to + V1 / in order to / so as to / so that)
lessons.book_ref: Asosiy material — shu reja (formula jadvali, mashqlar, matn). Ixtiyoriy qo'shimcha: Student's book IELTS 2.0, Lesson 19 — dars kitobsiz ham to'liq o'tiladi.
objectives: Maqsadni to + V1 / in order to / so as to bilan aytadi: 'Maqsadni ayting' mashqidagi 6 gapdan kamida 5 tasini to'g'ri tugatadi.
so that + gap (can/could) va for + ot shakllarini farqlaydi: 'in order to / so that / for' mashqidagi 6 banddan kamida 5 tasida to'g'ri shaklni tanlaydi.
Inkor maqsadni in order not to / so as not to bilan aytadi; Mini-vazifada 45–60 soniya ichida kamida 3 xil maqsad shaklini ishlatadi.
Chalkash so'zlar — CORE 10 juft (20 so'z): 'Chalkash so'zlar' mashqidagi 9 gapdan kamida 7 tasida to'g'ri so'zni tanlaydi.
Kombinatsiya: 6 qatorli formula jadvalini 1 daqiqada kamida 2 marta aytadi (normativ); Progress Test 3 (20-dars) qamrovi va bo'limlarini biladi.
materials: Formula jadvali — rejaning Grammatika bo'limi (grammar.formulas), proyektor yoki doska
Confusing words (chalkash so'zlar) CORE 20 varag'i (10 juft).
Kahoot: 'O'tgan dars Kahooti' tugmasi (18-dars savollari)
timeline: Salomlashish + kirish savoli
Ustoz: "Why do you come to Jony Academy?" — "To learn English!" — "Why do you learn English?" — "In order to get 7.0." Doskaga: to + V1 = maqsad.
Kahoot — 18-dars takrori: Wish Sentences + Shopping
'O'tgan dars Kahooti' tugmasi (18-dars Kahooti: 20 savol, har biriga 15 soniya). Bugungi dars Kahootini ochmang — u 20-dars boshida o'ynaladi.
YOZMA NORMATIV — 18-dars lug'ati: Shopping (CORE 20)
Ustoz 20 so'zni o'zbekcha aytadi, o'quvchi inglizchasini yozadi — 5 daqiqa; 1 daqiqa juftlikda CORE varag'i bilan tekshirish. 18–20 to'g'ri — 2 coin.
Uyga vazifa tekshiruvi
18-dars Mashq to'plami kaliti proyektorda, juftlikda tekshiriladi; eng ko'p xato qilingan 2 band doskada.
YANGI MAVZU — Infinitive of Purpose (to / in order to / so as to / so that / for)

Formula jadvali (grammar.formulas): 6 qator — to + V1; in order to / so as to (rasmiyroq); so that + S + can/could (ega o'zgarsa); for + ot; inkor in order not to / so as not to. Maqsad (to + V1) va sabab (because) farqi; presentation juftlikda. + 3 CCQ (grammar.notes).
Confusing words (chalkash so'zlar) — CORE 20
10 juft (20 so'z): ustoz juftni aytadi, o'quvchilar takrorlaydi va farqini o'zbekcha aytadi; har juftga bitta gap, iloji bo'lsa maqsad qolipida (… to + V1).
Kombinatsiya

Kombinatsiya — o'quvchi bugungi formula jadvalini (tasdiq → inkor → savol, har qatorga 1 misol + o'zbekcha tarjima) yoddan, to'xtamasdan aytib chiqadi va 1 daqiqada necha marta to'liq aytgani sanaladi. Bugun: S + V + to + V1 / S + V + in order to + V1 / S + V + so as to + V1 / S + V + so that + S + can/could / S + V + for + noun / in order not to / so as not to + V1. Juftlikda: biri aytadi, biri sanaydi. 1 daqiqada 1 marta — warm-up, 2 marta — normativ, 3 marta — 2 coin.
Sinf mashqlari

Majburiy: Maqsadni ayting (5 daq, yakka), in order to / so that / for (5 daq, yakka), Chalkash so'zlar (5 daq, juftlik), Mini-vazifa: Why do you learn English? (8 daq, juftlik). ZAXIRA: Xatoni toping.
Reading
Matn: 1-o'qish — umumiy mazmun; keyin maqsad gaplarini topish, TRUE / FALSE / NOT GIVEN (5 band), raqamlar, 'Ulug'bek nega?' (4 savol).
Listening
Ustoz transcript'ni 2 marta o'qiydi: 1-marta gist savol, 2-marta topshiriqlar; javoblar birga tekshiriladi.
Xatolar ustida ishlash + exit ticket
Ko'p uchragan 3–4 xato doskada (grammar.mistakes). Oxirgi 3 daqiqa — Exit ticket. ZAXIRA mashq va STRONG juftlar — kuchlilarga (+1 coin).
Uyga vazifa
Mashq to'plami, ovozli normativ, Progress Test 3 ga tayyorgarlik (yozma ish shu ichida); qo'shimcha — tarjima. Test — 20-dars boshida, 40 daqiqa.

intro: Maqsad savoli "Why? / What for?" — javob: to + V1: "He went to the gym to work out."
in order to / so as to — rasmiyroq, yozma: "She studies hard in order to pass the exam."
so that + gap: "I saved money so that I could buy a laptop." (ega o'zgarsa yoki modal kerak bo'lsa).
for + ot: "I went to the shop for bread" (for + ot; "for to buy" — xato).
Inkor: "I left early in order not to be late" / "so as not to be late" ("to not be" — og'zaki, yozma emas).
formulas: He went to the gym to work out.
U mashq qilish uchun sport zaliga bordi.
S + V + in order to + V1
She studies hard in order to pass the exam.
U imtihondan o'tish uchun qattiq o'qiydi.
S + V + so as to + V1 (rasmiy)
He left early so as to catch the train.
U poyezdga ulgurish uchun erta chiqdi.
S + V + so that + S + can/could/will
I saved money so that I could buy a laptop.
Noutbuk sotib ola olishim uchun pul yig'dim.
I went to the shop for bread.
in order not to / so as not to + V1
I whispered so as not to wake the baby.
presentation: Why do you learn English?
I learn English to get a good job.
Why did Ulugh Beg build an observatory?
He built it in order to study the stars.
Why did you go to the bazaar?
I went there for vegetables.
Why are you saving money?
I'm saving money so that I can buy a laptop.
Why did she leave so early?
She left early so as not to miss the bus.
Why do you write a shopping list?
So that I don't forget anything.
notes: Maqsad = "…uchun" (nima uchun qilyapman). Sabab = "because" (nima uchun bo'ldi). "I study because I want a job" (sabab) vs "I study to get a job" (maqsad).
"for + V-ing" — narsaning vazifasi: "A knife is for cutting" (odam maqsadi emas).
so that + can (hozir/kelajak) / could (o'tgan).
Chalkash so'zlar: talaffuz yoki imlo yaqin, ma'no boshqa: accept (qabul qilmoq) / except (tashqari); advice (ot) / advise (fe'l); quiet (jim) / quite (ancha).
CCQ: I went to the shop to buy bread. — Why did I go to the shop? (To buy bread) — Is this the reason or the purpose? (The purpose — nima uchun qildim)
CCQ: I study because I want a job. / I study to get a job. — Which sentence uses because + a sentence? (The first) — Which uses to + verb? (The second) — Do they have the same meaning? (Yes)
CCQ: I saved money so that my brother could buy a laptop. — Who buys the laptop? (My brother) — Can we say "I saved money to buy" here? (No — ega o'zgardi → so that + gap)
CCQ: I went to the shop for bread. — Is "bread" a verb or a noun? (A noun → for) — Can we say "for buy bread"? (No → to buy bread)
mistakes: I went to the shop for to buy bread.
I went to the shop to buy bread. / for bread.
I study hard for pass the exam.
I study hard to pass the exam.
She left early so that not to be late.
She left early so as not to be late. / so that she wouldn't be late.
I called him for asking a question.
I called him to ask a question.

homework.title: MAJBURIY: Progress Test 3 ga tayyorgarlik (~20 daq)
homework.instr: Test 20-dars boshida, 40 daqiqa, 14–19-darslar. Formulalarni (box) va CORE 20 varaqlarini takrorlang, har bo'limdan bittadan namuna savolni bajaring; E bo'limni daftarga to'liq yozing — bu bugungi yozma ish.
box: 14-dars: Yes/No savol (yordamchi + S + V?) va Wh-savol (Wh + yordamchi + S + V?); Who / What — ega haqida savol, yordamchisiz
15-dars: If + Past Simple, S + would + V1 (Type 2); If I had + V3, I would have + V3 (Type 3 — tanib olish)
16-dars: during + ot / while + S + V; unless = if … not
17-dars: Could you tell me / Do you know + Wh / if + S + V (so'z tartibi — darak gapdagidek)
18-dars: wish + Past Simple (hozir), wish + Past Perfect (o'tgan), wish + would (boshqa odamning odati)
19-dars: to / in order to / so as to + V1; so that + S + can/could; for + ot; in order not to / so as not to
Lug'at: Crime, Travelling, Food and drinks, At school, Shopping, Confusing words — CORE 20
items: A (Grammatika) — tanlang: We'll be late ___ we take a taxi. (if / unless / during)
B (Lug'at) — to'g'ri so'zni tanlang: I'm ___ tired today — I didn't sleep well. (quiet / quite)
C (Tarjima) — inglizchaga: «Qaniydi, men kecha ko'proq o'qigan bo'lsam.»
D (Reading) — "Dilnoza went to the market to buy fruit for her grandmother. She paid 40,000 soums." TRUE / FALSE / NOT GIVEN: Dilnoza bought the fruit for herself.
E (Writing) — 70–80 so'z: My goals. Ishlating: to + V1 (2 ta), in order to (1), so that (1), for + ot (1), bitta wish gap.
answers: I wish I had studied more yesterday.

Namuna: My name is Aziza and I am seventeen. I study English every day to get a good IELTS score. Next year I want to go to Tashkent in order to study at a good university. I am saving money so that I can buy a new laptop. Every Saturday I go to the library for new books. I also play volleyball to stay healthy. I wish I had more free time, but my goals are very important to me. Mezon: writing_a2 rubrikasi (4 × 0–5).

reading.title: Mirzo Ulugh Beg — the ruler who counted the stars
text: Mirzo Ulugh Beg was born in 1394. He was the grandson of Amir Temur, and in 1409, when he was still a teenager, he became the ruler of Samarkand. But he was not a typical ruler. He loved mathematics and astronomy more than war. He built madrasas in Samarkand and Bukhara in order to teach science. Above the door of his madrasa in Bukhara there are famous words: seeking knowledge is the duty of every Muslim man and woman.

In the 1420s he built a huge observatory on a hill near Samarkand. He built it to study the stars and planets. The main instrument was a giant curve, partly cut into the rock of the hill. Ulugh Beg and his scientists used it to measure the positions of the stars. In order to do this, they worked for years, every clear night.

The result was a catalogue of 1,018 stars — one of the most accurate star catalogues of its time. Ulugh Beg also measured the length of the year: 365 days, 6 hours, 10 minutes and 8 seconds. Today we know the real number — and he was wrong by less than one minute!

Sadly, in 1449 he was killed, and his observatory was destroyed. For hundreds of years, nobody knew where it was. In 1908, an archaeologist found the underground part of the giant curve. Today you can visit it in Samarkand. There is also a crater on the Moon named after Ulugh Beg.

tasks.instr: Write ONE WORD AND/OR A NUMBER for each answer.

transcript: Jasur: Hi, I'm Jasur, a student from Samarkand. Every summer I work as a guide at the Ulugh Beg Observatory. I do it to practise my English and to earn some money for university.

Jasur: Tourists come from all over the world in order to see the giant curve. My tour takes forty-five minutes. First, I ask everyone to be quiet so that they can hear me. Then I tell them the story of Ulugh Beg and his star catalogue.
Jasur: Many visitors say this place is more interesting than a big museum. In summer it is very hot here, so my advice is simple: bring a bottle of water so as not to get tired.
Jasur: After work I go to a small café for a piece of cake. Dessert is my reward! I'm saving money so that I can study astronomy in Tashkent next year.

kahoot.q: He went to the gym ___ work out.
kahoot.explain: Maqsad (nima uchun?) → to + V1: to work out.

kahoot.q: I went to the shop ___ bread.
kahoot.explain: Keyin OT (bread) keladi → for + ot. Fe'l bo'lsa: to buy bread.

kahoot.q: She studies hard ___ order to pass the exam.
kahoot.explain: Rasmiyroq shakl: in order to + V1.

kahoot.q: I saved money so ___ I could buy a laptop.
kahoot.explain: so that + ega + could/can: so that I could buy...

kahoot.q: I whispered so as ___ wake the baby.
kahoot.explain: Inkor: so as not to / in order not to + V1.

kahoot.q: Qaysi gapda XATO bor?
options: I called him for asking a question.
I called him to ask a question.
I went to the market for some apples.
He left early so as to catch the bus.
kahoot.explain: Odamning maqsadi → to + V1: to ask. «for asking» — xato.

kahoot.q: Tarjima: «U poyezdga ulgurish uchun erta chiqdi.»
options: He left early to catch the train.
He left early for catch the train.
He left early for catching the train.
He left early that catch the train.
kahoot.explain: «...uchun» (maqsad) + fe'l → to + V1: to catch.

kahoot.q: «so that» dan keyin nima keladi?
kahoot.explain: so that + to'liq gap: so that I could buy a laptop.

kahoot.q: I left early in order ___ be late.
kahoot.explain: in order not to + V1 — ...maslik uchun. Yozma nutqda «not» «to» dan oldin keladi: in order not to be late.

kahoot.q: Qaysi gap TO'G'RI?
options: I went to the bank to get some cash.
I went to the bank for get some cash.
I went to the bank for to get some cash.
I went to the bank getting some cash.
kahoot.explain: Maqsad + fe'l → to + V1: to get. «for to» — hech qachon.

kahoot.q: My mum works hard so that we ___ go to a good school.
kahoot.explain: so that + ega (we) + can + V1.

kahoot.q: «Why did you go to the library?» — «___ some books.»
kahoot.explain: Why? savoliga maqsad javobi: To + V1 (To borrow some books).

kahoot.q: Everyone came to the party ___ Ali — he was ill.
kahoot.explain: except — ...dan tashqari. accept — qabul qilmoq, expect — kutmoq.

kahoot.q: Can you ___ me some money until Friday?
kahoot.explain: lend — qarzga BERMOQ (lend me). borrow — qarzga OLMOQ (borrow from).

kahoot.q: My brother is taller ___ me.
kahoot.explain: than — taqqoslash (...dan). then — keyin.

kahoot.q: Can I give you some ___? Don't stay up late before the exam.
kahoot.explain: advice — ot (maslahat), sanalmaydi. advise — fe'l (maslahat bermoq).

kahoot.q: Ice cream is my favourite ___.
kahoot.explain: dessert (ss) — shirinlik. desert (s) — cho'l.

kahoot.q: Smoking can ___ your health.
kahoot.explain: affect — fe'l (ta'sir qilmoq). effect — ot (ta'sir, natija).

kahoot.q: The library is very ___ — nobody is talking.
kahoot.explain: quiet — jim, sokin. quite — ancha, juda.

kahoot.q: These trousers are too ___ — I need a belt.
kahoot.explain: loose — bo'sh, keng. lose — yo'qotmoq.

lessons.title: Modal Verbs: have to, need, must, should
lessons.grammar_topic: MODAL FE'LLAR — HAVE TO / NEED (TO) / MUST / SHOULD
lessons.book_ref: Asosiy material — shu reja (formula jadvali, mashqlar, matn). Ixtiyoriy qo'shimcha: Student's book IELTS 2.0, Lesson 20 — dars kitobsiz ham to'liq o'tiladi.
objectives: Progress Test 3 (14–19-darslar) ni 40 daqiqada yakka yozadi; tahlilda o'z xatolarini belgilaydi.
must / mustn't / have to / don't have to / should dan kontekstga mosini tanlaydi: 8 ta gapdan kamida 6 tasida to'g'ri.
mustn't (taqiq) va don't have to (shart emas) ni farqlaydi: 5 ta gapdan kamida 4 tasini to'g'ri belgilaydi.
have to ni tasdiq, inkor, savol va o'tgan zamonda (had to) tuzadi; juftlikda ijarachi uchun 6 ta uy qoidasini aytadi.
Home and buildings CORE 20 bilan uy va binoni tasvirlaydi (qavat, xonalar, qoidalar).
Kombinatsiya: have to jadvalini (tasdiq → inkor → savol) 1 daqiqada kamida 4 marta aytadi (normativ).
materials: Formula jadvali — rejaning Grammatika bo'limi (grammar.formulas), proyektor yoki doska
Home and buildings (uy va binolar) CORE 20 varag'i.
Kahoot: 'O'tgan dars Kahooti' tugmasi (19-dars savollari)
Progress Test 3 varag'i (A variant — har o'quvchiga; B variant — faqat qayta topshirish uchun, yopiq) va kaliti — test paketi 'pt3'
timeline: Salomlashish + test yo'riqnomasi

Salomlashish (1 daq). Yo'riqnoma (2 daq): telefonlar yig'iladi, partalar ajratiladi; hamma A variantni yozadi, qoralama varaq berilmaydi; 40 daqiqa, 5 bo'lim (A–E); javob faqat varaqqa, ruchka bilan; savol bo'lsa qo'l ko'taring.
Kahoot — 19-dars takrori: Infinitive of Purpose + Confusing words
'O'tgan dars Kahooti' tugmasi (19-dars Kahooti: 20 savol, har biriga 15 soniya). Bugungi dars Kahootini ochmang — u 21-dars boshida o'ynaladi.
TEST — Progress Test 3 (14–19-darslar)

40 daqiqa, yakka, qog'ozda. Varaq: test paketi 'pt3' — hamma o'quvchi A variantni yozadi (qo'shni partalarga aralash tarqatilmaydi); B variant faqat qayta topshirish uchun, yopiq saqlanadi; ikkala kalit faqat ustozda. Bo'limlar: A Grammatika 30 · B Lug'at 20 · C Tarjima 10 · D Reading 20 · E Writing 20 = 100 ball. Vaqt: A 10 · B 5 · C 5 · D 10 · E 10 daqiqa.
TEST TAHLILI — Progress Test 3

Varaqlar yig'ilgach, varaqsiz va kalitsiz: kalit proyektorga chiqarilmaydi, test savollari o'qib berilmaydi (A variant kelmaganlar uchun, B variant qayta topshirish uchun toza qoladi). Ustoz 14–19-darslardagi eng ko'p uchraydigan 5 xato turini (Could you tell me where is…, Unless you don't…, for to buy, I wish I have…, Who did steal…?) doskada o'z yangi misollari bilan tushuntiradi, o'quvchilar og'zaki tuzatadi. Butun testni ustoz 2 kun ichida tekshirib, natijani tizimga bo'limlar kesimida kiritadi; ballar 21-darsda aytiladi; o'tish qoidasi test paketida.
YANGI MAVZU — Modal verbs: have to / must / need to / should

Formula jadvali (grammar.formulas): HAVE TO — tashqi majburiyat (don't have to = shart emas; Do you have to…?; o'tgan: had to); MUST — kuchli majburiyat, yozma qoida (mustn't = taqiq!); NEED TO / needn't; SHOULD — maslahat (shouldn't). Warm-up: ustoz sinf qoidalarini aytadi ("You must switch off your phone. You should do your homework. You don't have to stand up.") — o'quvchilar qaysi eng qattiq ekanini aytadi; doskada shkala: must → have to → need to → should. Presentation'dan 3 juftlikni ustoz modellaydi, qolgani juftlikda savol-javob. + 3 CCQ (grammar.notes).
Home and buildings (uy va binolar) — CORE 20
Ustoz aytadi, sinf takrorlaydi + tarjima (har so'zga ~20 soniya); 5–6 so'z bilan modal gap (vocab.core misollari).
Kombinatsiya

Kombinatsiya — o'quvchi bugungi formula jadvalini (tasdiq → inkor → savol, har qatorga 1 misol + o'zbekcha tarjima) yoddan, to'xtamasdan aytib chiqadi va 1 daqiqada necha marta to'liq aytgani sanaladi. Bugun: S + have/has to + V1 / S + don't/doesn't have to + V1 / Do/Does + S + have to + V1? (I have to pay the rent. — I don't have to pay a deposit. — Do I have to pay a deposit?). Juftlikda: biri aytadi, biri sanaydi. 1 daqiqada 3 marta — warm-up, 4 marta — normativ, 5 marta — 2 coin.
Sinf mashqlari
Majburiy: Modal tanlang (7 daq, yakka), mustn't yoki don't have to (5 daq, juftlik), Uy qoidalari (8 daq, juftlik). ZAXIRA: Savol va inkor, Uyimni tasvirlash, Xatoni toping.
Xatolar ustida ishlash + exit ticket
Ko'p uchragan xatolar doskada (must to, don't must, has to not, mustn't ↔ don't have to) — 4 daqiqa; oxirgi 3 daqiqa: Exit ticket (class_ex oxirida), yakka, varaqqa.
Uyga vazifa
Test darsi bo'lgani uchun Reading va mini-vazifa uyga o'tadi: MAJBURIY — Mashq to'plami, Reading, Mini-vazifa (5 rules for a student hostel), Ovozli normativ (~45 daq); QO'SHIMCHA — Tarjima.

intro: HAVE TO — tashqi majburiyat (qoida, ish, boshqa odam): "I have to finish this report by tomorrow." O'tgan: had to; kelajak: will have to.
MUST — kuchli majburiyat, ko'pincha o'zim/qonun: "You must follow the safety guidelines." MUSTN'T = TAQIQ: "You mustn't smoke here."
DON'T HAVE TO / NEEDN'T = shart emas (ixtiyoriy): "She doesn't have to do it."
SHOULD — maslahat, to'g'ri ish: "You should apologize for your mistake." shouldn't = qilmagan ma'qul.
formulas: S + have/has to + V1 / don't/doesn't have to / Do/Does + S + have to?
I have to finish this report by tomorrow. / She doesn't have to do it. / Do you have to go there?
Men hisobotni ertagacha tugatishim shart. / U buni qilishi shart emas. / U yerga borishing shartmi?
You must follow the safety guidelines.
S + need to + V1 / needn't + V1
We need to paint the walls. / You needn't come early.
Devorlarni bo'yashimiz kerak. / Erta kelishing shart emas.
S + should/shouldn't + V1 / Should + S + V1?
You should apologize for your mistake. / Should I call the landlord?
Xatong uchun kechirim so'rashing kerak. / Uy egasiga qo'ng'iroq qilaymi?
We had to move last year. / You will have to pay a deposit.
O'tgan yili ko'chishimizga to'g'ri keldi. / Garov puli to'lashingga to'g'ri keladi.
presentation: Do you have to pay rent every month?
Yes, I have to pay it on the first.
Must tenants sign a lease?
Yes, they must sign it before moving in.
Should we paint the living room white?
Yes, you should — it'll look bigger.
Do I have to pay a deposit?
Yes, you have to pay one month's rent.
Can I keep a dog in the flat?
No, you mustn't keep pets here.
Do we need to fix the roof now?
No, you don't have to; it can wait until summer.
What should I do if the lock breaks?
You should call the landlord.
Did you have to move last year?
Yes, we had to move because of my job.
Do I have to take off my shoes?
Yes, in Uzbek homes you have to take off your shoes.
Will we have to renovate the kitchen?
Yes, you'll have to renovate it soon.
notes: must — yozma qoidalar va so'zlovchining o'z talabi; have to — tashqi majburiyat (qoida, boshqa odam, odat), og'zaki ko'proq. Qoida haqida gapirganda ko'pincha ikkalasi ham to'g'ri: Tenants must / have to sign the lease.
mustn't ≠ don't have to: mustn't = taqiq, don't have to = ixtiyoriy.
should = maslahat (qilgan ma'qul); shouldn't = qilmagan ma'qul.
Uy so'zlari: landlord (uy egasi), tenant (ijarachi), lease (ijara shartnomasi), mortgage (ipoteka).
Qiziquvchilar uchun: ought to ≈ should (rasmiyroq); had better = kuchli maslahat (aks holda muammo bo'ladi).
CCQ: You mustn't park here. — Can I park here? (No) — Is it a rule? (Yes)
CCQ: You don't have to park here. — Can I park here? (Yes) — Is it necessary? (No)
CCQ: I have to pay the rent on the first. — Is it my choice? (No) — Who makes the rule? (The landlord)
CCQ: You should call the landlord. — Is it a rule? (No) — Is it a good idea? (Yes)
mistakes: You mustn't come early — it's optional.
You don't have to come early.
Do you have to work? / Must you work?

how: CORE 20 — uy turlari va qismlari, ijara; STRONG — ijara va qurilish so'zlari; SUPER — hashamatli uy turlari, arxitektura va zamonaviy uy so'zlari.

class_ex.title: Progress Test 3 (14–19-darslar): ustoz uchun o'tkazish tartibi va ball jadvali
class_ex.instr: 20-dars: salomlashish + yo'riqnoma (3 daq) → Kahoot, 19-dars takrori (8 daq) → TEST (40 daq) → TEST TAHLILI (10 daq). Asosiy test — A variant; B variant — qayta topshirish uchun (ikkala variant bir xil tuzilma va qiyinlikda). Qamrov — faqat 14–19-darslar grammatikasi va CORE lug'ati; yangi mavzu yo'q.
items: 1. Dars oldidan: A variantdan har o'quvchiga 1 nusxa (A–E bo'limlar; D bo'limda matn savollardan oldin; E bo'lim uchun chiziqli joy va reja uchun kichik bo'sh joy), guruh uchun 1 ta ball varag'i chop eting. QOIDA: sinfdagi HAMMA o'quvchi A variantni yozadi — qo'shni partalarga A/B aralash tarqatilmaydi (ko'chirishning oldini partalarni ajratib olasiz). B variant papkada yopiq saqlanadi — u faqat qayta topshirish va remedialdan keyingi qayta yozish uchun. Testga kelmagan o'quvchi 7 kun ichida A variantni yozadi (bu asosiy test hisoblanadi). Ikkala variantning kaliti ham o'quvchilarga berilmaydi va proyektorga chiqarilmaydi.

2. Salomlashish bosqichi (3 daq): proyektorga faqat 'O'quvchi uchun yo'riqnoma' ni chiqaring va o'qib bering. Telefon, lug'at va daftarlar sumkaga olinadi; partada faqat ruchka (qoralama varaq berilmaydi — javoblar faqat test varag'iga yoziladi, E bo'lim rejasi varaqdagi bo'sh joyga); o'quvchilar alohida-alohida o'tiradi; varaqqa ism, familiya va sana yoziladi.
3. Kahoot (8 daq, 19-dars takrori: maqsad infinitivi + chalkash so'zlar) — testdan oldingi isinish. Keyin varaqlarni yuzini pastga qilib tarqating va proyektorga faqat taymerni chiqaring (40:00).

4. Vaqt taqsimoti (ustoz ovoz chiqarib e'lon qiladi): 0–10 daq — A. Grammatika; 10–15 — B. Lug'at; 15–20 — C. Tarjima; 20–30 — D. Reading; 30–40 — E. Writing. Har bo'lim tugashidan 1 daqiqa oldin ogohlantiring; kech kelgan o'quvchiga vaqt qo'shilmaydi.

5. Test paytida savollarga javob bermang (faqat topshiriq tushunarsiz bo'lsa, qavsdagi o'zbekcha ko'rsatmani qayta o'qib bering). Gaplashish yoki ko'chirishni ko'rsangiz — ogohlantiring; takrorlansa ishni yig'ib oling va holatni ball varag'iga yozing.

6. 40:00 tugagach varaqlarni yig'ing. TEST TAHLILI (10 daq) — varaqsiz va kalitsiz: kalit proyektorga chiqarilmaydi, test savollari o'qib berilmaydi (A variant kelmagan o'quvchilar uchun, B variant qayta topshirish uchun toza qolishi kerak). Ustoz 14–19-darslarda eng ko'p uchraydigan 5 xato turini doskada O'Z YANGI misollari bilan tushuntiradi, o'quvchilar og'zaki tuzatadi: 'Could you tell me where is…' → '…where … is' (L17), 'Unless you don't…' → 'Unless you…' (L16), 'for to buy' → 'to buy' (L19), 'I wish I have…' → 'I wish I had…' (L18), 'Who did steal…?' → 'Who stole…?' (L14). Ballar va shaxsiy xatolar 21-darsda aytiladi.

7. Tekshirish (dars tugagach, 48 soat ichida): A — har savol 2 yoki 0 (9–15 da to'g'ri shakl, lekin bitta harf imlo xatosi — 1; qisqa shakl hadn't = had not); B — 1 / 0.5 (bitta harf xatosi) / 0; C — har gap 1 (zamon/qolip) + 1 (so'z tartibi va lug'at); D — har savol 2.5 yoki 0 (qisqa javob 3 so'zdan oshsa — 0; ma'noni buzmaydigan imlo xatosi — ball beriladi); E — writing_a2 rubrikasi, 4 mezon × 0–5.

8. Natijani tizimga bo'limlar kesimida kiriting (A, B, C, D, E alohida + jami) va 21-darsda har o'quvchiga natija hamda keyingi qadamni ayting. Qayta topshirish va remedial sanasini shu kuni belgilang.
class_ex.answers: BALL → NATIJA → KEYINGI QADAM. (1) Jami 70–100 VA har bo'limda chegara bajarilgan (A ≥ 12, B ≥ 8, C ≥ 4, D ≥ 8, E ≥ 8) → O'TDI → kurs odatdagidek davom etadi; ball tizimga kiritiladi. (2) Jami 70 va undan yuqori, lekin biror bo'lim chegaradan past → QAYTA TOPSHIRISH → 7 kun ichida B variantdan faqat o'sha bo'lim(lar) o'z vaqti bilan qayta yoziladi (masalan, faqat D — 10 daqiqa). Yangi jami = eski jami − o'sha bo'limning eski bali + yangi bali; bu holatda 70 lik cheklov QO'LLANMAYDI — asosiy jami saqlanadi (masalan: jami 85, D = 6 → qayta D = 12 → jami 91). Qayta yozilgan bo'lim chegaraga yetsa → O'TDI. (3) Jami 50–69 → QAYTA TOPSHIRISH → 7 kun ichida B variantdan past bo'limlar qayta yoziladi: chegaradan past bo'limlar va o'z maksimumining 70% idan kam olingan bo'limlar (A < 21, B < 14, C < 7, D < 14, E < 14). Yangi jami = eski jami − qayta yozilgan bo'limlarning eski bali + yangi bali; faqat shu (3) holatda va (4) holatda qayta topshirishdan keyingi jami 70 dan yuqori hisoblanmaydi (masalan: 62 → qayta topshirishdan keyin 76 → tizimga 70 kiritiladi). Yangi jami ≥ 70 va har bo'lim chegarada → O'TDI. (4) Jami 50 dan kam → REMEDIAL → ustoz 2 ta qo'shimcha mashg'ulot o'tkazadi (har biri 30 daqiqa, eng zaif bo'limlar bo'yicha: masalan A past bo'lsa — 14–19-dars formulalari: savol tartibi, if-gaplar, bilvosita savol, wish, maqsad; B past bo'lsa — CORE ro'yxatlari va chalkash so'zlar; D past bo'lsa — T/F/NG strategiyasi), so'ng B variant to'liq (40 daqiqa) qayta yoziladi; bu natija ham 70 dan yuqori hisoblanmaydi. Qayta topshirishda ham chegara bajarilmasa — ustoz o'quv bo'limiga xabar beradi. Natija (asosiy va qayta topshirish) tizimga bo'limlar kesimida kiritiladi.

class_ex.title: O'quvchi uchun yo'riqnoma — Progress Test 3 (1 sahifa)
class_ex.type: Proyektorga chiqariladi va test oldidan o'qib beriladi
items: 1. Test 40 daqiqa davom etadi va 5 bo'limdan iborat: A. Grammatika — 30 ball (10 daq); B. Lug'at — 20 ball (5 daq); C. Tarjima — 10 ball (5 daq); D. Reading — 20 ball (10 daq); E. Writing — 20 ball (10 daq). Jami — 100 ball.

2. Test 14–19-darslarda o'tilgan grammatika (savollar, if-gaplar, during/while, if/unless, bilvosita savollar, wish, maqsad: to / in order to / so that) va lug'atdan (jinoyat, sayohat, taom, maktab, xarid, chalkash so'zlar) tuzilgan. Yangi mavzu yo'q.

3. Varaqning yuqorisiga ism, familiya va sanani yozing. Javoblarni ruchka bilan, faqat test varag'iga yozing. Tuzatmoqchi bo'lsangiz, eski javobni bir chiziq bilan o'chirib, yoniga yangisini yozing. Qoralama varaq berilmaydi: E bo'lim rejasini varaqdagi bo'sh joyga yozasiz. Ballaringiz va xatolaringiz keyingi darsda aytiladi.
4. Telefon, lug'at va daftar sumkada turadi. Gaplashish va boshqa o'quvchining ishiga qarash mumkin emas: ustoz ogohlantiradi, takrorlansa ish yig'ib olinadi.
5. Ustoz har bo'lim vaqti tugaganini aytadi — keyingi bo'limga o'ting. Vaqt qolsa, oxirida javoblaringizni qayta tekshiring.
6. A bo'lim: 1–8 savollarda bitta to'g'ri harfni (A, B, C yoki D) aylantiring; 9–15 da qavsdagi so'zni to'g'ri shaklda bo'sh joyga yozing (kerak bo'lsa, bir necha so'z).
7. B bo'lim: 1–15 — o'zbekcha so'zning inglizchasini yozing; 16–20 — qavsdagi ikki so'zdan to'g'risini yozing. Bitta harf xatosi bo'lsa — 0.5 ball.
8. C bo'lim: gapni to'liq inglizchaga tarjima qiling. To'g'ri zamon va qolip — 1 ball, to'g'ri so'z tartibi va so'zlar — yana 1 ball.
9. D bo'lim: TRUE — matnda aynan shunday yozilgan; FALSE — matnda buning aksi yozilgan; NOT GIVEN — matnda bu haqda ma'lumot yo'q. 6–8 savollarda matndan ko'pi bilan UCH so'z yozing.
10. E bo'lim: 70–80 so'zli e-mail yozing va oxirida so'zlar sonini yozing. Topshiriqdagi hamma talabni bajaring (If I …, I would …; wish; 2 ta muloyim bilvosita savol; maqsad — to / in order to).

11. O'tish sharti: jami kamida 70 ball VA har bir bo'limda kamida 40% (A — 12, B — 8, C — 4, D — 8, E — 8). Aks holda 7 kun ichida past bo'limni qayta yozasiz — bu jazo emas, qo'shimcha imkoniyat. Omad!
class_ex.answers: Yo'riqnoma — test boshlanishidan oldin (salomlashishning 3 daqiqasi ichida) o'qib beriladi; javob talab qilinmaydi.

class_ex.title: Ball varag'i — Progress Test 3 (bo'limlar bo'yicha)
class_ex.type: Har o'quvchi uchun 1 qator; natija tizimga shu bo'limlar bo'yicha kiritiladi
head: Bo'lim
Maksimum
O'tish chegarasi (40%)
Qanday baholanadi
Asosiy test (A variant)
Qayta topshirish (B variant)
rows: 5 gap × 2 ;; 1 — zamon/qolip, 1 — so'z tartibi va lug'at
class_ex.answers: To'ldirish: har bo'lim balini 'Asosiy test' ustuniga yozing, jamini hisoblang va natijani 1-topshiriqdagi jadval bo'yicha belgilang (O'TDI / QAYTA TOPSHIRISH / REMEDIAL). Qayta topshirishda faqat qayta yozilgan bo'lim(lar) ning yangi bali 'Qayta topshirish' ustuniga yoziladi va yangi jami hisoblanadi (eski jami − eski bo'lim bali + yangi bali). 70 lik cheklov: asosiy jami 70 va undan yuqori bo'lib, faqat bo'lim chegarasi bajarilmagan bo'lsa ((2) holat) — cheklov yo'q, yangi jami o'zicha kiritiladi; asosiy jami 70 dan past bo'lsa ((3) va (4) holat) — yangi jami 70 dan oshsa ham 70 deb kiritiladi. class_ex.title: Variant A — A. Grammatika (30 ball: 15 × 2)

reading.title: Amir Temur — a ruler and a builder
text: Amir Temur was born in 1336 near Shahrisabz. In 1370 he became a ruler, and he made Samarkand his capital. He built a huge empire, but today people remember him not only as a general. They remember him as a builder.

Temur wanted a beautiful capital. He brought the best architects, builders and artists from other lands — from Iran, India, Syria and other countries — and they had to live and work in Samarkand. Under his rule, builders built the Bibi-Khanym Mosque, many tombs in the Shah-i-Zinda complex and the Ak-Saray palace in Shahrisabz. The gate of Ak-Saray was so high that visitors had to look up to see the top of it.

Historians say that the stones for Bibi-Khanym were very heavy, so the workers had to use elephants from India to carry them. Temur also built roads, bridges and caravanserais so that traders could travel safely. Many people say that a good ruler should protect traders, scientists and craftsmen — and Temur did this.

Temur died in 1405 and is buried in the Gur-Emir mausoleum in Samarkand. Many historians say that Gur-Emir later influenced famous tombs in India, for example the Taj Mahal. Today these buildings are very old, and the city must look after them carefully. Visitors mustn't climb on the old walls. But you don't have to be a historian to feel Temur's power: you should simply stand in front of Gur-Emir and look up.

kahoot.q: You ___ smoke in the building. It's against the rules.
kahoot.explain: Taqiq (mumkin emas) → mustn't. don't have to / needn't — shart emas.

kahoot.q: I must ___ now — my bus is leaving.
kahoot.explain: must dan keyin to qo'yilmaydi: must + V1 (go).

kahoot.q: Tomorrow is Sunday, so I ___ get up early.
kahoot.explain: Ixtiyoriy, majbur emas → don't have to. mustn't — taqiq bo'lardi.

kahoot.q: She ___ pay the rent on the first day of every month.
kahoot.explain: she → has to + V1. «must to» — xato (to kerak emas).

kahoot.q: You ___ apologise to your neighbour — it's the right thing to do.
kahoot.explain: Maslahat, to'g'ri ish → should + V1.

kahoot.q: Qaysi gapda XATO bor?
options: She has to not pay the deposit.
She doesn't have to pay the deposit.
She has to pay the deposit.
Does she have to pay the deposit?
kahoot.explain: have to inkori do/does bilan: She doesn't have to pay.

kahoot.q: Last year we ___ paint the whole flat ourselves.
kahoot.explain: must ning o'tgan shakli yo'q → had to (Last year — o'tgan).

kahoot.q: Tarjima: «Erta kelishing shart emas.»
kahoot.explain: needn't + V1 = shart emas. mustn't — taqiq (mumkin emas).

kahoot.q: ___ you have to work on Saturdays?
kahoot.explain: have to savoli do/does bilan: Do you have to work...?

kahoot.q: MUSTN'T nimani bildiradi?
kahoot.explain: mustn't = taqiq: You mustn't touch the wires.

kahoot.q: The lift is broken, so we'll ___ use the stairs.
kahoot.explain: will dan keyin must bo'lmaydi → will have to + V1.

kahoot.q: Should I ___ the landlord about the broken window?
kahoot.explain: Should + ega + V1? (to qo'yilmaydi).

kahoot.q: The person who owns the flat and gets the rent is the ___.
kahoot.explain: landlord — uy egasi (ijaraga beruvchi). tenant — ijarachi.

kahoot.q: A person who pays rent to live in a flat is a ___.
kahoot.explain: tenant — ijarachi (ijara haqi to'laydi).

kahoot.q: We keep old boxes in the ___ under the house.
kahoot.explain: basement — yerto'la (pastda). attic — chordoq (tom ostida).

kahoot.q: A very tall building in a big city is a ___.
kahoot.explain: skyscraper — osmono'par bino. cottage — kichik qishloq uyi.

kahoot.q: Before you move in, you pay a ___; you get it back when you leave.
kahoot.explain: deposit — garov puli (qaytariladi). mortgage — ipoteka.

kahoot.q: «ta'mirlash» — inglizcha?
kahoot.explain: renovation — ta'mirlash. foundation — poydevor, inspection — tekshiruv.

kahoot.q: Smoke goes out of the house through the ___.
kahoot.explain: chimney — mo'ri. gutter — tarnov.

kahoot.q: The top part of a room above your head is the ___.
kahoot.explain: ceiling — shift (xona ichidagi yuqori qism). roof — tom (binoning ustki qismi), floor — pol/qavat.

lessons.title: Passive Voice (Simple)
lessons.grammar_topic: MAJHUL NISBAT — PRESENT / PAST / FUTURE SIMPLE PASSIVE (be + V3)
lessons.vocab_topic: Ages and stages of life (yosh va hayot bosqichlari)
lessons.book_ref: Asosiy material — shu reja (formula jadvali, mashqlar, matn). Ixtiyoriy qo'shimcha: Student's book IELTS 2.0, Lesson 21 — dars kitobsiz ham to'liq o'tiladi.
objectives: Active gapni Present / Past / Future Simple Passive'ga o'tkazadi (be + V3, kerak bo'lsa by): 8 ta gapdan kamida 6 tasi to'g'ri.
Passive tasdiq, inkor va savolni tuzadi: 'be + V3' mashqining 8 bandidan kamida 6 tasi to'g'ri.

Hayot bosqichlari CORE 20 va was born / was raised / was named after bilan o'zi haqida 6 passive gap aytadi; Part 2 kartochkasi bo'yicha 1 daqiqa gapiradi va 60–70 so'zli paragraf yozadi (kamida 4 passive).
Reading: Navoiy haqidagi matnda 6 ta passive gapni topadi; TRUE / FALSE / NOT GIVEN ning 5 bandidan kamida 4 tasi to'g'ri.
Kombinatsiya: Present va Past Simple Passive jadvalini (6 qator) 1 daqiqada kamida 2 marta (normativ) aytadi.
materials: Formula jadvali — rejaning Grammatika bo'limi (grammar.formulas), proyektor yoki doska
Ages and stages of life (yosh va hayot bosqichlari) CORE 20 varag'i.
Kahoot: 'O'tgan dars Kahooti' tugmasi (20-dars savollari)
timeline: Salomlashish + kirish savoli
Ustoz: "Somebody built this school in 1995." → "This school was built in 1995." Kim qurgani muhim emas — NIMA bo'lgani muhim. Doskaga: be + V3.
Kahoot — 20-dars takrori: Modal Verbs: have to, need, must, should + Home and buildings
'O'tgan dars Kahooti' tugmasi (20-dars Kahooti: 20 savol, har biriga 15 soniya). Bugungi dars Kahootini ochmang — u 22-dars boshida o'ynaladi.
YOZMA NORMATIV — 20-dars lug'ati: Home and buildings (CORE 20)
Ustoz 20 so'zni o'zbekcha aytadi, o'quvchi inglizchasini yozadi — 5 daqiqa; 1 daqiqa juftlikda CORE varag'i bilan tekshirish. 18–20 to'g'ri — 2 coin.
Uyga vazifa tekshiruvi
20-dars uyga vazifasi: Mashq to'plami — kalit proyektorda, o'quvchi o'zi belgilaydi; Reading va mini-vazifadan 2–3 javob og'zaki tekshiriladi.
YANGI MAVZU — Passive Voice: Present / Past / Future Simple (be + V3)

Formula jadvali (grammar.formulas): Present — S + am/is/are + V3 (Schools are built every year); Past — S + was/were + V3 (The hospital was built last year); Future — S + will be + V3 (The hotel will be built next year); inkor — be + not + V3; savol — Be + S + V3?; "by + bajaruvchi" faqat bajaruvchi muhim bo'lsa. So'ng grammar.presentation bo'yicha savol-javob. + 3 CCQ (grammar.notes).
Ages and stages of life (yosh va hayot bosqichlari) — CORE 20
Har so'z: talaffuz → tarjima → vocab misoli (passive gap); o'quvchi o'zi yoki oila a'zosi haqida 1 gap aytadi: "I was named after …", "My grandfather retired at …".
Kombinatsiya

Kombinatsiya — o'quvchi bugungi formula jadvalini (tasdiq → inkor → savol, har qatorga 1 misol + o'zbekcha tarjima) yoddan, to'xtamasdan aytib chiqadi va 1 daqiqada necha marta to'liq aytgani sanaladi. Bugun: S + am/is/are + V3 / S + am/is/are + not + V3 / Am/Is/Are + S + V3? / S + was/were + V3 / S + wasn't/weren't + V3 / Was/Were + S + V3? (English is spoken here. / English isn't spoken here. / Is English spoken here? / The school was built in 2005. / The school wasn't built in 2005. / Was the school built in 2005?) Juftlikda: biri aytadi, biri sanaydi. 1 daqiqada 1 marta — warm-up, 2 marta — normativ, 3 marta — 2 coin.
Sinf mashqlari
Majburiy: Passive'ga o'tkazing (6 daq, yakka), be + V3 (6 daq, yakka), Mening biografiyam (6 daq, juftlik), Hayot bosqichlari (5 daq, juftlik). ZAXIRA: by kerakmi?, Xatoni toping.
Reading
Jony Academy matni (Alisher Navoiy): 1-o'qish — 6 ta passive gapni topish; 2-o'qish — TRUE / FALSE / NOT GIVEN; oxirida 3 ta qisqa savol. Javoblar birga tekshiriladi.
Writing / speaking mini-vazifa

Mini-vazifa: A person I admire — IELTS Part 2 mini-kartochka: 1 daqiqa tayyorgarlik + 1 daqiqa gapirish (juftlikda navbat bilan, 4 daq); so'ng yakka 60–70 so'zli paragraf, kamida 4 passive (8 daq) — Final Test writing'iga tayyorgarlik. Mezon: speaking_mini va mini_writing.
Xatolar ustida ishlash + exit ticket

4 daqiqa: mini-vazifadagi eng ko'p uchragan 3 xato doskada (was wrote → was written; "He born" → He was born; yesterday bilan will be); kuchlilarga STRONG so'zlar bilan 2 passive gap. Oxirgi 3 daqiqa: Exit ticket (class_ex oxirgi mashqi).
Uyga vazifa
Mashq to'plami, yozma ish va ovozli normativ — majburiy (ovozli normativ 22-darsgacha); tarjima va kartochkalar — qo'shimcha.

intro: Active: "People speak English here" → Passive: "English is spoken here". Ob'ekt (English) — yangi ega; fe'l — be + V3.
be zamonni ko'rsatadi: is/are (hozir), was/were (o'tgan), will be (kelajak). V3 o'zgarmaydi.
Bajaruvchi kerak bo'lsa — by: "The poem was written by Navoi." Noma'lum/muhim emas bo'lsa — tushiriladi.
Biografiyada passive ko'p: was born, was raised, was educated, was called, is remembered.
formulas: The hospital was built last year.
The hotel will be built next year.
presentation: Where were you born?
I was born in Fergana.
Where was Navoi born?
He was born in Herat in 1441.
Is Uzbek spoken in Afghanistan?
Yes, it is spoken in the north of the country.
Who was "Khamsa" written by?

notes: Passive faqat ob'ektli (transitive) fe'llarda: "arrive, happen, sleep" — passive bo'lmaydi.
Modal bilan passive: must be done, can be seen, should be finished (20-dars bilan bog'lang).
Yosh bosqichlari: infancy → childhood → adolescence → adulthood → middle age → old age.
CCQ: English is spoken here. — Do people speak English here? (Yes) — Is it important who speaks it? (No)
CCQ: "Khamsa" was written by Navoi. — Who wrote it? (Navoi) — Is it now or in the past? (In the past)
CCQ: The new school will be built next year. — Is the school ready now? (No) — Do we know who will build it? (No, it isn't important)
Qiziquvchilar uchun: ikki ob'ektli fe'llar — "She was given a prize" / "A prize was given to her" (sinfda mashq qilinmaydi).
mistakes: The book was wrote by Navoi.
The book was written by Navoi.
The bridge was built next year.
The bridge will be built next year.
The letter was sent by yesterday.

reading.title: Alisher Navoi — the poet whose words are still read
text: Alisher Navoi was born in Herat in 1441. He was raised in a family of officials, and his childhood was spent close to the palace. His friend from school was Husayn Bayqara, who later became the ruler of Herat. Navoi was educated in Herat, Mashhad and Samarkand, and as a young man he was already known as a poet.

In the 15th century, most poetry in Central Asia was written in Persian. Turkic, the language of ordinary people, was not often used for serious literature. Navoi changed this. His poems were written in Old Uzbek (Chagatai), and he showed that this language was as rich as Persian. His most famous work, "Khamsa" (Five Poems), was finished in 1485. About 26,000 couplets (more than 50,000 lines) were written for it.

Navoi was also a minister. Under him, many schools, hospitals, mosques and bridges were built in Herat. Poor students were given money, and artists were supported. He never married and had no children.

Navoi died in 1501. Today his name is given to a city, a region, a metro station, a theatre and the national library of Uzbekistan. His poems are still read at weddings and at school, and many of his lines are known by heart.
