lessons.title: Passive Voice (Continuous)
lessons.grammar_topic: MAJHUL NISBAT — PRESENT / PAST CONTINUOUS PASSIVE (be + being + V3)
lessons.book_ref: Asosiy material — shu reja (formula jadvali, mashqlar, matn). Ixtiyoriy qo'shimcha: Student's book IELTS 2.0, Lesson 22 — dars kitobsiz ham to'liq o'tiladi.
objectives: Present Continuous Passive (am/is/are being + V3): 'Continuous passive' mashqidagi 8 bandning kamida 6 tasini to'g'ri to'ldiradi.
Past Continuous Passive (was/were being + V3) ni tanib oladi va tanlaydi (A2): Reading'dagi 4 ta shunday gapni topadi.
Simple va continuous passive farqi: 3 ta CCQ ga to'g'ri javob beradi; 'Simple yoki Continuous passive' mashqidagi 6 gapdan kamida 5 tasida to'g'ri tanlaydi.
Mini-vazifa: 60–70 so'zlik paragraf — shahrida hozir nima qilinyapti (kamida 4 ta is/are being + V3).
Reading TRUE / FALSE / NOT GIVEN (5 band) va Listening gap-fill (6 band) — har birida kamida 4 ta to'g'ri.
Kombinatsiya: 4 qatorli jadvalni 1 daqiqada kamida 2 marta aytadi (normativ).
materials: Formula jadvali — rejaning Grammatika bo'limi (grammar.formulas), proyektor yoki doska
Money (pul va moliya) CORE 20 varag'i.
Kahoot: 'O'tgan dars Kahooti' tugmasi (21-dars savollari)
timeline: Salomlashish + kirish savoli

Kirish savoli: "What is being built or repaired in our city now?" Ustoz doskaga yozadi: "The road is being repaired." → is being + V3 (hozir jarayonda); "Yesterday at 5 pm, the road was being repaired too." → was being + V3.
Kahoot — 21-dars takrori: Passive Voice (Simple) + Ages and stages of life
'O'tgan dars Kahooti' tugmasi (21-dars Kahooti: 20 savol, har biriga 15 soniya). Bugungi dars Kahootini ochmang — u 23-dars boshida o'ynaladi.
YOZMA NORMATIV — 21-dars lug'ati: Ages and stages of life (CORE 20)
Ustoz 20 so'zni o'zbekcha aytadi, o'quvchi inglizchasini yozadi — 5 daqiqa; 1 daqiqa juftlikda CORE varag'i bilan tekshirish. 18–20 to'g'ri — 2 coin.
Uyga vazifa tekshiruvi
21-dars Mashq to'plami kaliti proyektorda, juftlikda tekshiriladi; eng ko'p xato qilingan 2 band doskada.
YANGI MAVZU — Present / Past Continuous Passive

Formula jadvali (grammar.formulas): Present Continuous Passive — S + am/is/are + being + V3 (The hospital is being built); Past Continuous Passive — S + was/were + being + V3, tanib olish darajasida (The hotel was being built when I came). Farq: odatiy / har oy / tugagan ish → simple (Salaries are paid every month); hozir jarayonda → continuous (Your salary is being paid now). Future Continuous Passive yo'q → will be + V3. presentation juftlikda. + 3 CCQ (grammar.notes).
Money (pul va moliya) — CORE 20
Ustoz so'zni aytadi, o'quvchilar takrorlaydi; har o'quvchi 2–3 so'z bilan passive gap aytadi ("Your balance is being updated." / "Pocket money is given to me every Friday.").
Kombinatsiya

Kombinatsiya — o'quvchi bugungi formula jadvalini (tasdiq → inkor → savol, har qatorga 1 misol + o'zbekcha tarjima) yoddan, to'xtamasdan aytib chiqadi va 1 daqiqada necha marta to'liq aytgani sanaladi. Bugun: S + am/is/are + being + V3 / S + am/is/are + not + being + V3 / Am/Is/Are + S + being + V3? / S + was/were + being + V3. Juftlikda: biri aytadi, biri sanaydi. 1 daqiqada 1 marta — warm-up, 2 marta — normativ, 3 marta — 2 coin.
Sinf mashqlari

Majburiy: Continuous passive (6 daq, yakka), Simple yoki Continuous passive (5 daq, yakka), Active → Passive (4 daq, juftlik), Mini-vazifa: What is being done in our city? (8 daq: 2 daq juftlikda og'zaki + 6 daq yozma). ZAXIRA: Pul lug'ati, Xatoni toping.
Reading
Matn: 1-o'qish — umumiy mazmun; keyin passive gaplarni topish (simple / continuous), TRUE / FALSE / NOT GIVEN (5 band), 3 qisqa savol.
Listening
Ustoz transcript'ni 2 marta o'qiydi: 1-marta gist savol, 2-marta topshiriqlar; javoblar birga tekshiriladi.
Xatolar ustida ishlash + exit ticket
Ko'p uchragan 3–4 xato doskada (grammar.mistakes), ayniqsa "every month → are paid" (being emas). Oxirgi 3 daqiqa — Exit ticket. ZAXIRA mashqlar — kuchlilarga.
Uyga vazifa
Mashq to'plami, yozma ish 'Money in my family', ovozli normativ; qo'shimcha — tarjima.

intro: Present Continuous Passive — HOZIR bajarilayotgan ish, bajaruvchi muhim emas: "The hospital is being built" (hozir qurilyapti).
Past Continuous Passive — o'tgan paytda bajarilayotgan edi: "At 5 pm the hotel was being built." (A2: tanib olish va tanlash darajasida).
Formula: be (zamonda) + being + V3. "being" o'zgarmaydi.
Future Continuous Passive ishlatilmaydi — o'rniga Future Simple Passive: "will be built".
formulas: The hotel was being built when I came.
The money isn't being spent wisely.
Is your salary being paid on time?
is paid (har oy) — is being paid (hozir)
Salaries are paid monthly. / Your salary is being paid now.
Maosh har oy to'lanadi. / Maoshing hozir to'lanyapti.
will be + V3 (Future Continuous Passive yo'q)
The new bank will be opened in May.
presentation: What is being built near your house?
A new bank is being built.
Is your salary being paid on time?
Yes, it's paid on the fifth every month.
What was being discussed at the meeting?
The budget was being discussed.
Is the money being spent on education?

Yes, it was being repaired.
Are prices being raised again?

Because the money was being counted.
Is your loan being paid off now?
Yes, it's being paid off. A payment is made every month.
What is being done about inflation?
New laws are being prepared.
notes: "being" — faqat continuous passive'da; simple passive'da yo'q (is built ≠ is being built).

Continuous passive — faqat hozir yoki o'sha paytda jarayondagi ish (now, at the moment; when / while / at 5 pm). Odatiy, takroriy (every month, as usual) va tugagan ish → simple passive: "Salaries are paid every month."
Pul so'zlari: salary (oylik), wage (soatlik/haftalik haqi), income (daromad), loan (kredit), debt (qarz), interest (foiz).
Listening: bank e'lonlarida passive ko'p ("Your account is being updated").
CCQ: Your salary is being paid now. — Is the payment happening at this moment? (Yes) — Is it finished? (Not yet)
CCQ: Salaries are paid on the 5th every month. — Is this happening only now? (No) — Does it happen again and again? (Yes — every month)
CCQ: The bridge was being built when I came. — Was the bridge finished when I came? (No) — Was the work in progress? (Yes)
CCQ: The bridge was built in 1990. — Is the work finished? (Yes) — Are we talking about the process or the finished action? (The finished action)
mistakes: The house is being built now.
The bank will be being opened.
Is your salary being paid now?
Salaries are being paid on the 5th every month.
Salaries are paid on the 5th every month.
Har oy takrorlanadi → simple passive (being emas).

reading.title: Lionel Messi — the boy who needed help to grow
text: Lionel Messi was born in 1987 in Rosario, Argentina. When he was a child, doctors found that he had a growth problem. He needed expensive treatment every month, but his family could not pay for it. In 2000, FC Barcelona agreed to pay for the treatment, and his first contract was written on a paper napkin.

Messi moved to Spain at 13. While he was being trained at the club's academy, his treatment was being paid for by the club. He worked hard, and at 17 he played his first match for Barcelona. Soon he was being watched by football fans all over the world.

Messi stayed at Barcelona until 2021. That summer, a new contract was being prepared for him, but the club had serious money problems, and he had to leave. He played in France for two years. In 2022 he won the World Cup with Argentina, and in 2023 he moved to Inter Miami in the USA. In the same year, he won the Ballon d'Or for the eighth time.

Messi also has a charity foundation that helps children with their health and education. Aziz, 15, from Namangan, is a big fan. "This month, money is being collected at our school for a children's hospital," he says. "Messi's story shows that money can really help people."
glossary: serious money problems — jiddiy moliyaviy muammolar

kahoot.q: The road is being ___ at the moment.

The house was being built in May.
The house will be built soon.

kahoot.q: Is your salary ___ paid on time this month?
kahoot.explain: Continuous Passive savol: Is + ega + being + V3?

lessons.title: Passive Voice (Perfect)
lessons.grammar_topic: MAJHUL NISBAT — PRESENT / PAST / FUTURE PERFECT PASSIVE (have been + V3)
lessons.book_ref: Asosiy material — shu reja (formula jadvali, mashqlar, matn). Ixtiyoriy qo'shimcha: Student's book IELTS 2.0, Lesson 23 — dars kitobsiz ham to'liq o'tiladi.
objectives: Present Perfect Passive (has/have been + V3) ni tasdiq, inkor va savolda tuzadi: 8 ta gapdan kamida 6 tasini to'g'ri to'ldiradi.

Past Perfect Passive (had been + V3) va Future Perfect Passive (will have been + V3) ni tanib oladi va passive oilasidan (is / is being / has been + V3) to'g'ri shaklni tanlaydi: 3 ta tanlash bandidan kamida 2 tasi.
On the road CORE 20 ni biladi va yo'l yangiligini 60–70 so'zli paragrafda yozadi (kamida 3 ta has/have been + V3).
Reading: Jalolov matnidan perfect passive gaplarni topadi, T/F/NG da 5 dan 4.
Listening: yo'l yangiliklari gap-fill'da 6 dan kamida 4 ta to'g'ri javob.
Kombinatsiya: 1 daqiqada 3 / 4 / 5 marta (warm-up / normativ / 2 coin).
materials: Formula jadvali — rejaning Grammatika bo'limi (grammar.formulas), proyektor yoki doska
On the road (yo'lda) CORE 20 varag'i.
Kahoot: 'O'tgan dars Kahooti' tugmasi (22-dars savollari)
timeline: Salomlashish + kirish savoli
Ustoz: "Has the homework been checked? — Yes, it has been checked." Kirish savoli: "What has been changed in our street this year?" Doskaga: has/have been + V3.
Kahoot — 22-dars takrori: Passive Voice (Continuous) + Money
'O'tgan dars Kahooti' tugmasi (22-dars Kahooti: 20 savol, har biriga 15 soniya). Bugungi dars Kahootini ochmang — u 24-dars boshida o'ynaladi.
YOZMA NORMATIV — 22-dars lug'ati: Money (CORE 20)
Ustoz 20 so'zni o'zbekcha aytadi, o'quvchi inglizchasini yozadi — 5 daqiqa; 1 daqiqa juftlikda CORE varag'i bilan tekshirish. 18–20 to'g'ri — 2 coin.
Uyga vazifa tekshiruvi
22-dars Mashq to'plami: kalit proyektorda, o'quvchilar daftarni almashtirib juftlikda belgilaydi; eng ko'p xato qilingan 2 band doskada tushuntiriladi.
YANGI MAVZU — Perfect Passive

Formula jadvali (grammar.formulas): tasdiq S + have/has been + V3 → inkor haven't/hasn't been + V3 → savol Have/Has + S + been + V3? Past / Future Perfect Passive (had been, will have been + V3) — faqat tanib olish, belgisi 'by + vaqt'. Passive oilasi: is / is being / has been repaired. grammar.presentation juftlikda. + 3 CCQ (grammar.notes).
On the road (yo'lda) — CORE 20
Har so'z misol gapi bilan (vocab.core); ustoz so'zni aytadi, o'quvchilar takrorlaydi. Keyin 5 ta so'z bilan og'zaki: "… has been closed / repaired / put up".
Kombinatsiya

Kombinatsiya — o'quvchi bugungi formula jadvalini (tasdiq → inkor → savol, har qatorga 1 misol + o'zbekcha tarjima) yoddan, to'xtamasdan aytib chiqadi va 1 daqiqada necha marta to'liq aytgani sanaladi. Bugun: S + have/has been + V3 / S + haven't/hasn't been + V3 / Have/Has + S + been + V3? Juftlikda: biri aytadi, biri sanaydi. 1 daqiqada 3 marta — warm-up, 4 marta — normativ, 5 marta — 2 coin.
Sinf mashqlari

Majburiy: Perfect passive (6 daq, yakka), Active → Passive (5 daq, yakka), Yo'lda muammo (5 daq, juftlik), Mini-vazifa: Road news (7 daq, yakka yozma + juftlikda og'zaki). ZAXIRA: Passive oilasi, Yo'l lug'ati, Xatoni toping.
Reading
Bakhodir Jalolov matni: o'qish + glossary (4 daq) → perfect passive gaplarni topish (3 daq) → TRUE / FALSE / NOT GIVEN (3 daq) → qisqa savollar (2 daq).
Listening
Ustoz transcript'ni 2 marta o'qiydi: 1-marta gist savol, 2-marta topshiriqlar; javoblar birga tekshiriladi.
Xatolar ustida ishlash + exit ticket
6 daqiqa: darsdagi ko'p uchragan xatolar doskada (been tushib qolishi, V3 o'rniga V1, will has been); STRONG lug'at — kuchlilarga (+1 coin). Oxirgi 3 daqiqa: Exit ticket (class_ex oxirida).
Uyga vazifa
Mashq to'plami (12 band), "Shahrim yo'llari" paragrafi, ovozli normativ (CORE 20) — majburiy; tarjima — qo'shimcha. Ovozli normativ 24-darsgacha yuboriladi.

intro: Present Perfect Passive — ish bajarilgan, natija hozir: "The road has been closed" (yo'l yopilgan — hozir yopiq).
Past Perfect Passive — o'tgan nuqtagacha bajarilgan edi: "By 2020 the bridge had been built." (A2: tanib olish)
Future Perfect Passive — kelajak nuqtagacha bajarilgan bo'ladi: "By 2050 the hotel will have been built." (A2: tanib olish)
Formula: have/has/had/will have + been + V3. "been" o'zgarmaydi.
formulas: The hospital had been built by 2020.
The hotel will have been built by 2050.
The road hasn't been repaired yet.
is repaired / is being repaired / has been repaired
Roads are repaired every spring. / The road is being repaired. / The road has been repaired.
Yo'llar har bahorda ta'mirlanadi. / Yo'l ta'mirlanyapti. / Yo'l ta'mirlangan (ta'mirlab bo'lingan).
presentation: Has the road been repaired yet?
Yes, it has just been repaired.
Had the bridge been built before you moved here?
Yes, it had been built by 2015.
Will the motorway have been finished by next year?
Yes, it will have been finished by summer.
Has your car ever been stolen?
No, it has never been stolen.
Have the road signs been changed?
Yes, new signs have been put up.
Has the driver been fined?
Yes, he has been fined for speeding.
Has the new bridge been opened yet?
No, it hasn't been opened yet — maybe next month.
Had the accident been reported when the police came?
Yes, it had already been reported.
notes: already / just / yet / ever / never — have va been orasida: "has already been done", "has never been stolen".
by + vaqt → Past Perfect / Future Perfect Passive (A2 da faqat tanib olish va tanlash).
Yo'l so'zlari: traffic jam (tirbandlik), rush hour (tig'iz vaqt), breakdown (buzilish), detour (aylanma yo'l).
Qiziquvchilar uchun: modal + perfect passive — "The tyre should have been checked" (tekshirilishi kerak edi).
CCQ: The road has been closed. — Is the road open now? (No) — Is it important who closed it? (No)
CCQ: The road is being repaired. / The road has been repaired. — In which sentence are the workers still working? (is being repaired) — In which can we drive now? (has been repaired)
CCQ: By 2020 the bridge had been built. — Was the bridge ready in 2020? (Yes) — Was it built before or after 2020? (Before)
CCQ: The tunnel will have been finished by 2027. — Is the tunnel ready now? (No) — Will it be ready in 2027? (Yes)
mistakes: The bridge had been built by 2020.
The hotel will has been built.
The hotel will have been built.

how: CORE 20 — yo'l va haydash asosiy so'zlari; STRONG — tirbandlik va hodisalar; SUPER — magistral va texnik so'zlar.

reading.title: Bakhodir Jalolov — a champion from Surkhandarya
text: Bakhodir Jalolov was born in 1994 in the Surkhandarya region of Uzbekistan. He is about two metres tall, and in amateur boxing he fights in the heaviest division, super-heavyweight. Like many sportsmen, he trained for many years before he became famous.

Jalolov won Olympic gold medals in Tokyo (2021) and in Paris (2024). By the end of the Paris Games, his name had been written in Olympic history twice. His fights have been watched by millions of people, and he has been called one of the best amateur boxers of his generation by many sports journalists.
Jalolov also boxes as a professional. So far (2024), he has won all his professional fights, and many of his opponents have been knocked out.

His success has been noticed by young people all over Uzbekistan. New boxing clubs have been opened in many towns, and a lot of children have been inspired to start boxing. Sardor, 14, from Termez, is one of them. "I have been training for a year, and my first competition has been planned for May," he says. "My coach says that by the summer I will have been chosen for the regional team. I hope he's right!"

transcript: Presenter: Good afternoon. This is the four o'clock traffic news on City Radio.
Presenter: The Tashkent–Samarkand highway has been closed near Jizzakh because of a crash between a lorry and three cars.
Presenter: Luckily, nobody has been badly hurt, but three cars have been damaged.

Presenter: The police have been called, and a detour has been set up through the old road. Drivers have been asked to slow down there — the speed limit on the old road has been lowered to 50 kilometres an hour.
Presenter: In the city, the rush hour has started early today. There is a long traffic jam on Amir Temur Street, because one lane has been closed for roadworks.
Presenter: And some good news: new road signs have finally been put up near the airport.
Presenter: The highway will have been reopened by seven o'clock this evening. Drive carefully, and have a safe trip home!

kahoot.q: The road has been ___ because of the snow.
kahoot.explain: has been + V3: has been closed (yopilgan — hozir ham yopiq).

kahoot.q: The road ___ repaired yet.
kahoot.explain: Perfect Passive inkor: hasn't been + V3. «yet» — Perfect belgisi.

kahoot.q: By 2020, the bridge ___ built.
kahoot.explain: O'tgan nuqtagacha (By 2020) tugagan → had been + V3.

kahoot.q: By 2050, the new highway will ___ built.
kahoot.explain: Kelajak nuqtagacha: will have been + V3. will dan keyin «has» emas.

kahoot.q: ___ the car been fixed?
kahoot.explain: Perfect Passive savol: Has + ega + been + V3?

kahoot.q: Qaysi gapda XATO bor?
options: A new bridge has been built.
kahoot.explain: Yo'l o'zi ta'mirlamaydi → been kerak: has been repaired.

kahoot.q: Active → Passive: «They have closed the tunnel.»
kahoot.explain: have closed → has been closed (tunnel — birlik, V3).

kahoot.q: Tarjima: «Mashina hali tuzatilmagan.»
options: The car hasn't been fixed yet.
The car isn't been fixed yet.
The car didn't been fixed yet.
kahoot.explain: hasn't been + V3 (fixed) + yet.

kahoot.q: «Ko'prik qurib bo'lingan (natija hozir).» Qaysi gap?
options: The bridge is built every year.
kahoot.explain: Natija hozir → Present Perfect Passive: has been built. is being built — hali qurilyapti.

kahoot.q: Qaysi gap TO'G'RI?
options: The road will have been finished by May.
The road will has been finished by May.
The road will have be finished by May.
The road will been finished by May.
kahoot.explain: Future Perfect Passive: will have been + V3.

kahoot.q: Two cars ___ damaged in the accident.
kahoot.explain: cars — ko'plik → have been + V3 (damaged).

kahoot.q: Perfect Passive formulasi qaysi?
kahoot.explain: have/has/had/will have + been + V3. «been» o'zgarmaydi.

kahoot.q: Cars move very slowly in a traffic ___.
kahoot.explain: traffic jam — tirbandlik.

kahoot.q: The busy time when everyone goes to work is ___ hour.
kahoot.explain: rush hour — tig'iz vaqt.

kahoot.q: I can't drive — my tyre is ___. There's no air in it.
kahoot.explain: flat tyre — teshilgan (havosi chiqqan) g'ildirak.

kahoot.q: We ran ___ of petrol on the highway.
kahoot.explain: run out of petrol — benzin tugab qolmoq.

kahoot.q: The police asked the driver to pull ___ at the side of the road.
kahoot.explain: pull over — yo'l chetiga to'xtamoq.

kahoot.q: Don't ___ on a bend — it's dangerous to pass other cars there.
kahoot.explain: overtake — quvib o'tmoq (boshqa mashinadan o'tib ketmoq).

kahoot.q: A road that you must pay to use is a ___ road.
kahoot.explain: toll road — pullik yo'l.

kahoot.q: «aylanma yo'l» — inglizcha?
kahoot.explain: detour — aylanma yo'l. lane — yo'l qatori (polosa).

lessons.title: Adjectives -ed vs -ing
lessons.grammar_topic: -ED va -ING SIFATLAR (bored — boring)
lessons.book_ref: Asosiy material — shu reja (formula jadvali, mashqlar, matn). Ixtiyoriy qo'shimcha: Student's book IELTS 2.0, Lesson 24 — dars kitobsiz ham to'liq o'tiladi.
objectives: -ed (his) va -ing (xususiyat) sifatlarini farqlaydi: '-ed yoki -ing' mashqidagi 8 gapdan kamida 6 tasida to'g'ri tanlaydi.
Predloglarni (interested in, excited about, tired of…) 5 gapdan kamida 4 tasida to'g'ri qo'yadi.
Transport CORE so'zlari bilan IELTS Part 1 savollariga 45–60 soniya javob beradi (2 ta -ed, 2 ta -ing).
Reja qolipi bo'yicha 80–100 so'zli paragraf yozadi (Final Test E talabi; kamida 4 bog'lovchi); T/F/NG ning 5 bandidan 4 tasini to'g'ri belgilaydi.
Kombinatsiya: 3 qatorli jadvalni 1 daqiqada kamida 4 marta aytadi (normativ).
materials: Formula jadvali — rejaning Grammatika bo'limi (grammar.formulas), proyektor yoki doska
Transport (transport) CORE 20 varag'i.
Kahoot: 'O'tgan dars Kahooti' tugmasi (23-dars savollari)
writing_a2 rubrikasi — proyektorda.
Final Test o'quvchi yo'riqnomasi — test paketi 'final'
timeline: Salomlashish + kirish savoli
Ustoz zerikkan yuz bilan: "I am bored." Keyin darsga ishora qilib: "This lesson is boring?!" — sinf kuladi. Farq: -ed = mening hissim; -ing = narsaning xususiyati.
Kahoot — 23-dars takrori: Passive Voice (Perfect) + On the road
'O'tgan dars Kahooti' tugmasi (23-dars Kahooti: 20 savol, har biriga 15 soniya). Bugungi dars Kahootini ochmang — u 25-dars boshida o'ynaladi.
YOZMA NORMATIV — 23-dars lug'ati: On the road (CORE 20)
Ustoz 20 so'zni o'zbekcha aytadi, o'quvchi inglizchasini yozadi — 5 daqiqa; 1 daqiqa juftlikda CORE varag'i bilan tekshirish. 18–20 to'g'ri — 2 coin.
Uyga vazifa tekshiruvi
23-dars Mashq to'plami kaliti proyektorda, juftlikda tekshiriladi; eng ko'p xato qilingan 2 band doskada.
YANGI MAVZU — -ed vs -ing sifatlar

Formula jadvali (grammar.formulas): -ed — his-tuyg'u (I'm bored); -ing — odam/narsaning xususiyati (The film is boring). Juftlar va predloglar (interested in, tired of); presentation juftlikda. + 3 CCQ (grammar.notes).
Transport (transport) — CORE 20
Ustoz so'zni aytadi, sinf takrorlaydi; har o'quvchi 2–3 so'z bilan -ed/-ing gap aytadi: "The bus was crowded and I was annoyed."
Kombinatsiya

Kombinatsiya — o'quvchi bugungi formula jadvalini (tasdiq → inkor → savol, har qatorga 1 misol + o'zbekcha tarjima) yoddan, to'xtamasdan aytib chiqadi va 1 daqiqada necha marta to'liq aytgani sanaladi. Bugun: S + be/feel + adj-ed (+ in/about/of/with) / S + be + adj-ing / a(n) + adj-ing + noun. Juftlikda: biri aytadi, biri sanaydi. 1 daqiqada 3 marta — warm-up, 4 marta — normativ, 5 marta — 2 coin.
Sinf mashqlari
Majburiy: -ed yoki -ing (5 daq, yakka), Predlog qo'shing (4 daq, yakka), Juftlarni to'ldiring (3 daq, juftlik), Mini-vazifa: Mening qatnovim (6 daq, juftlik). ZAXIRA: Xatoni toping.
Reading
1-o'qish — umumiy mazmun; keyin -ed/-ing topish, TRUE / FALSE / NOT GIVEN, 3 qisqa savol; 4-topshiriq — og'zaki yoki uyga.
WRITING WORKSHOP — Final Test tayyorgarligi

Writing workshop (Final Test tayyorgarligi): 4 daq — namuna 'My last trip' tahlili va writing_a2 rubrikasi; 8 daq — o'z paragrafi (80–100 so'z — Final Test E talabi); 3 daq — juftlikda checklist bilan tekshirish.
Xatolar ustida ishlash + exit ticket
Ko'p uchragan 3–4 xato doskada (grammar.mistakes). Oxirgi 3 daqiqa — Exit ticket. ZAXIRA: Listening — vaqt qolsa, xatolar bosqichi o'rnida.
Uyga vazifa
Mashq to'plami, ovozli normativ, Final Test ga tayyorgarlik; qo'shimcha — tarjima. Final Test — 25-dars. Final Test o'quvchi yo'riqnomasi (test paketi 'final') tarqatiladi.

intro: -ED — odam NIMA HIS QILADI: I'm bored, tired, excited, interested, surprised.
-ING — narsa/odam QANDAY (his uyg'otadi): The film is boring, the trip is tiring, the news is exciting.
Predloglar: interested in, excited about, bored with, tired of, surprised at/by, worried about, frightened of.
formulas: I am bored by this film.
He is bored. / He is boring.
He is bored (zerikkan) / He is boring (zeriktiradigan).
adj-ed + in / about / with / of / at
I'm interested in trains. / I'm tired of traffic.
an exciting journey, a tiring flight
The metro was so crowded and I was really annoyed.
Metro juda gavjum edi va men rosa asabiylashdim.
presentation: Are you interested in cars?
Yes, I'm very interested in electric cars.
Was the flight tiring?
Yes, it was a tiring flight — ten hours!
Are you excited about the trip?
Yes, I'm really excited about it.
Is the traffic in Tashkent annoying?
Yes, rush hour is very annoying.
Were you surprised by the ticket price?
Yes, I was surprised — it was so cheap!
Are you tired of waiting for the bus?
Yes, I'm tired of it — let's take a taxi.
Was the last football final you watched exciting?
Yes, it was so exciting — I was shouting all the time!
notes: Sabab so'raganda: "What is boring?" — narsa; "Who is bored?" — odam.

Ko'p uchraydigan juftlar: amazed/amazing, annoyed/annoying, confused/confusing, disappointed/disappointing, embarrassed/embarrassing, exhausted/exhausting, frightened/frightening, relaxed/relaxing, shocked/shocking, worried/worrying.
Diqqat: crowded (gavjum), delayed (kechikkan) ham -ed bilan tugaydi, lekin his emas — holat: a crowded bus, a delayed flight.
Get on/off (bus, train, plane) — get in/out of (car, taxi).
CCQ: I'm bored. — Is this about my feeling? (Yes) — Is something making me feel like this? (Yes, e.g. the lesson)
CCQ: He is boring. — Does he feel bored? (Not necessarily) — Do other people feel bored with him? (Yes)
CCQ: The trip was tiring. / I was tired. — Which sentence describes the trip? (The first) — Which describes my feeling? (The second)
CCQ: an exciting match — Can we say 'an excited match'? (No — a match can't feel anything, so -ing before the noun)
mistakes: I am boring in this lesson.
I am bored in this lesson.

class_ex.title: Writing workshop (Final Test tayyorgarligi)
class_ex.instr: Namunani tahlil qiling, 'A journey I remember' mavzusida 80–100 so'z yozing (Final Test E talabi), juftlikda checklist bilan tekshiring.
box: Namuna — My last trip: Last summer my family and I went to Samarkand by high-speed train. First, the journey was really relaxing because the seats were comfortable and the train was on time. Then, we visited the Registan. I was amazed by the beautiful blue tiles, but the square was very crowded. After that, we walked a lot, so by the evening I was exhausted. However, the food was delicious and the people were friendly. In conclusion, it was a tiring but exciting trip, and I would like to go there again next year.
Reja: Kirish (qachon, qayerga, nima bilan) → First, … → Then, … → After that, … → In conclusion, …
Bog'lovchilar: First · Then · After that · However · because · so

Checklist: 1) Kirish, 3 fikr, xulosa bormi? 2) 4+ bog'lovchi? 3) 2 ta -ed va 2 ta -ing to'g'rimi? 4) 80–100 so'z (Final Test E talabi), imlo to'g'rimi? Final Test da yana 3 majburiy qolip: will have + V3; to / in order to + V1; If I + Past Simple, I would + V1.
items: 4 daq: namunada kirish, 3 fikr, xulosa va bog'lovchilarni toping; writing_a2 rubrikasi (4 × 0–5) bilan tanishing.

answers: Tahlil: Kirish — 'Last summer … train.' Fikrlar — First (relaxing, on time), Then (Registan: amazed, crowded), After that (exhausted). Xulosa — 'In conclusion …'. Bog'lovchilar: First, Then, After that, However, because, so, but.

Namuna: Last month I went to Bukhara by coach with my classmates. First, the journey was long and tiring because the coach was crowded. Then, we visited the old city in order to see the famous buildings, and I was fascinated by them. After that, we had plov, but it was surprisingly expensive, so we were disappointed. However, our guide was really interesting, and we weren't bored. In conclusion, it was an exhausting but amazing trip. If I had more time, I would go there again.

box: 1–6: S + have/has + V3 · PP vs Past Simple · since / for · already, just, yet, still · have been + V-ing · PP vs PPC
7–13: -er than / more … than · the -est / the most · had + V3 · will have + V3 · before / after / by the time / as soon as · had been + V-ing · will have been + V-ing
14–19: Aux + S + V? / Wh + Aux + S + V? · If + Past Simple, would + V1 · during / while; unless · Could you tell me where … is? · I wish + Past Simple · to / in order to / so that
20–24: have to / must / should · be + V3 · being + V3 · have been + V3 · -ed (his) / -ing (xususiyat) + in / of / about
Lug'at: 1–24-darslar CORE varaqlarini takrorlang (B bo'lim — shu so'zlardan, o'zbekchadan inglizchaga).

D (Reading) — "Kamol has been learning English since 2023." TRUE / FALSE / NOT GIVEN: Kamol's sister also learns English.
E (Writing) — 'My plans by 2030' (80–100 so'z): faqat reja — kirish, 3 reja (will have + V3; in order to; If I …, I would …), xulosa.
answers: If I had time, I would go to Khiva.

reading.title: Diyora Keldiyorova — an amazing Olympic champion
text: Diyora Keldiyorova is a judoka from Uzbekistan. She was born in 1998. Judo is an exciting sport, but the training is hard and often exhausting. Diyora worked hard for many years.

In 2024 she competed at the Olympic Games in Paris. In the final she beat a strong judoka from Kosovo. It was an amazing result: Diyora became the first Uzbek woman to win gold at the Summer Olympics. Millions of Uzbeks were proud, and that night the streets of Tashkent were full of excited fans.

Madina, 14, from Namangan, watched the final on TV with her family. "I was so worried that I couldn't sit down," she says. "The last minute was terrifying! When Diyora won, we were shocked and then really happy."

Today Diyora is an inspiring example for many girls in Uzbekistan. Madina became interested in judo too, and she started training last month. "The training is tiring, but I'm never bored," she says. "I'm really excited about my first competition."

kahoot.q: I was ___ during the long bus journey.

kahoot.q: I'm ___ in trains and old cars.

kahoot.q: Riding a camel was an ___ experience.
kahoot.explain: Tajriba QANDAY → -ing: an exciting experience.

kahoot.q: «Men bu darsda zerikyapman.» Qaysi tarjima NOTO'G'RI?

I am bored in this lesson.
I feel bored in this lesson.
I get bored in this lesson.

The metro was crowded and I was annoying.

The metro crowded and I was annoying.

kahoot.q: The news about the new metro line was ___.
kahoot.explain: Yangilik QANDAY → -ing: surprising (hayratlanarli).

kahoot.q: This is our stop. Let's get ___ the bus.

kahoot.q: We got ___ the taxi and told the driver the address.

lessons.title: Reflexive Pronouns + Course Revision
lessons.grammar_topic: O'ZLIK OLMOSHLARI (myself, yourself…) + IELTS 2.0 YAKUNIY TAKROR
lessons.test_after: FINAL TEST — shu darsda (25-dars), 45 daqiqa; qamrov: 1–24-darslar
lessons.book_ref: Asosiy material — shu reja (formula jadvali, mashqlar, matn). Ixtiyoriy qo'shimcha: Student's book IELTS 2.0, Lesson 25 — dars kitobsiz ham to'liq o'tiladi.
objectives: Final Test (1–24-darslar) ni 45 daqiqada yakka yozadi; tahlilda A–C bo'limlaridagi o'z xatolarini belgilaydi.
Sakkizta o'zlik olmoshini egaga moslaydi (I → myself, they → themselves): 'O'zlik olmoshi' mashqidagi 8 ta gapdan kamida 6 tasida to'g'ri olmosh qo'yadi.
each other (bir-birini) va themselves (o'zlarini) ni farqlaydi, by myself = yolg'iz ma'nosini biladi: 5 ta gapdan kamida 4 tasida to'g'ri tanlaydi; exit ticket'da 3 banddan kamida 2 tasi to'g'ri.
Kombinatsiya: o'zlik olmoshi jadvalini (tasdiq → inkor → savol) 1 daqiqada kamida 4 marta aytadi (normativ).
materials: Formula jadvali — rejaning Grammatika bo'limi (grammar.formulas), proyektor yoki doska
Kurs lug'ati — 60 so'z (CORE/STRONG/SUPER) varag'i: uyda flashcard takrori uchun.
Kahoot: 'O'tgan dars Kahooti' tugmasi (24-dars savollari); 'Bugungi dars Kahooti' — kurs takrori (25-dars savollari)
Final Test varag'i (A/B variant) va kaliti — test paketi 'final'
timeline: Salomlashish + kirish savoli
Ustoz: "I taught myself to cook. Did you teach yourself anything?" — har o'quvchi bitta "I taught myself to …" gapi aytadi. Bugungi tartib: yangi mavzu → Kahoot takrori → Final Test → tahlil.
Kahoot — 24-dars takrori: Adjectives -ed vs -ing + Transport
'O'tgan dars Kahooti' tugmasi (24-dars Kahooti: 20 savol, har biriga 15 soniya). Bugungi dars Kahooti keyinroq 'Kurs takrori' bosqichida o'ynaladi.
YANGI MAVZU — O'zlik olmoshlari (myself … themselves) va each other

Formula jadvali (grammar.formulas): myself, yourself, himself, herself, itself, ourselves, yourselves, themselves — ega va ob'ekt bir odam bo'lganda (She cut herself); urg'u (We built it ourselves); by + self = yolg'iz (He lives by himself); each other = bir-birini (They help each other). Presentation'dan 4 juftlikni ustoz modellaydi, qolgani juftlikda. Oxirgi 1 daqiqa — Kombinatsiya: Kombinatsiya — o'quvchi bugungi formula jadvalini (tasdiq → inkor → savol, har qatorga 1 misol + o'zbekcha tarjima) yoddan, to'xtamasdan aytib chiqadi va 1 daqiqada necha marta to'liq aytgani sanaladi. Bugun: S + V + self (She cut herself. — U o'zini kesib oldi.) / S + didn't + V + self (She didn't cut herself.) / Did + S + V + self? (Did she cut herself?). Juftlikda: biri aytadi, biri sanaydi. 1 daqiqada 3 marta — warm-up, 4 marta — normativ, 5 marta — 2 coin. + 3 CCQ (grammar.notes).
Sinf mashqlari

Majburiy: O'zlik olmoshi (6 daq, yakka), each other yoki themselves (6 daq, juftlik). ZAXIRA: Kurs takrori — formulalar, Kurs takrori — zamon tanlash, Xatoni toping. Exit ticket — 'Kurs yakuni' bosqichida.
Kurs takrori — 25-dars Kahooti

'Bugungi dars Kahooti' tugmasi (25-dars Kahooti: 20 savol — 12 grammatika 1–24-darslardan + 8 lug'at turli darslar CORE ro'yxatidan, har biriga 15 soniya). Final Test oldidan isinish: har savoldan keyin ustoz explain'ni 1 jumlada aytadi.
Final testga yo'riqnoma

Telefonlar yig'iladi, partalar ajratiladi. O'quvchi yo'riqnomasi (1 sahifa, test paketi 'final') o'qiladi: 45 daqiqa, 5 bo'lim (A–E), javob faqat varaqqa, ruchka bilan; savol bo'lsa qo'l ko'taring. O'tish: jami kamida 70 ball va har bo'limda o'z maksimumining kamida 40% i.
FINAL TEST — IELTS 2.0 (1–24-darslar)

45 daqiqa, yakka, qog'ozda. Varaq: test paketi 'final' (A/B variant — qo'shni partalarga har xil); kalit faqat ustozda. Bo'limlar: A Grammatika 30 · B Lug'at 20 · C Tarjima 10 · D Reading 20 · E Writing 20 = 100 ball. Vaqt: A 8 · B 5 · C 5 · D 12 · E 15 daqiqa.
TEST TAHLILI — Final Test

Varaqlar yig'ilgach: A–C bo'limlari kaliti proyektorda, o'quvchi o'z qoralamasi bo'yicha xatosini belgilaydi; eng ko'p uchragan 3–5 xato doskada tushuntiriladi. D–E ni ustoz 2 kun ichida tekshirib (E — writing_a2 rubrikasi), natijani tizimga bo'limlar kesimida kiritadi. O'TDI → IELTS 3.0; qayta topshirish va remedial — test paketidagi qoida bo'yicha.
Kurs yakuni + uyga vazifa

2 daqiqa: Exit ticket (class_ex oxirida), yakka, varaqqa. 3 daqiqa: kurs yakuni va uyga vazifa — MAJBURIY: Men o'zim haqimda (8 gap); QO'SHIMCHA: Kurs lug'ati (flashcard 60 so'z), Reading (Beruniy matni + T/F/NG). ZAXIRA: Listening (kurs yakuni skripti) — vaqt qolsa, shu bosqichda.

intro: O'zlik olmoshi — ish egaga qaytganda: "She cut herself while cooking" (o'zini kesib oldi).
Urg'u: "We built the bookshelf ourselves" (boshqa hech kim emas, o'zimiz).
by + o'zlik olmoshi = yolg'iz, yordamsiz: "He lives by himself."
each other — bir-birini: "They help each other" (u — unga, u — unga); "They help themselves" — har biri o'ziga.
Iboralar: enjoy yourself (maza qil), help yourself (o'zing ol), behave yourself (o'zingni tut), make yourself at home.
formulas: I bought myself a new book. / You can help yourself to some snacks.
O'zimga yangi kitob oldim. / O'zingiz gazak oling.
he … himself / she … herself / it … itself
He taught himself to play the guitar. / She cut herself while cooking.
U gitara chalishni o'zi o'rgandi. / U ovqat pishirayotib o'zini kesib oldi.
we … ourselves / you (pl) … yourselves / they … themselves
We built the bookshelf ourselves. / Please make yourselves at home.
Javonni o'zimiz yasadik. / O'zingizni uydagidek his qiling.
The president opened the school himself.
Ibn Sina and Beruni wrote to each other.
Ibn Sino va Beruniy bir-biriga xat yozishgan.
presentation: Did you teach yourself English?
No, I learned it at Jony Academy — but I taught myself the alphabet.
Did she hurt herself?
Yes, she cut herself while cooking.
Do you live by yourself?
No, I live with my family.
Did they build the house themselves?
Yes, they built it themselves.
Did you enjoy yourselves at the party?
Yes, we enjoyed ourselves a lot.
Do you and your sister help each other?
Yes, we help each other with homework.
Did the teacher herself check the tests?
Yes, she checked them herself.
Can I take a cake?
Of course — help yourself!
Did Beruni measure the size of the Earth?
Yes, he measured it himself.
What have you learned about yourself this course?
I've learned that I can speak English!
notes: Ko'plik: yourselves (siz — ko'p), themselves, ourselves; "theirselves / hisself" — xato.
Ba'zi fe'llardan keyin self yo'q: relax, concentrate, feel, wash/shave/dress (odatda): "I feel good" (myself emas).

Final Test tarkibi (test paketi 'final', 45 daqiqa, 100 ball): A Grammatika 30 (1–24-darslar) · B Lug'at 20 (CORE ro'yxatlaridan, 24-dars Transport'dan 3 ta) · C Tarjima 10 (5 gap) · D Reading 20 (TRUE / FALSE / NOT GIVEN + qisqa javob) · E Writing 20 ("My plans by 2030", 80–100 so'z, writing_a2 rubrikasi). Bugungi mavzu (o'zlik olmoshlari) testga kirmaydi.
CCQ: They looked at themselves in the mirror. — Did each person look at his or her own face? (Yes) — Did they look at the other person? (No)
CCQ: They looked at each other. — Did Ali look at Vali and Vali look at Ali? (Yes) — Did they look in a mirror? (No)
CCQ: He lives by himself. — Does he live with his family? (No) — Is he alone at home? (Yes)
CCQ: We painted the room ourselves. — Did a painter help us? (No) — Who did the work? (We did)
mistakes: We looked at ourselves and smiled. (bir-biriga)
We looked at each other and smiled.

how: CORE 20 — 1–13-darslarning takror so'zlari; STRONG — 11–20-darslar; SUPER — 21–24-darslar + bugungi reflexive iboralar va Beruniy matni so'zlari. Sinfda alohida CORE bosqichi yo'q (Final Test kuni): so'zlar uyda flashcard orqali takrorlanadi.
Uyda (ixtiyoriy): 60 so'zdan 10 tasini o'zingiz tanlab, har biri bilan gap tuzing (I chose these words myself).
core: I have begun to believe in myself.
I have lost my keys again!
Beruni was born in Khorezm in 973.
She gave birth to twins last year.
They got married in 2015 and still love each other.

class_ex.title: Final Test — IELTS 2.0 (1–24-darslar): ustoz uchun o'tkazish tartibi va ball jadvali
class_ex.instr: Test 25-darsda, 45 daqiqa. Har o'quvchiga A variant chop etib beriladi; B variant faqat qayta topshirish va remedial uchun saqlanadi — o'quvchilarga oldindan ko'rsatilmaydi.
items: 1. Tayyorgarlik (test kunidan oldin): A variant varaqlarini o'quvchilar soniga +2 nusxa chop eting (A–D bo'limlar 2 varaqda (ikki tomonlama), E bo'lim yozuvi uchun alohida varaq — 12 qator). Ball varag'ini guruh ro'yxati bilan chop eting. Kalitlar faqat ustoz ko'rinishida — proyektorga chiqarilmaydi.
2. Boshlashdan oldin (2–3 daqiqa, 45 daqiqaga kirmaydi): telefonlar yig'iladi, partalar alohida. O'quvchi yo'riqnomasini ovoz chiqarib o'qing: 5 bo'lim, 100 ball, o'tish qoidasi.
3. Proyektorda faqat: bo'lim nomi, qolgan vaqt (taymer) va joriy bo'lim ko'rsatmasi. Javob, reading kaliti va namuna javob proyektorga CHIQMAYDI.

4. Vaqt: A. Grammatika — 8 daq. → B. Lug'at — 5 daq. → C. Tarjima — 5 daq. → D. Reading — 12 daq. → E. Writing — 15 daq. (jami 45). Har bo'lim oxirida 1 daqiqa qolganini ayting; bo'limdan bo'limga o'tishda varaq yig'ilmaydi, lekin ortga qaytish faqat qolgan vaqt hisobidan.
5. Test vaqtida ustoz savol mazmunini tushuntirmaydi — faqat ko'rsatmani o'zbekcha takrorlashi mumkin. Ko'chirish aniqlansa — o'sha bo'lim 0 ball, sababi ball varag'iga yoziladi.

6. Tekshirish (A–D): kalit bo'yicha. A — har savol 2 ball (qavsdagi so'zda imlo xatosi bo'lsa, lekin shakl to'g'ri — 1 ball). B — har so'z 1 ball, bitta harf xatosi — 0.5, ikki va undan ko'p harf xatosi — 0. C — har gap 2 ball: 1 ball zamon/qolip, 1 ball so'z tartibi va lug'at. D — har savol 2.5 ball; qisqa javobda 3 so'zdan ko'p yozilsa — 0; imlo xatosi ma'noni buzmasa — ball beriladi.

7. Tekshirish (E): writing_a2 rubrikasi — 4 mezon × 0–5 = 20 ball. Avval so'zlarni sanang (80–100), keyin 3 majburiy qolip (will have + V3; to / in order to; If I …, I would …) va bog'lovchilarni belgilang. Shubhali ishni ikkinchi ustoz ham baholaydi, o'rtachasi olinadi.

8. Natija tizimga bo'limlar kesimida (A, B, C, D, E alohida) test kunining o'zida yoki ertasi kuni kiritiladi. O'quvchiga ish 1 dars ichida ko'rsatiladi va 3 ta eng ko'p takrorlangan xato sinfda tahlil qilinadi.
answers: O'TDI: jami ≥ 70 VA har bo'limda maksimumning kamida 40% i (A ≥ 12, B ≥ 8, C ≥ 4, D ≥ 8, E ≥ 8) → IELTS 3.0 (B1) ga o'tadi.
Jami ≥ 85 (va barcha bo'limlar chegaradan yuqori) → O'TDI + kuchli IELTS 3.0 guruhiga tavsiya (ma'muriyatga yoziladi).

QAYTA TOPSHIRISH: jami 50–69 YOKI biror bo'lim 40% dan past (jami ≥ 50 bo'lsa ham) → 7 kun ichida B variantdan faqat past bo'lim(lar) qayta yoziladi; yangi ball eski bo'lim balli o'rniga qo'yiladi. Qayta topshirishdan keyingi jami 70 dan yuqori hisoblanmaydi (masalan, 76 chiqsa ham tizimga 70 yoziladi). Shartlar bajarilsa → O'TDI → IELTS 3.0.

REMEDIAL: jami < 50 → ustoz 2 ta qo'shimcha mashg'ulot o'tkazadi (har biri 30 daqiqa, eng zaif 2 bo'lim bo'yicha: grammatika — 1–24-darslar formulalari, lug'at — CORE ro'yxatlari, reading — T/F/NG strategiyasi, writing — reja + bog'lovchilar), so'ng B variant to'liq (45 daqiqa) qayta yoziladi va yuqoridagi qoidalar bo'yicha baholanadi.
Qayta topshirish yoki remedialdan keyin ham shart bajarilmasa — ustoz va o'quv bo'limi rahbari o'quvchini IELTS 2.0 ni takrorlash yoki shaxsiy reja bo'yicha qaror qiladi (ota-onaga xabar beriladi).

class_ex.instr: Choose the correct answer A, B, C or D. (To'g'ri javobni tanlang: A, B, C yoki D. Harfni aylana ichiga oling.) Time for A (1–15): 8 minutes.
items: 1. I _____ my keys yesterday, so I couldn't open the door. A) have lost B) lost C) have lose D) was lose
2. My parents have been married _____ 2005. A) for B) since C) ago D) during
3. Aziz is _____ student in our group. A) the most hard-working B) more hard-working C) the hard-workingest D) most hard-working than
4. By the time we arrived at the station, the train _____. A) left B) has left C) had left D) leaves
5. Could you tell me where _____? A) is the bank B) the bank is C) does the bank D) the bank does
6. You will miss the bus _____ you hurry. A) if B) unless C) during D) while
7. Our flat _____ recently — the walls look new. A) has been painted B) has painted C) is painting D) painted been
8. Sorry, you can't use this room now. It _____. A) is cleaning B) cleans C) is being cleaned D) has cleaned
why: 3-dars: aniq boshlanish nuqtasi (2005) → since; for — muddat.
9/11-darslar: by the time + Past Simple, ikkinchi (oldinroq) ish → Past Perfect.
17-dars: bilvosita savolda tartib to'g'ri gapdagidek: where + ega + fe'l.
23-dars: xonadonni kimdir bo'yagan, natija hozir → Present Perfect Passive (has been + V3).
22-dars: hozir jarayonda, xona o'zi tozalamaydi → is being + V3.

10. By next June, I _____ (finish) this English course.
11. If I _____ (have) more money, I would buy a new phone.
12. I don't know the answer. I wish I _____ (know) it.
13. This bridge _____ (build) in 1998.
14. At her new school, Laylo _____ (not / have to) wear a uniform — it is optional.
15. The film was very long and _____ (bore). I nearly fell asleep.
answers: doesn't have to (does not have to)
why: 5-dars: jarayon hozirgacha davom etgan (for an hour) → has been + V-ing.
10-dars: kelajakdagi nuqtagacha tugaydi → will have + V3.
15-dars: 2-tur shart gap → If + Past Simple, would + V1.
18-dars: hozirgi holatdan afsus → wish + Past Simple.
21-dars: Past Simple Passive → was + V3 (build → built).
20-dars: shart emas → don't/doesn't have to + V1 (Laylo → doesn't); wear gapda bor, qayta yozilmaydi.
24-dars: narsa/holat qanday → -ing sifat (boring); odam his qiladi → bored.

class_ex.type: Reading: 5 × TRUE / FALSE / NOT GIVEN + 3 × short answer (8 × 2.5 ball)
class_ex.instr: Read the text. Questions 1–5: write TRUE, FALSE or NOT GIVEN. Questions 6–8: write NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS from the text. (Matnni o'qing. 1–5: TRUE — matnda shunday yozilgan, FALSE — matnga zid, NOT GIVEN — matnda bu haqda ma'lumot yo'q. 6–8: matndan ko'pi bilan 3 so'z yozing.) Time: 12 minutes.
box: TEXT: A Busy Year for Sardor
Sardor is nineteen and he lives in Namangan. He has been learning English for two years, and he has already passed two English tests. Last year was the busiest year of his life.

In January, Sardor's older sister got married, so the whole family was very excited. Before the wedding, Sardor had never worn a suit, and he felt a little nervous. His mother said he looked more handsome than all his friends.
In March, Sardor got a job in a small shop to save money. He works there three evenings a week. The job is sometimes tiring, but the customers are kind and polite.
In summer, he travelled to Tashkent by train with his cousin. The journey took four hours. While they were in the city, they visited a museum and bought souvenirs for their parents.

Now Sardor is saving money in order to study in Korea. He says, "If I had more free time, I would learn Korean too." By 2027, he hopes he will have finished his English course. His teacher thinks he is one of the most hard-working students in the group.
items: 1. Sardor has been learning English for two years.
2. Sardor's sister got married in the summer.
3. Sardor had worn a suit many times before his sister's wedding.
4. Sardor's cousin is older than Sardor.
5. Sardor and his cousin paid nothing to visit the museum.
6. How many evenings a week does Sardor work in the shop?
7. How did Sardor travel to Tashkent?
8. In which country does Sardor want to study?
why: 1-xatboshi: "He has been learning English for two years".
2-xatboshi: "Sardor had never worn a suit" — gapga zid.
Muzey narxi haqida hech narsa aytilmagan.

class_ex.title: Variant A — E. Writing: "My plans by 2030" — 20 ball
class_ex.instr: Write about your plans by 2030. Follow the plan below. (2030-yilgacha rejalaringiz haqida reja bo'yicha yozing. 24-darsdagi Writing workshop formatida.)
items: 1. Topic: "My plans by 2030". Write 80–100 words. (Mavzu: "2030-yilgacha rejalarim". 80–100 so'z yozing.)
2. Introduction: 1–2 sentences about you and your future. (Kirish: 1–2 gap.)
3. Three plans (uchta reja): study (o'qish), work or money (ish yoki pul), travel (sayohat).
4. Use at least: 1 × will have + V3 (By 2030, I will have …); 1 × to / in order to + V1; 1 × If I + Past Simple, I would + V1. (Kamida bittadan shu 3 qolipni ishlating.)
5. Use at least 4 different linking words: first, second, because, so, but, however, when, and, in conclusion … (Kamida 4 xil bog'lovchi.)
6. Conclusion: 1 sentence. Count your words and write the number at the end. (Xulosa — 1 gap. Oxirida so'zlar sonini yozing.) Time: 15 minutes.
answers: Namuna javob (A2, 100 so'z): My plans by 2030. I am sixteen, and I have big plans for my future. First, I want to improve my English. By 2030, I will have passed the IELTS exam, and I will have finished school. Second, I am going to find a part-time job in order to save money for a laptop. Third, I want to travel. If I saved enough money, I would visit Turkey with my family because we love its history. However, these plans are not easy, so I study every day. In conclusion, I believe my dreams will come true when I work hard.
Namunada: kirish (1–2-gaplar), 3 reja (First / Second / Third), xulosa (In conclusion).
A variant yo'nalishi: o'qish, ish/pul, sayohat. Boshqa 3 reja ham qabul qilinadi, agar mavzu (2030-yilgacha rejalar) saqlansa.

Majburiy qoliplar: will have + V3 — "will have passed / will have learned"; to / in order to — "in order to save / to stay healthy"; If I + Past Simple, I would — "If I saved …, I would visit … / If I earned …, I would buy …".
Bog'lovchilar namunada: and, first, second, third, because, however, so, when, in conclusion — 4 tadan ko'p.

Baholash: writing_a2 rubrikasi (quyidagi jadval), 4 mezon × 0–5 = 20 ball. Majburiy qoliplardan biri yo'q bo'lsa — "Topshiriqni bajarish" mezoni ko'pi bilan 4; 60 so'zdan kam — ko'pi bilan 2; namuna matnni yodlab yozgan — 0.

box: Nodira is a university student from Bukhara. She has always wanted to see the old city of Khiva, and last month she finally went there with two friends.

They had planned the trip for weeks and had saved money for tickets, food and a cheap hostel. On Friday morning they got on the bus at seven o'clock. The journey was long and boring, so Nodira read a book during the trip.

When they arrived, the weather was sunny but windy. They walked around the old walls and took hundreds of photos. In the evening they ate plov in a small cafe. The waiter was very friendly, and the bill was lower than they had expected.
On Saturday, one of her friends lost her phone. She was very worried, but a kind shop assistant found it and brought it back. Nodira says it was the most surprising moment of the weekend.

Now Nodira is saving money again in order to visit Samarkand in spring. "If I had a car, I would travel every month," she says. She hopes she will have seen every old city in Uzbekistan by the time she finishes university.
items: 1. Nodira went to Khiva alone.
2. Nodira and her friends travelled to Khiva by bus.
3. It was raining when they arrived in Khiva.
4. The hostel gave the friends free breakfast.
5. Nodira's friend gave the shop assistant some money.
6. What did Nodira do during the journey?
7. What did the friends eat in the evening?
8. Which city does Nodira want to visit in spring?
why: Sotuvchiga pul berilgani haqida hech narsa yozilmagan.
2-xatboshi: "Nodira read a book during the trip".
5-xatboshi: "in order to visit Samarkand in spring".

class_ex.title: Variant B — E. Writing: "My plans by 2030" — 20 ball
class_ex.instr: Write about your plans by 2030. Follow the plan below. (2030-yilgacha rejalaringiz haqida reja bo'yicha yozing. 24-darsdagi Writing workshop formatida.)
items: 1. Topic: "My plans by 2030". Write 80–100 words. (Mavzu: "2030-yilgacha rejalarim". 80–100 so'z yozing.)
2. Introduction: 1–2 sentences about you and your future. (Kirish: 1–2 gap.)
3. Three plans (uchta reja): new skills (yangi ko'nikmalar), health and sport (sog'liq va sport), family and home (oila va uy).
4. Use at least: 1 × will have + V3 (By 2030, I will have …); 1 × to / in order to + V1; 1 × If I + Past Simple, I would + V1. (Kamida bittadan shu 3 qolipni ishlating.)
5. Use at least 4 different linking words: first, second, because, so, but, however, when, and, in conclusion … (Kamida 4 xil bog'lovchi.)
6. Conclusion: 1 sentence. Count your words and write the number at the end. (Xulosa — 1 gap. Oxirida so'zlar sonini yozing.) Time: 15 minutes.
answers: Namuna javob (A2, 94 so'z): My plans by 2030. I am fifteen, and I am thinking about my future. First, I want to learn new skills. By 2030, I will have learned to drive, and I will have finished a computer course. Second, I am going to do sport to stay healthy. Third, I want to help my family. If I earned a good salary, I would buy a bigger flat for my parents. However, it will take time, so I save money every month. In conclusion, I am sure my plans will come true because I am hard-working.
Namunada: kirish (1–2-gaplar), 3 reja (First / Second / Third), xulosa (In conclusion).
B variant yo'nalishi: yangi ko'nikmalar, sog'liq va sport, oila va uy. Qayta topshiruvchi A variantdagi o'z matnini takrorlasa — Topshiriq mezoni ko'pi bilan 2.

Majburiy qoliplar: will have + V3 — "will have passed / will have learned"; to / in order to — "in order to save / to stay healthy"; If I + Past Simple, I would — "If I saved …, I would visit … / If I earned …, I would buy …".
Bog'lovchilar namunada: and, first, second, third, because, however, so, when, in conclusion — 4 tadan ko'p.

Baholash: writing_a2 rubrikasi (quyidagi jadval), 4 mezon × 0–5 = 20 ball. Majburiy qoliplardan biri yo'q bo'lsa — "Topshiriqni bajarish" mezoni ko'pi bilan 4; 60 so'zdan kam — ko'pi bilan 2; namuna matnni yodlab yozgan — 0.

head: Bo'lim
Maks.
Chegara (40%)
Variant A balli
Qayta topshirish (B) balli
Izoh (xato turi)
rows: E. Writing (4 mezon × 5): Topshiriq ___ ;; Grammatika ___ ;; Lug'at ___ ;; Tuzilish ___

Misol 1: A 24, B 16, C 8, D 17.5, E 15 → jami 80.5, barcha bo'limlar chegaradan yuqori → O'TDI (IELTS 3.0).
Misol 2: A 26, B 7, C 8, D 20, E 17 → jami 78, lekin B < 8 → QAYTA TOPSHIRISH: faqat B (lug'at) bo'limi B variantdan; yangi natija bilan jami 70 dan yuqori yozilmaydi.

class_ex.title: O'quvchi uchun yo'riqnoma (1 sahifa) — Final Test IELTS 2.0
class_ex.type: Chop etib beriladi / testdan oldin ovoz chiqarib o'qiladi
class_ex.instr: Testdan bir dars oldin (24-dars oxirida) va test boshlanishida o'quvchilarga beriladi.
items: 1. Test 45 daqiqa davom etadi va 5 bo'limdan iborat: A. Grammatika (30 ball, 8 daqiqa), B. Lug'at (20 ball, 5 daqiqa), C. Tarjima (10 ball, 5 daqiqa), D. Reading (20 ball, 12 daqiqa), E. Writing (20 ball, 15 daqiqa). Jami — 100 ball.
2. Test 1–24-darslardagi grammatika va CORE so'zlarni tekshiradi. Takrorlash uchun: har darsning formulalari va 20 ta CORE so'zi, Progress Test 1–3 dagi xatolaringiz.
3. Testdan O'TISH uchun: jami kamida 70 ball VA har bir bo'limda kamida 40% (Grammatika — 12, Lug'at — 8, Tarjima — 4, Reading — 8, Writing — 8).
4. O'tgan o'quvchilar IELTS 3.0 (B1) kursiga o'tadi. 85 va undan yuqori ball olganlar kuchli guruhga tavsiya etiladi.
5. Jami 50–69 ball yoki biror bo'lim 40% dan past bo'lsa — 7 kun ichida faqat past bo'limni qayta yozasiz. Bunda jami ball 70 dan yuqori yozilmaydi.
6. Jami 50 dan kam bo'lsa — ustoz bilan 2 ta qo'shimcha mashg'ulot (30 daqiqadan), keyin testni to'liq qayta yozasiz.
7. Telefon va lug'at ishlatilmaydi. Ko'chirish aniqlansa — o'sha bo'lim 0 ball.

8. Maslahatlar: avval savolni oxirigacha o'qing; Reading'da NOT GIVEN — matnda bu haqda umuman ma'lumot yo'q degani; qisqa javobga 3 so'zdan ko'p yozmang; Writing'da reja tuzing (kirish — 3 reja — xulosa), 3 majburiy qolipni belgilab qo'ying va so'zlarni sanang; oxirgi 2 daqiqada imloni tekshiring.
answers: Ustoz tekshiradi: har o'quvchi yo'riqnomani oldi va o'tish qoidasini tushundi (2–3 o'quvchidan o'zbekcha qayta aytib berishni so'rang: "Nechchi ball kerak? Har bo'limda-chi?").
To'g'ri javob: jami ≥ 70 va har bo'limda ≥ 40% (12 / 8 / 4 / 8 / 8).

homework.title: QO'SHIMCHA: Reading — Beruniy matni + TRUE / FALSE / NOT GIVEN (~15 daq)
homework.instr: Reading bo'limidagi "Abu Rayhan Beruni and the size of the Earth" matnini glossariy bilan o'qing va 3 topshiriqni bajaring: o'zlik olmoshlarini toping, TRUE / FALSE / NOT GIVEN, kurs grammatikasi bilan 5 gap.
answers: O'zlik olmoshlari: each other (wrote letters to each other), himself (measured the radius of the Earth himself), himself (described the method himself), yourself (Ask yourself), ourselves (check his result ourselves).
TRUE / FALSE / NOT GIVEN: 1 TRUE, 2 FALSE, 3 NOT GIVEN, 4 FALSE, 5 TRUE.

5 gap: Namuna — Before he went to India, he had studied the stars in Khorezm. / A crater on the Moon was named after him. Mezon: har gap ko'rsatilgan grammatikada (Past Perfect, passive, superlative, conditional 3, wish) va matn faktlariga zid emas; 5 dan kamida 4 tasi to'g'ri.

reading.title: Abu Rayhan Beruni and the size of the Earth
text: Abu Rayhan Beruni was born in 973 in Kath, an old city in Khorezm. He was educated in Khorezm, and when he was still young, he studied the Sun, the stars and maps.

Beruni studied many sciences: astronomy, mathematics, geography, history and medicine. He knew several languages, including Arabic and Persian. He and Ibn Sina wrote letters to each other and argued about science.

In 1017 Beruni was taken to Ghazni (in today's Afghanistan) by Sultan Mahmud. From there he travelled to India. He learned Sanskrit, the old language of Indian science, and wrote a famous book called "India" about the culture, religion and science of the country.

Later, standing on a mountain in today's Pakistan, Beruni measured the radius of the Earth himself. He used a simple instrument and some mathematics. His result was about 6,340 km. The real number is about 6,371 km, so the difference is less than 1 percent. Beruni described the method himself in one of his books.

Beruni wrote more than 100 books and spent the rest of his life in Ghazni. Today a city in Karakalpakstan and a crater on the Moon are named after him. Ask yourself: could you measure the Earth with a mountain and a simple instrument? Today we can check his result ourselves — and he was almost right!
glossary: be named after — nomi bilan atalmoq

tasks.title: Kurs yakuni
tasks.instr: Listen again and complete the notes. Write ONE WORD AND/OR A NUMBER for each answer.
items: Lessons completed: ___
Number of tests: ___
Before the final test, some students felt ___.
Read for ___ minutes every day.
Unless you ___, you will forget.

transcript: Teacher: Congratulations, everyone! You have finished IELTS 2.0.
Teacher: Twenty-five lessons have been completed, and you have written four tests.
Teacher: I know some of you were anxious before the final test. Now you can relax and feel relieved.
Teacher: Ask yourselves: what have I learned? You can talk about the past and the future, compare things and give advice.
Teacher: Many of you taught yourselves new words at home, and you helped each other in class. You have been hard-working and reliable students.
Teacher: Be proud of yourselves!
Teacher: Enjoy yourselves after the course, but don't lose your English: read for fifteen minutes every day.
Teacher: Remember: unless you practise, you will forget.
Teacher: IELTS 3.0 is the next step. Believe in yourselves — see you there!

kahoot.q: I taught ___ to swim.
kahoot.explain: Ega va ob'ekt bir odam → myself.

kahoot.q: Ibn Sina and Beruni wrote letters to ___.
kahoot.explain: Biri ikkinchisiga → each other. themselves — har biri o'ziga.

kahoot.q: I ___ Samarkand last summer.
kahoot.explain: «last summer» — aniq o'tgan vaqt → Past Simple (visited).

kahoot.q: This school ___ in 2015.
kahoot.explain: Maktab o'zi qurmaydi → passive, 2015 → was built.

kahoot.q: If I ___ rich, I would buy a house for my parents.
kahoot.explain: Type 2: If + Past Simple (were), would + V1.

kahoot.q: The metro is ___ than the bus.
kahoot.explain: Qisqa sifat: fast → faster than. «more faster» — xato.

kahoot.q: Do you know where ___?
kahoot.explain: Bilvosita savol: ega + fe'l (the station is).

kahoot.q: You ___ park here — it's not allowed.
kahoot.explain: Ruxsat yo'q (taqiq) → mustn't.

kahoot.q: I ___ English at Jony Academy for two years.
kahoot.explain: for two years + hali davom etyapti → have been + V-ing.

kahoot.q: When we arrived at the cinema, the film ___.
kahoot.explain: O'tgandagi ikki ishdan oldingisi → had + V3 (had already started).

kahoot.q: I wish I ___ more free time. (Hozir vaqtim kam.)
kahoot.explain: Hozirgi holatdan afsus → wish + Past Simple (had).

kahoot.q: The film was so ___ that I fell asleep.
kahoot.explain: Film — sabab/xususiyat → -ing (boring). bored — odamning hissi.

kahoot.q: My grandfather ___ away last year. We miss him a lot.
kahoot.explain: pass away — olamdan o'tmoq.

kahoot.q: I passed the exam! I'm ___ — very, very happy.
kahoot.explain: delighted — juda xursand. homesick — uyini sog'ingan.

kahoot.q: Ali studies every day and never stops. He is very ___.
kahoot.explain: hard-working — mehnatkash. lazy — dangasa.

kahoot.q: The doctor gave me a ___ for some medicine.
kahoot.explain: prescription — dori retsepti.

kahoot.q: «hozirgacha» — inglizcha?
kahoot.explain: so far — hozirgacha. as soon as — ...bilanoq.

kahoot.q: A week of very hot weather is a ___.
kahoot.explain: heatwave — jazirama davri. rainbow — kamalak.

kahoot.q: Our parents' wedding ___ is on 5 May — 25 years together!
kahoot.explain: anniversary — yillik (to'y yilligi).

kahoot.q: The bus was very ___ — there were no free seats.
kahoot.explain: crowded — gavjum (odam ko'p).
